name: Elevación de talones en hack
instructions: ajusta the sled machine to a cómodo weight.
párate on the sled machine with tus dedos del pie on the plataforma and tus talones hanging off.
mantén onto the handles for stability.
eleva tus talones lo más alto posible by pushing through the la parte delantera de tus pies.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más alto, luego lentamente baja tus talones back down to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Press de piernas en trineo 45°
instructions: ajusta the seat of the sled machine so that tus rodillas are at a ángulo de 90 grados when tus pies are on the footplate.
siéntate en sled machine with tu espalda plano against the backrest and tus pies al ancho de hombros on the footplate.
agarra the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
empuja against the footplate to extiende tus piernas, straightening them completely.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más alto, luego lentamente flexiona tus rodillas to baja the footplate de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Elevación frontal con mancuerna
instructions: párate con los pies al ancho de hombros, holding a mancuerna in each hand with your palmas hacia your muslos.
manteniendo arms recto, exhala and levanta the mancuernas frente a ti hasta they are at hombro level.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más alto, luego inhala and lentamente baja the mancuernas back down to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Curl de muñeca inverso con mancuerna
instructions: siéntate en banco with tus pies plano on el suelo and mantén a mancuerna in each hand, palmas hacia abajo.
Rest tus antebrazos on the banco, allowing tus muñecas to hang off the edge.
lentamente curl tus muñecas hacia arriba, bringing the mancuernas towards tu cuerpo.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más alto, luego lentamente baja the mancuernas back down to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Press inclinado con barra
instructions: Set up an incline banco at a 45-degree angle.
Lie down on the banco with tus pies plano on el suelo.
agarra the barra with an agarre en pronación, slightly wider than al ancho de hombros.
Unrack the barra and baja it lentamente towards tu pecho, manteniendo codos at a 45-degree angle.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más bajo, luego empuja the barra back up to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Curl en cuclillas con cable
instructions: Attach a cable handle to the lowest setting on a máquina de cable.
párate facing the machine with tus pies al ancho de hombros.
mantén the cable handle with an agarre en supinación, palmas hacia arriba, and arms completamente extended.
baja tu cuerpo into a squat posiciona, manteniendo back recto and rodillas detrás de tus toes.
As you squat down, curl the cable handle towards tus hombros, manteniendo codos close a tu lados.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más alto of the curl, squeezing tus bíceps.
lentamente baja the cable handle de vuelta a la posición inicial, completamente extending tus brazos.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Curl martillo en predicador un brazo
instructions: siéntate en preacher banco with a mancuerna in one hand and your upper arm resting on the pad.
mantén the mancuerna with a agarre neutro (palmas hacia tu cuerpo).
manteniendo upper arm stationary, exhala and curl the mancuerna up towards your hombro.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más alto, squeezing tus bíceps.
inhala and lentamente baja the mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas, luego switch arms.

name: Curl de pie agarre cerrado con barra
instructions: párate erguido with tus pies al ancho de hombros and mantén a barra with an agarre en supinación, hands close together.
mantén tus codos close to your torso and your la parte superior de los brazos stationary throughout the movement.
exhala as you curl the weights mientras contracting tus bíceps. Continue to eleva the bar hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the bar is at hombro level.
mantén the posición contraída for a brief haz una pausa as you aprieta tus bíceps.
inhala as you lentamente comienza to lleva the barra de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Sentadilla pistola con pesa rusa
instructions: párate con los pies al ancho de hombros, holding a pesa rusa frente a tir pecho with both hands.
levanta your left foot off el suelo and extiende it hacia adelante, keeping it paralelo to el suelo.
lentamente baja tu cuerpo down into a squat posiciona, manteniendo right foot plano on el suelo and your left leg extended.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más bajo of the squat, luego empuja through your right heel to regresa a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas, luego cambia de pierna.

name: Fondos imposibles
instructions: posiciona yourself between two paralelo bars with tus brazos completamente extended and tu cuerpo suspended in the air.
flexiona tus rodillas and cross tus tobillos.
baja tu cuerpo by bending tus codos hasta your la parte superior de los brazos are paralelo to el suelo.
haz una pausa for a moment, luego empuja yourself back up to the posición inicial by straightening tus brazos.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Extensión de tríceps sobre cabeza sentado con barra
instructions: siéntate en banco with tu espalda recto and feet plano on el suelo.
mantén a barra with an agarre en pronación, hands al ancho de hombros, and eleva it sobre la cabeza.
baja the barra detrás de tus head by bending tus codos, manteniendo la parte superior de los brazos close to tu cabeza.
haz una pausa for a moment, luego extiende tus brazos to eleva the barra de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Press inclinado en máquina Smith
instructions: ajusta the banco to a 30-45 degree incline.
siéntate en banco with tu espalda plano against the pad and feet firmly on el suelo.
agarra the barra with an agarre en pronación slightly wider than al ancho de hombros.
Unrack the barra and baja it lentamente towards your upper pecho, manteniendo codos slightly tucked in.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más bajo, luego empuja the barra back up to the posición inicial, completamente extending tus brazos.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Flexión lateral con peso en pelota
instructions: siéntate en stability ball with tus pies al ancho de hombros and plano on el suelo.
mantén a weight in one hand and coloca your other hand on your cadera.
activa tu core and lentamente flexiona sideways towards the weighted side, manteniendo back recto.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más bajo, luego lentamente regresa a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas, luego cambia de lado.

name: Remo vertical un brazo con mancuerna
instructions: párate con los pies al ancho de hombros, holding a mancuerna in one hand with an agarre en pronación.
Let the mancuerna hang at arm's length frente a tir muslos, with your palm facing tu cuerpo.
manteniendo back recto and tu core engaged, exhala and levanta the mancuerna recto up towards your chin, leading with your codo.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más alto, luego inhala and lentamente baja the mancuerna back down to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas, luego switch to el otro brazo.

name: Elevación de pantorrilla oscilante con barra
instructions: párate con los pies al ancho de hombros and mantén a barra across your la espalda alta.
eleva tus talones off el suelo lo más alto posible, balancing on the la parte delantera de tus pies.
lentamente baja tus talones back down to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Curl de muñeca con barra v.2
instructions: siéntate en banco with tus pies plano on el suelo and tus rodillas bent.
mantén a barra with an agarre en supinación, palmas hacia arriba, and tus manos al ancho de hombros.
Rest tus antebrazos on your muslos, allowing tus muñecas to hang off the edge.
lentamente curl tus muñecas hacia arriba, bringing the barra towards tus antebrazos.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más alto, luego lentamente baja the barra back down to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Extensión individual acostado con mancuerna
instructions: Lie plano on a banco with a mancuerna in one hand and your arm completamente extended sobre tus pecho.
baja the mancuerna de forma controlada towards your forehead, manteniendo upper arm stationary.
haz una pausa briefly en el punto más bajo del movimiento, luego extiende your arm de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas, luego switch arms.

name: Curl araña inverso con mancuernas
instructions: párate erguido with a mancuerna in each hand, palmas hacia tu cuerpo and arms completamente extended.
manteniendo la parte superior de los brazos stationary, exhala and curl the weights mientras contracting tus bíceps.
Continue to eleva the mancuernas hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level.
mantén the posición contraída for a brief haz una pausa as you aprieta tus bíceps.
inhala and lentamente comienza to baja the mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Giro acostado con rodillas flexionadas
instructions: Lie plano on tu espalda with tus rodillas bent and feet plano on el suelo.
extiende tus brazos out to the sides, perpendicular to tu cuerpo.
manteniendo rodillas together, lentamente baja them to one side, aiming to touch el suelo with tus rodillas.
haz una pausa for a moment, luego activa tu core and lentamente levanta tus rodillas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite the movement to the other side.
Continue alternando sides for the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Jalón frontal en palanca
instructions: ajusta the seat height and posiciona yourself on the machine with tus rodillas under the pads and tus pies plano on el suelo.
agarra the handles with an agarre en pronación, slightly wider than al ancho de hombros.
siéntate upright with tu pecho lifted and tus hombros back, maintaining una ligera curvatura in your la espalda baja.
activa tus dorsales and jala the handles down towards tu pecho, squeezing your hombro blades together.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más bajo del movimiento, luego lentamente release the handles de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Remo sentado en palanca
instructions: ajusta the seat height and footrests to a cómodo posiciona.
siéntate en machine with tu pecho against the pad and tus pies on the footrests.
agarra the handles with an agarre en pronación, al ancho de hombros.
mantén la espalda recta and tu core engaged.
jala the handles towards tu cuerpo, squeezing your hombro blades together.
haz una pausa for a moment at the peak of the movement.
lentamente release the handles and regresa a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Curl de concentración de pie con mancuerna
instructions: párate con los pies al ancho de hombros and mantén a mancuerna in one hand, with your arm completamente extended and palm facing inwards.
coloca your opposite hand on your muslo for support.
manteniendo upper arm stationary, exhala and curl the mancuerna towards your hombro by contracting tus bíceps.
Continue to eleva the mancuerna hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the mancuerna is at hombro level.
mantén the posición contraída for a brief haz una pausa as you aprieta tus bíceps.
inhala and lentamente baja the mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas, luego switch arms.

name: Apertura declinada con cable
instructions: ajusta the máquina de cable to a decline posiciona.
párate facing away from the machine with tus pies al ancho de hombros.
mantén the handles with your palmas hacia adelante and tus brazos extended recto out frente a ti.
Keeping una ligera flexión in tus codos, open tus brazos out to the sides in a controlado motion.
haz una pausa for a moment at the completamente extended posiciona, luego lentamente regresa a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Press de piernas en máquina Smith
instructions: ajusta the seat and footplate of the smith machine to a cómodo posiciona.
siéntate en machine with tu espalda against the backrest and tus pies al ancho de hombros on the footplate.
agarra the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
empuja the footplate away from you by extending tus piernas, manteniendo back against the backrest.
haz una pausa for a moment at the completamente extended posiciona.
lentamente flexiona tus rodillas and baja the footplate back towards you, returning to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Press inclinado agarre neutro con mancuernas
instructions: Set up an incline banco at a 45-degree angle.
siéntate en banco with tu espalda against the backrest and feet plano on el suelo.
mantén a mancuerna in each hand with an agarre en pronación, palmas hacia inwards.
extiende tus brazos recto up sobre tus pecho, keeping una ligera flexión in tus codos.
baja the mancuernas lentamente towards tus hombros, manteniendo codos close to tu cuerpo.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más bajo, luego presiona the mancuernas back up to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Curl sentado con cable
instructions: siéntate en máquina de cable with tus pies plano on el suelo and tu espalda recto.
agarra the cable attachment with an agarre en supinación, palmas hacia arriba, and tus brazos completamente extended.
manteniendo la parte superior de los brazos stationary, exhala and curl the cable attachment towards tus hombros, contracting tus bíceps.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más alto del movimiento, squeezing tus bíceps.
inhala and lentamente baja the cable attachment de vuelta a la posición inicial, completamente extending tus brazos.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Elevación de pantorrilla de pie con barra
instructions: párate con los pies al ancho de hombros and coloca a barra across your la espalda alta.
eleva tus talones off el suelo lo más alto posible, using only tus dedos del pie.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más alto, luego lentamente baja tus talones back down to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Hiperextensión con peso en pelota
instructions: posiciona yourself face down on a stability ball with tus caderas resting on the ball and tus pies against a wall for stability.
coloca tus manos detrás de tus head or cross them over tu pecho.
activa tu core and lentamente levanta your upper body off the ball, extending tu espalda hasta tu cuerpo forms a recto line.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más alto, luego lentamente baja your upper body back down to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Crunch sentado con cable
instructions: siéntate en máquina de cable with tus pies plano on el suelo and tus rodillas bent.
mantén the cable handle with both hands and posiciona it detrás de tus head.
activa tus abdominales and lentamente curl your upper body hacia adelante, bringing tu pecho towards tus rodillas.
haz una pausa for a moment en el punto más alto, luego lentamente regresa a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Press de banca con barra - Agarre medio
instructions: Lie back on a plano banco. Using a medium width agarra (a agarra that creates a ángulo de 90 grados in the middle of the movement between the antebrazos and the la parte superior de los brazos), levanta the bar from the rack and mantén it recto over you with tus brazos locked. esta es tu posición inicial.
From the posición inicial, inhala and comienza coming down lentamente hasta the bar touches your middle pecho.

después a brief haz una pausa, empuja the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhalas. Focus on pushing the bar using tu pecho muscles. Lock tus brazos and aprieta tu pecho in the posición contraída en el punto más alto of the motion, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente again. Consejo: Ideally, lowering the weight should take about twice as long as raising it.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, coloca the bar back in the rack.

name: Peso muerto con barra
instructions: párate in front of a loaded barra.

mientras manteniendo back as recto as possible, flexiona tus rodillas, flexiona hacia adelante and agarra the bar using a medium (al ancho de hombros) agarre en pronación. This will be the posición inicial of the exercise. Consejo: If it is difficult to mantén on to the bar with this agarra, alterna your agarra or use muñeca straps.

mientras holding the bar, comienza the levanta by pushing with tus piernas mientras simultáneamente getting your torso to the upright posiciona mientras exhalas. In the upright posiciona, stick tu pecho out and contrae the back by bringing the hombro blades back. Think of how the soldiers in the military look when they are in standing in attention.

Go de vuelta a la posición inicial by bending at the rodillas mientras simultáneamente leaning the torso hacia adelante at the waist mientras manteniendo back recto. When the weights on the bar touch el suelo you are back at the posición inicial and ready to realiza another repetition.
realiza the amount of repetitions prescribed in the program.

name: Sentadilla completa con barra
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To comienza, first set the bar on a rack just above hombro level. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, da un paso under the bar and coloca the back of tus hombros (slightly below the cuello) across it.
mantén on to the bar using both arms at each side and levanta it off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straightening your torso.

da un paso away from the rack and posiciona tus piernas using a al ancho de hombros medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. mantén tu cabeza up at all times and maintain a recto back. esta es tu posición inicial.

comienza to lentamente baja the bar by bending the rodillas and sitting back with tus caderas as you maintain a recto posture with the head up. Continue down hasta tus isquiotibiales are on tus pantorrillas. inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement.
comienza to eleva the bar as you exhala by pushing el suelo with the heel or middle of your foot as you straighten the legs and extiende the caderas to go de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Hack squat con barra
instructions: párate erguido mientras holding a barra detrás de ti at arms length and tus pies at al ancho de hombros. Consejo: A al ancho de hombros agarra is best with the palms of tus manos facing back. You can use muñeca wraps for this exercise for a better agarra. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras manteniendo head and eyes up and back recto, squat hasta your upper muslos are paralelo to el suelo. inhala as you lentamente go down.
Pressing mainly with the heel of the foot and squeezing the muslos, go back up mientras exhalas.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Press inclinado con barra - Agarre medio
instructions: Lie back on an incline banco. Using a medium-width agarra (a agarra that creates a ángulo de 90 grados in the middle of the movement between the antebrazos and the la parte superior de los brazos), levanta the bar from the rack and mantén it recto over you with tus brazos locked. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras inhalas, come down lentamente hasta que sientas the bar on you upper pecho.

después a second haz una pausa, lleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhalas and empuja the bar using tu pecho muscles. Lock tus brazos in the posición contraída, aprieta tu pecho, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente again. Consejo: it should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, coloca the bar back in the rack.

name: Zancada con barra
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To comienza, first set the bar on a rack just below hombro level. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, da un paso under the bar and coloca the back of tus hombros (slightly below the cuello) across it.
mantén on to the bar using both arms at each side and levanta it off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straightening your torso.

da un paso away from the rack and da un paso hacia adelante with your right leg and squat down through tus caderas, mientras manteniendo torso upright and maintaining balance. inhala as you go down. Nota: Do not allow your rodilla to go hacia adelante beyond tus dedos del pie as you come down, as this will put undue stress on the rodilla joint. li>
Using mainly the heel of your foot, empuja up and go de vuelta a la posición inicial as you exhala.
repite the movement for the número de repeticiones recomendadas and luego realiza with the left leg.

name: Press de hombros con barra
instructions: siéntate en banco with back support in a squat rack. posiciona a barra at a height that is just sobre tus head. agarra la barrabell with a agarre en pronación (palmas hacia adelante).

Once you agarra up the barra with the correct agarra width, levanta the bar up over tu cabeza by locking tus brazos. mantén at about hombro level and slightly frente a tir head. esta es tu posición inicial.
baja the bar down to the hombros lentamente as you inhala.
levanta the bar back up to the posición inicial as you exhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Sentadilla con barra
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To comienza, first set the bar on a rack to just below hombro level. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, da un paso under the bar and coloca the back of tus hombros (slightly below the cuello) across it.
mantén on to the bar using both arms at each side and levanta it off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straightening your torso.

da un paso away from the rack and posiciona tus piernas using a al ancho de hombros medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. mantén tu cabeza up at all times and also maintain a recto back. esta es tu posición inicial. (Nota: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section).

comienza to lentamente baja the bar by bending the rodillas and caderas as you maintain a recto posture with the head up. Continue down hasta the angle between the upper leg and the pantorrillas becomes slightly less than 90-degrees. inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the rodillas should make an imaginary recto line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If tus rodillas are past that imaginary line (if they are past tus dedos del pie) luego you are placing undue stress on the rodilla and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
comienza to eleva the bar as you exhala by pushing el suelo with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Zancada caminando con barra
instructions: comienza standing with tus pies al ancho de hombros and a barra across your la espalda alta.

da un paso hacia adelante with one leg, flexing the rodillas to baja tus caderas. Descend hasta your rear rodilla nearly touches el suelo. Your posture should remain upright, and your front rodilla should stay above the front foot.
Drive through the heel of your lead foot and extiende both rodillas to eleva yourself back up.
da un paso hacia adelante with your rear foot, repeating the lunge on the opposite leg.

name: Fondos en banco
instructions: For this exercise you will need to coloca a banco detrás de tus back. With the banco perpendicular to tu cuerpo, and mientras looking away from it, mantén on to the banco on its edge with the hands completamente extended, separated at al ancho de hombros. The legs will be extended hacia adelante, bent at the waist and perpendicular to your torso. esta es tu posición inicial.

lentamente baja tu cuerpo as you inhala by bending at the codos hasta you baja yourself far enough to where there is an angle slightly smaller than 90 degrees between the upper arm and the antebrazo. Consejo: mantén the codos as close as possible throughout the movement. antebrazos should always be pointing down.
Using tus tríceps to lleva your torso up again, levanta yourself de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Remo inclinado con barra
instructions: Holding a barra with a agarre en pronación (palmas hacia abajo), flexiona tus rodillas slightly and lleva your torso hacia adelante, by bending at the waist, mientras manteniendo back recto hasta it is almost paralelo to el suelo. Consejo: asegúrate de that you mantén the head up. The barra should hang directly frente a ti as tus brazos hang perpendicular to el suelo and your torso. esta es tu posición inicial.

Now, mientras manteniendo torso stationary, exhala and levanta the barra to you. mantén the codos close to the body and only use the antebrazos to mantén the weight. en el punto más alto posición contraída, aprieta the back muscles and mantén durante a brief haz una pausa.
luego inhala and lentamente baja the barra de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Sentadilla con peso corporal
instructions: párate con los pies al ancho de hombros. You can coloca tus manos detrás de tus head. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza the movement by flexing tus rodillas and caderas, sitting back with tus caderas.
Continue down to full depth if you are able,and rápidamente reverse the motion hasta you regresa a la posición inicial. As you squat, mantén tu cabeza and pecho up and empuja tus rodillas out.

name: Dominada supina
instructions: Grab the jala-up bar with the palmas hacia your torso and a agarra closer than the al ancho de hombros.

As you have both arms extended frente a ti holding the bar at the chosen agarra width, mantén your torso as recto as possible mientras creating a curvature on your la espalda baja and sticking tu pecho out. esta es tu posición inicial. Consejo: manteniendo torso as recto as possible maximizes bíceps stimulation mientras minimizing back involvement.

mientras exhalas, jala your torso up hasta tu cabeza is around the level of the jala-up bar. Concentrate on using the bíceps muscles para realiza the movement. mantén the codos close to tu cuerpo. Consejo: The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The antebrazos should do no other work other than mantén the bar.

después a second of squeezing the bíceps in the posición contraída, lentamente baja your torso de vuelta a la posición inicial; when tus brazos are completamente extended. inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement.
repite this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Press de banca agarre cerrado con barra
instructions: Lie back on a plano banco. Using a close agarra (around al ancho de hombros), levanta the bar from the rack and mantén it recto over you with tus brazos locked. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras inhalas, come down lentamente hasta que sientas the bar on your middle pecho. Consejo: asegúrate de that - as opposed to a regular banco presiona - you mantén the codos close to the torso at all times para maximize tríceps involvement.

después a second haz una pausa, lleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhalas and empuja the bar using tus tríceps muscles. Lock tus brazos in the posición contraída, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente again. Consejo: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, coloca the bar back in the rack.

name: Press declinado con barra
instructions: Secure tus piernas at the end of the decline banco and lentamente lay down on the banco.

Using a medium width agarra (a agarra that creates a ángulo de 90 grados in the middle of the movement between the antebrazos and the la parte superior de los brazos), levanta the bar from the rack and mantén it recto over you with tus brazos locked. The arms should be perpendicular to el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial. Consejo: para protect your rotator cuff, it is best if you have a spotter help you levanta the barra off the rack.
mientras inhalas, come down lentamente hasta que sientas the bar on your baja pecho.

después a second haz una pausa, lleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhalas and empuja the bar using tu pecho muscles. Lock tus brazos and aprieta tu pecho in the posición contraída, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente again. Consejo: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up).
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, coloca the bar back in the rack.

name: Press declinado con mancuernas
instructions: Secure tus piernas at the end of the decline banco and lie down with a mancuerna on each hand on top of your muslos. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.
Once you are laying down, move the mancuernas frente a ti at al ancho de hombros.
Once at al ancho de hombros, rota tus muñecas hacia adelante so that the palms of tus manos are facing away from you. esta es tu posición inicial.

lleva down the weights lentamente a tu lado mientras exhalas. mantén full control of the mancuernas at all times. Consejo: Throughout the motion, the antebrazos should always be perpendicular to el suelo.

mientras exhalas, empuja the mancuernas up using your pectoral muscles. Lock tus brazos in the posición contraída, aprieta tu pecho, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente. Consejo: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up..
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.

name: Press de banca con mancuernas
instructions: Lie down on a plano banco with a mancuerna in each hand resting on top of your muslos. The palms of tus manos will be facing each other.
luego, using your muslos to help eleva the mancuernas up, levanta the mancuernas one at a time so that you can mantén them frente a ti at al ancho de hombros.

Once at al ancho de hombros, rota tus muñecas hacia adelante so that the palms of tus manos are facing away from you. The mancuernas should be just to the sides of tu pecho, with your upper arm and antebrazo creating a ángulo de 90 grados. Be sure to maintain full control of the mancuernas at all times. esta es tu posición inicial.

luego, mientras exhalas, use tu pecho to empuja the mancuernas up. Lock tus brazos en el punto más alto of the levanta and aprieta tu pecho, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente. Consejo: Ideally, lowering the weight should take about twice as long as raising it.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.

name: Press de banca agarre neutro con mancuernas
instructions: Take a mancuerna in each hand and lay back onto a plano banco. tus pies should be plano on el suelo and your hombro blades retracted.
Maintaining a agarre neutro, palmas enfrentadas, comienza with tus brazos extended directly sobre ti, perpendicular to el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza the movement by flexing the codo, lowering the la parte superior de los brazos to the side. Descend hasta the mancuernas are to your torso.
haz una pausa, luego extiende the codo and regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Zancadas con mancuernas
instructions: párate con torso upright holding two mancuernas in tus manos by your sides. esta es tu posición inicial.

da un paso hacia adelante with your right leg around 2 feet or so from the foot being left stationary behind and baja your upper body down, mientras manteniendo torso upright and maintaining balance. inhala as you go down. Nota: As in the other exercises, do not allow your rodilla to go hacia adelante beyond tus dedos del pie as you come down, as this will put undue stress on the rodilla joint. asegúrate de that you mantén your front espinilla perpendicular to el suelo.
Using mainly the heel of your foot, empuja up and go de vuelta a la posición inicial as you exhala.
repite the movement for the número de repeticiones recomendadas and luego realiza with the left leg.

name: Press de hombros un brazo con mancuerna
instructions: Grab a mancuerna and either siéntate en military presiona banco or a utility banco that has a back support on it as you coloca the mancuernas upright on top of your muslos or párate erguido.
Clean the mancuerna up to lleva it to hombro height. The other hand can be kept completamente extended to the side, by the waist or grabbing a fixed surface.
rota the muñeca so that the palm of your hand is facing hacia adelante. esta es tu posición inicial.
As you exhala, empuja the mancuerna up hasta your arm is completamente extended.
después a second haz una pausa, lentamente come down de vuelta a la posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas and luego switch arms.

name: Zancada trasera con mancuernas
instructions: párate con torso upright holding two mancuernas in tus manos by your sides. esta es tu posición inicial.

da un paso hacia atrás with your right leg around two feet or so from the left foot and baja your upper body down, mientras manteniendo torso upright and maintaining balance. inhala as you go down. Consejo: As in the other exercises, do not allow your rodilla to go hacia adelante beyond tus dedos del pie as you come down, as this will put undue stress on the rodilla joint. asegúrate de that you mantén your front espinilla perpendicular to el suelo. mantén the torso upright durante the lunge; flexible flexores de cadera are important. A long lunge emphasizes the Gluteus Maximus; a short lunge emphasizes cuádriceps.
empuja up and go de vuelta a la posición inicial as you exhala. Consejo: Use the ball of tus pies to empuja para accentuate the cuádriceps. To focus on the glúteos, presiona with tus talones.
Now repite with the opposite leg.

name: Press de hombros con mancuernas
instructions: mientras holding a mancuerna in each hand, siéntate en military presiona banco or utility banco that has back support. coloca the mancuernas upright on top of your muslos.
Now eleva the mancuernas to hombro height one at a time using your muslos to help propel them up into posiciona.
asegúrate de to rota tus muñecas so that the palms of tus manos are facing hacia adelante. esta es tu posición inicial.
Now, exhala and empuja the mancuernas hacia arriba hasta they touch en el punto más alto.
luego, después a brief haz una pausa en el punto más alto posición contraída, lentamente baja el pesos back down to the posición inicial mientras inhaling.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Sentadilla con mancuernas
instructions: párate erguido mientras holding a mancuerna on each hand (palmas hacia the side of tus piernas).

posiciona tus piernas using a al ancho de hombros medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. mantén tu cabeza up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a recto back. esta es tu posición inicial. Nota: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section.

comienza to lentamente baja your torso by bending the rodillas as you maintain a recto posture with the head up. Continue down hasta your muslos are paralelo to el suelo. Consejo: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the rodillas should make an imaginary recto line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If tus rodillas are past that imaginary line (if they are past tus dedos del pie) luego you are placing undue stress on the rodilla and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
comienza to eleva your torso as you exhala by pushing el suelo with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Zancada trasera elevada
instructions: posiciona a bar onto a rack at hombro height loaded to an appropriate weight. coloca a short, raised plataforma detrás de ti.
Rack the bar onto your la espalda alta, manteniendo back arched and firme. da un paso onto your raised plataforma with both feet. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza by stepping backwards with one leg. Descend by flexing tus caderas and rodillas hasta your rodilla touches el suelo.
haz una pausa, and extiende through the caderas and rodillas to rise up, returning all the way to the posición inicial antes alternando.

name: Sentadilla con salto sin peso
instructions: Cross tus brazos over tu pecho.
With tu cabeza up and tu espalda recto, posiciona tus pies at al ancho de hombros.
manteniendo back recto and pecho up, squat down as you inhala hasta your upper muslos are paralelo, or baja, to el suelo.
Now pressing mainly with the ball of tus pies, salta recto up in the air lo más alto posible, using the muslos like springs. exhala durante this portion of the movement.
When you touch el suelo again, immediately squat down and salta again.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Sentadilla frontal con barra
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To comienza, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, lleva tus brazos up under the bar mientras manteniendo codos high and the upper arm slightly above paralelo to el suelo. Rest the bar on top of the deltoids and cross tus brazos mientras grasping the bar for total control.
levanta the bar off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straightening your torso.

da un paso away from the rack and posiciona tus piernas using a al ancho de hombros medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. mantén tu cabeza up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a recto back. esta es tu posición inicial. (Nota: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

comienza to lentamente baja the bar by bending the rodillas as you maintain a recto posture with the head up. Continue down hasta the angle between the upper leg and the pantorrillas becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below paralelo to el suelo). inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the rodillas should make an imaginary recto line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If tus rodillas are past that imaginary line (if they are past tus dedos del pie) luego you are placing undue stress on the rodilla and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
comienza to eleva the bar as you exhala by pushing el suelo mainly with the middle of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Sentadilla frontal (agarre limpio)
instructions: To comienza, first set the bar in a rack slightly below hombro level. Rest the bar on top of the deltoids, pushing into the clavicles, and lightly touching the throat. tus manos should be in a clean agarra, touching the bar only with your fingers to help mantén it in posiciona.

levanta the bar off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straightening your torso. da un paso away from the rack and posiciona tus piernas using a al ancho de hombros medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. mantén tu cabeza and codos up at all times. esta es tu posición inicial.

flexiona at the rodillas, sitting down between tus piernas. Continue down hasta tus isquiotibiales are on tus pantorrillas. mantén tus rodillas aligned with tus pies by consciously using your abductors to empuja tus rodillas out as you squat.
comienza to eleva the bar as you exhala by pushing el suelo mainly with the heel or middle of your foot as you straighten the legs again and regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Press inclinado agarre martillo con mancuernas
instructions: Lie back on an incline banco with a mancuerna on each hand on top of your muslos. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.
By using your muslos to help you get the mancuernas up, clean the mancuernas one arm at a time so that you can mantén them at al ancho de hombros.

Once at al ancho de hombros, mantén the palms of tus manos with a agarre neutro (palmas enfrentadas). mantén tus codos flared out with the la parte superior de los brazos in line with the hombros (perpendicular to the torso) and the codos bent creating a ángulo de 90 grados between the upper arm and the antebrazo. esta es tu posición inicial.
Now lleva down the weights lentamente a tu lado mientras inhalas. mantén full control of the mancuernas at all times.

mientras exhalas, empuja the mancuernas up using your pectoral muscles. Lock tus brazos in the posición contraída, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente. Consejo: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, coloca the mancuernas back in your muslos and luego on el suelo. This is the safest manner to dispose of the mancuernas.

name: Flexiones en parada de manos
instructions: With tu espalda to la pared flexiona at the waist and coloca both hands on el suelo at al ancho de hombros.

patea yourself up against la pared with tus brazos recto. tu cuerpo should be upside down with the arms and legs completamente extended. mantén your whole body as recto as possible. Consejo: If doing this for the first time, have a spotter help you. Also, asegúrate de that you mantén facing la pared with tu cabeza, rather than looking down.
lentamente baja yourself to el suelo as you inhala hasta tu cabeza almost touches el suelo. Consejo: It is of utmost importance that you come down lento para avoid head injury.
empuja yourself back up lentamente as you exhala hasta tus codos are nearly locked.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Flexión inclinada
instructions: párate facing banco or sturdy elevated plataforma. coloca hands on edge of banco or plataforma, slightly wider than al ancho de hombros.
posiciona forefoot back from banco or plataforma with arms and body recto. Arms should be perpendicular to body. Keeping body recto, baja pecho to edge of box or plataforma by bending arms.
empuja body up hasta arms are extended. repite.

name: Sentadilla con piernas juntas
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To comienza, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, da un paso under the bar and coloca the back of tus hombros (slightly below the cuello) across it.
mantén on to the bar using both arms at each side and levanta it off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straightening your torso.

da un paso away from the rack and posiciona tus piernas using a less-than-al ancho de hombros narrow stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Feet should be around 3-6 inches apart. mantén tu cabeza up at all times (looking down will get you off balance) and maintain a recto back. esta es tu posición inicial. (Nota: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section).

comienza to lentamente baja the bar by bending the rodillas as you maintain a recto posture with the head up. Continue down hasta the angle between the upper leg and the pantorrillas becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below paralelo to el suelo). inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the rodillas should make an imaginary recto line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If tus rodillas are past that imaginary line (if they are past tus dedos del pie) luego you are placing undue stress on the rodilla and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
comienza to eleva the bar as you exhala by pushing el suelo with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Press de banca un brazo con mancuerna
instructions: Lie down on a plano banco with a mancuerna in one hand on top of your muslo.

By using your muslo to help you get the mancuerna up, clean the mancuerna up so that you can mantén it frente a ti at al ancho de hombros. Use the hand you are not lifting with to help posiciona the mancuerna over you correctamente.
Once at al ancho de hombros, rota your muñeca hacia adelante so that the palm of your hand is facing away from you. esta es tu posición inicial.

lleva down the weights lentamente a tu lado mientras inhalas. mantén full control of the mancuerna at all times. Consejo: Use the hand that you are not lifting with to help mantén the mancuerna balance as you may struggle a bit at first. Only use your non-lifting hand if it is needed. Otherwise, mantén it resting to the side.

mientras exhalas, empuja the mancuernas up using your pectoral muscles. Lock tus brazos in the posición contraída, aprieta tu pecho, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente. Consejo: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
Switch arms and repite the movement.

name: Sentadilla una pierna con barra
instructions: comienza by standing about 2 to 3 feet in front of a plano banco with tu espalda facing the banco. Have a barra frente a ti on el suelo. Consejo: tus pies should be al ancho de hombros from each other.
flexiona the rodillas and use a agarre en pronación with tus manos being wider than al ancho de hombros from each other to levanta the barra up hasta you can rest it on tu pecho.

luego levanta the barra over tu cabeza and rest it on the base of tu cuello. Move one foot back so that your toe is resting on the plano banco. Your other foot should be stationary frente a ti. mantén tu cabeza up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a recto back. Consejo: asegúrate de tu espalda is recto and pecho is out mientras performing this exercise.

As you inhala, lentamente baja your leg hasta your muslo is paralelo to el suelo. At this point, your rodilla should be over tus dedos del pie. tu pecho should be directly above the middle of your muslo.
Leading with the pecho and caderas and contracting the cuádriceps, elevate your leg de vuelta a la posición inicial as you exhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.
cambia de pierna and repite the movement.

name: Sentadilla plie con mancuerna
instructions: mantén a mancuerna at the base with both hands and párate recto up. Move tus piernas so that they are wider than al ancho de hombros from each other with tus rodillas ligeramente flexionados.
tus dedos del pie should be facing out. Nota: tus brazos should be stationary mientras performing the exercise. This is the posición inicial.
lentamente flexiona the rodillas and baja tus piernas hasta your muslos are paralelo to el suelo. asegúrate de to inhala as this is the eccentric part of the exercise.
presiona mainly with the heel of the foot to lleva the body de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhaling.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Flexión agarre ancho
instructions: With tus manos amplio apart, support tu cuerpo on tus dedos del pie and hands in a plank posiciona. tus codos should be extended and tu cuerpo recto. Do not allow tus caderas to sag. esta es tu posición inicial.
To comienza, allow the codos to flexiona, lowering tu pecho to el suelo as you inhala.
Using your pectoral muscles, presiona your upper body back up to the posición inicial by extending the codos. exhala as you realiza this da un paso.
después pausing at the posición contraída, repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Flexiones posición cerrada para tríceps
instructions: acuéstate en floor face down and coloca tus manos closer than al ancho de hombros for a close hand posiciona. asegúrate de that you are holding your torso up at arms' length.
baja yourself hasta tu pecho almost touches el suelo as you inhala.
Using tus tríceps and some of your pectoral muscles, presiona your upper body back up to the posición inicial and aprieta tu pecho. exhala as you realiza this da un paso.
después a second haz una pausa at the posición contraída, repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Flexiones con pies elevados
instructions: acuéstate en floor face down and coloca tus manos about 36 inches apart from each other holding your torso up at arms length.
coloca tus dedos del pie on top of a plano banco. This will allow tu cuerpo to be elevated. Nota: The higher the elevation of the plano banco, the higher the resistance of the exercise is.
baja yourself hasta tu pecho almost touches el suelo as you inhala.
Using your pectoral muscles, presiona your upper body back up to the posición inicial and aprieta tu pecho. exhala as you realiza this da un paso.
después a second haz una pausa at the posición contraída, repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Flexiones
instructions: acuéstate en floor face down and coloca tus manos about 36 inches apart mientras holding your torso up at arms length.
Next, baja yourself hacia abajo hasta tu pecho almost touches el suelo as you inhala.
Now exhala and presiona your upper body back up to the posición inicial mientras squeezing tu pecho.
después a brief haz una pausa en el punto más alto posición contraída, you can comienza to baja yourself hacia abajo again for as many repetitions as needed.

name: Peso muerto rumano
instructions: Put a barra frente a ti on el suelo and grab it using a pronated (palmas hacia abajo) agarra that a little wider than al ancho de hombros. Consejo: Depending on the weight used, you may need muñeca wraps to realiza the exercise and also a raised plataforma para allow for better rango de movimiento.
flexiona the rodillas slightly and mantén the espinillas vertical, caderas back and back recto. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo back and arms completely recto at all times, use tus caderas to levanta the bar as you exhala. Consejo: The movement should not be rápido but estable and de forma controlada.

Once you are standing completely recto up, baja the bar by pushing the caderas back, only slightly bending the rodillas, unlike when squatting. Consejo: Take a deep breath at the comienza of the movement and mantén tu pecho up. mantén your breath as you baja and exhala as you completa the movement.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Press militar sentado con barra
instructions: siéntate en Military presiona banco with a bar detrás de tus head and either have a spotter give you the bar (better on the rotator cuff this way) or agarra it up yourself carefully with a agarre en pronación (palmas hacia adelante). Consejo: Your agarra should be wider than al ancho de hombros and it should create a ángulo de 90 grados between the antebrazo and the upper arm as the barra goes down.

Once you agarra up the barra with the correct agarra length, levanta the bar up over tu cabeza by locking tus brazos. mantén at about hombro level and slightly frente a tir head. esta es tu posición inicial.
baja the bar down to the collarbone lentamente as you inhala.
levanta the bar back up to the posición inicial as you exhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Flexión un brazo
instructions: comienza laying prone on el suelo. Move yourself into a posiciona supporting your weight on tus dedos del pie and one arm. Your working arm should be placed directly under the hombro, completamente extended. tus piernas should be extended, and for this movement you may need a wider base, placing tus pies further apart than in a normal empuja-up.
Maintain good posture, and coloca your free hand detrás de tus back. esta es tu posición inicial.
baja yourself by allowing the codo to flexiona hasta you touch el suelo.
Descend lentamente, and reverse direction be extending the arm to regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Sentadillas explosivas
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To comienza, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, da un paso under the bar and coloca the back of tus hombros (slightly below the cuello) across it.
mantén on to the bar using both arms at each side and levanta it off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straightening your torso.

da un paso away from the rack and posiciona tus piernas using a al ancho de hombros medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. mantén tu cabeza up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a recto back. esta es tu posición inicial. (Nota: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section).

comienza to baja the bar by bending the rodillas as you maintain a recto posture with the head up. Continue down hasta the angle between the upper leg and the pantorrillas becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below paralelo to el suelo). inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the rodillas should make an imaginary recto line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If tus rodillas are past that imaginary line (if they are past tus dedos del pie) luego you are placing undue stress on the rodilla and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.

comienza to eleva the bar as rápido as possible sin involving momentum as you exhala by pushing el suelo with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go de vuelta a la posición inicial. Nota: You should realiza these exercises as rápido as possible but sin breaking perfect form and sin involving momentum.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Sentadilla dividida con mancuernas
instructions: posiciona yourself into a staggered stance with the rear foot elevated and front foot hacia adelante.
mantén a mancuerna in each hand, letting them hang at the sides. esta es tu posición inicial.

comienza by descending, flexing your rodilla and cadera to baja tu cuerpo down. Maintain good posture througout the movement. mantén the front rodilla in line with the foot as you realiza the exercise.
en el punto más bajo del movimiento, drive through the heel to extiende the rodilla and cadera to regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Sentadilla-jerk
instructions: Standing with the weight racked on the front of the hombros, comienza with the dip. With tus pies directly under tus caderas, flexiona the rodillas sin moving the caderas hacia atrás. Go down only slightly, and reverse direction as powerfully as possible. Drive through the heels create as much speed and force as possible, and be sure to move tu cabeza out of the way as the bar leaves the hombros.

At this moment as the feet leave el suelo, the feet must be placed into the receiving posiciona as rápidamente as possible. In the brief moment the feet are not actively driving against the plataforma, the athlete's effort to empuja the bar up will drive them down. The feet should move forcefully to just outside the caderas, turned out as necessary. Receive the bar with tu cuerpo in a full squat and the arms completamente extended sobre la cabeza.
manteniendo bar aligned over the front of the heels, tu cabeza and pecho up, drive throught heels of the feet to move to a standing posiciona. Carefully regresa the weight to floor.

name: Sentadilla con discos
instructions: To comienza, first set the bar on a rack to just below hombro level. posiciona a weight plate on el suelo a couple feet back from the rack. Once the bar is loaded, da un paso under it and coloca the back of tus hombros across it.
mantén on to the bar with both hands and levanta it off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straighten your torso.
da un paso away from the rack and adopt a amplio stance with the toes slightly pointed out, with one foot on the weight plate. mantén tu cabeza up at all times. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza to lentamente baja the bar by bending the rodillas and caderas. Continue down hasta the angle between the upper leg and the pantorrillas becomes slightly less than 90-degrees.
eleva the bar as you exhala by pushing el suelo with the heels of tus pies as you extiende the caderas and rodillas.
en el punto más alto del movimiento, side da un paso, bringing tus pies together on the opposite side of the plate.
Using your inside foot, empuja the weight plate, sliding it across el suelo to where you were just standing.
coloca your inside foot on the weight plate, adopting a amplio stance for the next repetition.

name: Press militar de pie
instructions: comienza by placing a barra that is about pecho high on a squat rack. Once you have selected the weights, agarra la barrabell using a pronated (palmas hacia adelante) agarra. asegúrate de to agarra la barra wider than al ancho de hombros from each other.

Slightly flexiona the rodillas and coloca the barra on your collar bone. levanta the barra up keeping it lying on tu pecho. Take a da un paso back and posiciona tus pies al ancho de hombros from each other.

Once you agarra up the barra with the correct agarra length, levanta the bar up over tu cabeza by locking tus brazos. mantén at about hombro level and slightly frente a tir head. esta es tu posición inicial.
baja the bar down to the collarbone lentamente as you inhala.
levanta the bar back up to the posición inicial as you exhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Peso muerto piernas rígidas con barra
instructions: agarra a bar using an agarre en pronación (palmas hacia abajo). You may need some muñeca wraps if using a significant amount of weight.
párate con torso recto and tus piernas spaced using a al ancho de hombros or narrower stance. The rodillas should be ligeramente flexionados. esta es tu posición inicial.

manteniendo rodillas stationary, baja the barra to over the top of tus pies by bending at the caderas mientras manteniendo back recto. mantén moving hacia adelante as if you were going to agarra something from el suelo hasta you siente el estiramiento on the isquiotibiales. inhala as you realiza this movement.
comienza bringing your torso up recto again by extending tus caderas hasta you are back at the posición inicial. exhala as you realiza this movement.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Peso muerto piernas rígidas con mancuernas
instructions: agarra a couple of mancuernas holding them by your side at arm's length.
párate con torso recto and tus piernas spaced using a al ancho de hombros or narrower stance. The rodillas should be ligeramente flexionados. esta es tu posición inicial.

manteniendo rodillas stationary, baja the mancuernas to over the top of tus pies by bending at the waist mientras manteniendo back recto. mantén moving hacia adelante as if you were going to agarra something from el suelo hasta you siente el estiramiento on the isquiotibiales. exhala as you realiza this movement
comienza bringing your torso up recto again by extending tus caderas and waist hasta you are back at the posición inicial. inhala as you realiza this movement.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Remo vertical con barra
instructions: agarra a barra with an agarre en pronación that is slightly less than al ancho de hombros. The bar should be resting on the top of your muslos with tus brazos extended and una ligera flexión in tus codos. tu espalda should also be recto. esta es tu posición inicial.

Now exhala and use the sides of tus hombros to levanta the bar, raising tus codos up and to the side. mantén the bar close to tu cuerpo as you eleva it. Continue to levanta the bar hasta it nearly touches your chin. Consejo: tus codos should drive the motion, and should always be higher than tus antebrazos. Remember to mantén your torso stationary and haz una pausa for a second en el punto más alto del movimiento.
baja the bar back down lentamente to the posición inicial. inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Sentadilla con salto y peso
instructions: posiciona a lightly loaded barra across the back of tus hombros. You could also use a weighted vest, sandbag, or other type of resistance for this exercise.
The weight should be ligero enough that it doesn't lento you down significantly. tus pies should be just outside of al ancho de hombros with tu cabeza and pecho up. esta es tu posición inicial.

Using a countermovement, squat partially down and immediately reverse your direction to explode off of el suelo, extending through tus caderas, rodillas, and tobillos. Maintain good posture throughout the salta.
As you regresa to el suelo, absorb the impact through tus piernas.

name: Sentadilla sissy con peso
instructions: Standing upright, with feet at al ancho de hombros and toes raised, use one hand to mantén onto the beams of a squat rack and the opposite arm to mantén a plate on top of tu pecho. esta es tu posición inicial.

As you use one arm to mantén yourself, flexiona at the rodillas and lentamente baja your torso toward el suelo by bringing your pelvis and rodillas hacia adelante. inhala as you go down and stop when your superior e inferior legs almost create a ángulo de 90 grados. mantén the stretch posiciona for a second.
después your one second mantén, use your muslo muscles to lleva your torso back up to the posición inicial. exhala as you move up.
repite durante las repeticiones recomendadas amount of times.

name: Press de banca agarre ancho con barra
instructions: Lie back on a plano banco with feet firme on el suelo. Using a amplio, pronated (palms hacia adelante) agarra that is around 3 inches away from al ancho de hombros (for each hand), levanta the bar from the rack and mantén it recto over you with tus brazos locked. The bar will be perpendicular to the torso and el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras inhalas, come down lentamente hasta que sientas the bar on your middle pecho.

después a second haz una pausa, lleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhalas and empuja the bar using tu pecho muscles. Lock tus brazos and aprieta tu pecho in the posición contraída, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente again. Consejo: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Press declinado agarre ancho con barra
instructions: Lie back on a decline banco with the feet securely locked at the front of the banco. Using a amplio, pronated (palms hacia adelante) agarra that is around 3 inches away from al ancho de hombros (for each hand), levanta the bar from the rack and mantén it recto over you with tus brazos locked. The bar will be perpendicular to the torso and el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras inhalas, come down lentamente hasta que sientas the bar on your baja pecho.

después a second haz una pausa, lleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhalas and empuja the bar using tu pecho muscles. Lock tus brazos and aprieta tu pecho in the posición contraída, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente again. Consejo: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Dominada trasera agarre ancho
instructions: Grab the jala-up bar with the palmas hacia adelante using a amplio agarra.

As you have both arms extended frente a ti holding the bar, lleva your torso hacia adelante and head so that there is an imaginary line from the jala-up bar to the back of tu cuello. esta es tu posición inicial.

jala your torso up hasta the bar is near the back of tu cuello. To do this, draw the hombros and la parte superior de los brazos down and back mientras slightly leaning tu cabeza hacia adelante. exhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full posición contraída. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The antebrazos should do no other work other than mantén the bar.

después a second on the posición contraída, comienza to inhala and lentamente baja your torso de vuelta a la posición inicial when tus brazos are completamente extended and the dorsales are completamente stretched.
repite this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Sentadilla sumo con barra
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To comienza, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, da un paso under the bar and coloca the back of tus hombros (slightly below the cuello) across it.
mantén on to the bar using both arms at each side and levanta it off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straightening your torso.

da un paso away from the rack and posiciona tus piernas using a wider-than-al ancho de hombros stance with the toes slightly pointed out. mantén tu cabeza up at all times as looking down will get you off balance, and also maintain a recto back. esta es tu posición inicial.

comienza to lentamente baja the bar by bending the rodillas as you maintain a recto posture with the head up. Continue down hasta the angle between the upper leg and the pantorrillas becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below paralelo to el suelo). inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the rodillas should make an imaginary recto line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If tus rodillas are past that imaginary line (if they are past tus dedos del pie) luego you are placing undue stress on the rodilla and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
comienza to eleva the bar as you exhala by pushing el suelo with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Sentadilla Zercher
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To comienza, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. The correct height should be anywhere above the waist but below the pecho. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, lock tus manos together and coloca the bar on top of tus brazos in between the antebrazo and upper arm.
levanta the bar up so that it is resting on top of tus antebrazos. If you are holding the bar correctamente, it should look as if you have tus brazos crossed but with a bar running across them.

da un paso away from the rack and posiciona tus piernas using a al ancho de hombros medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. mantén tu cabeza up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a recto back. esta es tu posición inicial. (Nota: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section).

comienza to baja the bar by bending the rodillas as you maintain a recto posture with the head up. Continue down hasta the angle between the upper leg and the pantorrillas becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below paralelo to el suelo). inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the rodillas should make an imaginary recto line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If tus rodillas are past that imaginary line (if they are past tus dedos del pie) luego you are placing undue stress on the rodilla and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
comienza to eleva the bar as you exhala by pushing el suelo with the ball of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Press de hombros alternado con cable
instructions: Move the cables to the bottom of the tower and select an appropriate weight.
agarra the cables and mantén them at hombro height, palmas hacia adelante. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo head and pecho up, extiende through the codo to presiona one side directly over head.
después pausing en el punto más alto, regresa a la posición inicial and repite on the opposite side.

name: Peso muerto con cable
instructions: Move the cables to the bottom of the towers and select an appropriate weight. párate directly in between the uprights.
To comienza, squat down be flexing tus caderas and rodillas hasta you can reach the handles.

después grasping them, comienza your ascent. Driving through tus talones extiende tus caderas and rodillas manteniendo hands hanging a tu costado. mantén tu cabeza and pecho up throughout the movement.
después reaching a full standing posiciona, regresa a la posición inicial and repite.

name: Press de hombros con cable
instructions: Move the cables to the bottom of the towers and select an appropriate weight.
párate directly in between the uprights. agarra the cables and mantén them at hombro height, palmas hacia adelante. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo head and pecho up, extiende through the codo to presiona the handles directly over head.
después pausing en el punto más alto, regresa a la posición inicial and repite.

name: Jalón al pecho agarre cerrado
instructions: siéntate down on a jala-down machine with a amplio bar attached to the top pulley. asegúrate de that you ajusta the rodilla pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent tu cuerpo from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.

agarra la barra with the palmas hacia adelante using the prescribed agarra. Note on grips: For a amplio agarra, tus manos need to be spaced out at a distance wider than your al ancho de hombros. For a medium agarra, tus manos need to be spaced out at a distance equal to your al ancho de hombros and for a close agarra at a distance smaller than your al ancho de hombros.

As you have both arms extended frente a ti - mientras holding the bar at the chosen agarra width - lleva your torso back around 30 degrees or so mientras creating a curvature on your la espalda baja and sticking tu pecho out. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras exhalas, lleva the bar down hasta it touches your upper pecho by drawing the hombros and the la parte superior de los brazos down and back. Consejo: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full posición contraída. The upper torso should remain stationary (only the arms should move). The antebrazos should do no other work except for holding the bar; therefore do not try to jala the bar down using the antebrazos.

después a second in the posición contraída, mientras squeezing your hombro blades together, lentamente eleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial when tus brazos are completamente extended and the dorsales are completamente stretched. inhala durante this portion of the movement.
6. repite this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Face pull con cable
instructions: Facing a high pulley with a rope or dual handles attached, jala the weight directly towards your face, separating tus manos as you do so. mantén your la parte superior de los brazos paralelo to el suelo.

name: Jalón al pecho rango completo
instructions: Either standing or seated on a high banco, agarra two stirrup cables that are attached to the high pulleys. Grab with the opposing hand so tus brazos are crisscrossed about you and your palms are facing hacia adelante.

manteniendo pecho up and maintaining una ligera curvatura in your la espalda baja, jala the handles down as if you were doing a regular pulldown. The rango de movimiento will be more of an arc. durante the movement, rota tus manos so that in the bottom posiciona your palms face each other rather than hacia adelante. regresa lentamente to the posición inicial and repite.

name: Jalón un brazo con cable
instructions: Select an appropriate weight and ajusta the rodilla pad to help mantén you down. agarra the handle with a agarre en pronación. esta es tu posición inicial.
jala the handle down, squeezing your codo a tu lado as you flexiona the codo.
haz una pausa en el punto más bajo of the motion, and luego lentamente regresa the handle to the posición inicial.
For multiple repetitions, avoid completely returning the weight to mantén tension on the muscles being worked.

name: Press de hombros sentado con cable
instructions: ajusta the weight to an appropriate amount and be seated, grasping the handles. Your la parte superior de los brazos should be about 90 degrees to the body, with tu cabeza and pecho up. The codos should also be bent to about 90 degrees. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza by extending through the codo, pressing the handles together sobre tus head.
después pausing en el punto más alto, regresa the handles to the posición inicial. asegúrate de que that you maintain tension on the cables.
You can also ejecuta this movement with tu espalda off the pad and alterna hands.

name: Jalón al pecho agarre ancho
instructions: siéntate down on a jala-down machine with a amplio bar attached to the top pulley. asegúrate de that you ajusta the rodilla pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent tu cuerpo from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.

agarra la barra with the palmas hacia adelante using the prescribed agarra. Note on grips: For a amplio agarra, tus manos need to be spaced out at a distance wider than al ancho de hombros. For a medium agarra, tus manos need to be spaced out at a distance equal to your al ancho de hombros and for a close agarra at a distance smaller than your al ancho de hombros.

As you have both arms extended frente a ti holding the bar at the chosen agarra width, lleva your torso back around 30 degrees or so mientras creating a curvature on your la espalda baja and sticking tu pecho out. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras exhalas, lleva the bar down hasta it touches your upper pecho by drawing the hombros and the la parte superior de los brazos down and back. Consejo: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full posición contraída. The upper torso should remain stationary and only the arms should move. The antebrazos should do no other work except for holding the bar; therefore do not try to jala down the bar using the antebrazos.

después a second at the posición contraída squeezing your hombro blades together, lentamente eleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial when tus brazos are completamente extended and the dorsales are completamente stretched. inhala durante this portion of the movement.
repite this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Sentadilla goblet
instructions: párate holding a ligero pesa rusa by the horns close to tu pecho. esta es tu posición inicial.
Squat down between tus piernas hasta tus isquiotibiales are on tus pantorrillas. mantén tu pecho and head up and tu espalda recto.
en el punto más bajo posiciona, haz una pausa and use tus codos to empuja tus rodillas out. regresa a la posición inicial, and repite durante 10-20 repetitions.

name: Hack squat
instructions: coloca the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook tus hombros under the hombro pads provided.

posiciona tus piernas in the plataforma using a al ancho de hombros medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Consejo: mantén tu cabeza up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
coloca tus brazos on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front posiciona to a diagonal posiciona).

Now straighten tus piernas sin locking the rodillas. esta es tu posición inicial. (Nota: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

comienza to lentamente baja the unit by bending the rodillas as you maintain a recto posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down hasta the angle between the upper leg and the pantorrillas becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below paralelo to el suelo). inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the rodillas should make an imaginary recto line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If tus rodillas are past that imaginary line (if they are past tus dedos del pie) luego you are placing undue stress on the rodilla and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
