comienza to eleva the unit as you exhala by pushing el suelo with mainly with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Peso muerto una pierna con pesa rusa
instructions: mantén a pesa rusa by the handle in one hand. párate on one leg, on the same side that you mantén the pesa rusa.
Keeping that rodilla ligeramente flexionados, realiza a stiff legged deadlift by bending at the cadera, extending your free leg detrás de ti for balance.
Continue lowering the pesa rusa hasta you are paralelo to el suelo, and luego regresa to the upright posiciona.

name: Sentadilla pistola con pesa rusa
instructions: agarra up a pesa rusa with two hands and mantén it by the horns. mantén one leg off of el suelo and squat down on the other.
Squat down by flexing the rodilla and sitting back with the caderas, holding the pesa rusa up frente a ti.
mantén the bottom posiciona for a second and luego reverse the motion, driving through the heel and manteniendo head and pecho up.
baja yourself again and repite.

name: Turkish Get-Up con pesa rusa (estilo zancada)
instructions: acuéstate boca arriba on el suelo and presiona a pesa rusa to the top posiciona by extending the codo. flexiona the rodilla on the same side as the pesa rusa.

manteniendo pesa rusa locked out at all times, gira to the opposite side and use your non- working arm to assist you in driving hacia adelante to the lunge posiciona. Using your free hand, empuja yourself to a seated posiciona, luego progressing to one rodilla.
mientras looking up at the pesa rusa, lentamente párate up. Reverse the motion de vuelta a la posición inicial and repite.

name: Turkish Get-Up con pesa rusa (estilo sentadilla)
instructions: acuéstate boca arriba on el suelo and presiona a pesa rusa to the top posiciona by extending the codo. flexiona the rodilla on the same side as the pesa rusa.
manteniendo pesa rusa locked out at all times, gira to the opposite side and use your non- working arm to assist you in driving hacia adelante to the lunge posiciona.

Using your free hand, empuja yourself to a seated posiciona, luego progressing to tus pies. mientras looking up at the pesa rusa, lentamente párate up. Reverse the motion de vuelta a la posición inicial and repite.

name: Press de piernas
instructions: Using a leg presiona machine, siéntate down on the machine and coloca tus piernas on the plataforma directly frente a ti at a medium (al ancho de hombros) foot stance. (Nota: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

baja the safety bars holding the weighted plataforma in coloca and presiona the plataforma all the way up hasta tus piernas are completamente extended frente a ti. Consejo: asegúrate de that you do not lock tus rodillas. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect ángulo de 90 grados. esta es tu posición inicial.
As you inhala, lentamente baja the plataforma hasta your superior e inferior legs make a ángulo de 90 grados.
Pushing mainly with the heels of tus pies and using the cuádriceps go de vuelta a la posición inicial as you exhala.

repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas and asegúrate de que to lock the safety pins correctamente once you are done. You do not want that plataforma falling on you completamente loaded.

name: Peso muerto en máquina de palanca
instructions: Load the pins to an appropriate weight. posiciona yourself directly between the handles. agarra the bottom handles with a cómodo agarra, and luego baja tus caderas as you take a breath. Look hacia adelante with tu cabeza and mantén tu pecho up. esta es tu posición inicial.
regresa the weight to the posición inicial.

name: Press de hombros en máquina de palanca
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and ajusta the seat for your height. The handles should be near the top of the hombros at the beginning of the motion. tu pecho and head should be up and handles held with a agarre en pronación. esta es tu posición inicial.
presiona the handles hacia arriba by extending through the codo.

después a brief haz una pausa en el punto más alto, regresa the weight to just above the comienza posiciona, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops hasta the set is completa.

name: Remo con barra curvada acostado
instructions: coloca a cambered bar underneath an exercise banco.
acuéstate boca abajo on the exercise banco and agarra la barra using a palms down (agarre en pronación) that is wider than al ancho de hombros. esta es tu posición inicial.
As you exhala row the bar up as you mantén the codos close to tu cuerpo to either tu pecho, para target the upper mid back, or to your stomach if targeting the dorsales is your goal.
después a second mantén en el punto más alto, la espalda baja down to the posición inicial lentamente as you inhala.

name: Sentadilla en máquina acostado
instructions: ajusta the leg machine to a height that will allow you to get inside it with tus rodillas bent and the muslos slightly below paralelo.

Once you select the weight, posiciona yourself inside the machine face up with the rodillas bent and muslos slightly below paralelo to the plataforma. asegúrate de that the rodillas do not go past the toes. The angle created between the isquiotibiales and the pantorrillas should be one that is slightly less than 90 degrees (since your posición inicial requires you to comienza slightly below paralelo). tu espalda and tu cabeza should be resting on the machine mientras tus hombros are pressed under the hombro pads.
coloca tus manos by the handles and posiciona tus pies slightly pointing out at a al ancho de hombros posiciona. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras pressing with the la parte delantera de los pies mientras exhalas, make your whole body erect as you aprieta the cuádriceps. mantén the posición contraída for a second. Consejo: Since you are starting below paralelo, you can opt to use tus manos to help you up by pressing on your muslos only on the first repetition.

lentamente squat down as you inhala but instead of going all the way down to the posición inicial, just stop once your muslos are paralelo to the plataforma. The angle between tus isquiotibiales and pantorrillas should be a ángulo de 90 grados.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Press de pecho en máquina
instructions: siéntate down on the pecho presiona Machine and select the weight.
da un paso on the lever provided by the machine since it will help you to lleva the handles hacia adelante so that you can grab the handles and completamente extiende the arms.

Grab the handles with a palms-down agarra and levanta tus codos so that your la parte superior de los brazos are paralelo to el suelo to the sides of your torso. Consejo: tus antebrazos will be pointing hacia adelante since you are grabbing the handles. Once you lleva the handles hacia adelante and extiende the arms you will be at the posición inicial.
Now lleva the handles back towards you mientras inhalas.
empuja the handles away from you as you flexiona your pecs and you exhala. mantén la contracción for a second antes going de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante las repeticiones recomendadas amount of reps.
When finished da un paso on the lever again and lentamente get the handles back to their original coloca.

name: Hack squat piernas juntas
instructions: coloca the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook tus hombros under the hombro pads provided.

posiciona tus piernas in the plataforma using a less than al ancho de hombros narrow stance with the toes slightly pointed out. tus pies should be around 3 inches or less apart. Consejo: mantén tu cabeza up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
coloca tus brazos on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front posiciona to a diagonal posiciona).
Now straighten tus piernas sin locking the rodillas. esta es tu posición inicial.

comienza to lentamente baja the unit by bending the rodillas as you maintain a recto posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down hasta the angle between the upper leg and the pantorrillas becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below paralelo to el suelo). inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement.
comienza to eleva the unit as you exhala by pushing el suelo with mainly with the heels of tus pies as you straighten the legs again and go de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Press de piernas piernas juntas
instructions: Using a leg presiona machine, siéntate down on the machine and coloca tus piernas on the plataforma directly frente a ti at a less-than-al ancho de hombros narrow stance with the toes slightly pointed out. tus pies should be around 3 inches or less apart. Consejo: mantén tu cabeza up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.

baja the safety bars holding the weighted plataforma in coloca and presiona the plataforma all the way up hasta tus piernas are completamente extended frente a ti. Consejo: asegúrate de that you do not lock tus rodillas. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect ángulo de 90 grados. esta es tu posición inicial.
As you inhala, lentamente baja the plataforma hasta your superior e inferior legs make a ángulo de 90 grados.
Pushing mainly with the heels of tus pies and using the cuádriceps go de vuelta a la posición inicial as you exhala.

repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas and asegúrate de que to lock the safety pins correctamente once you are done. You do not want that plataforma falling on you completamente loaded.

name: Flexiones pliométricas con pesa rusa
instructions: coloca a pesa rusa on el suelo. coloca yourself in a pushup posiciona, on tus dedos del pie with one hand on el suelo and one hand holding the pesa rusa, with tus codos extended. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza by lowering yourself as low as you can, manteniendo back recto.

rápidamente and forcefully reverse direction, pushing yourself up to the other side of the pesa rusa, switching hands as you do so. Continue the movement by descending and repeating the movement back and forth.

name: Press de banca en máquina Smith
instructions: coloca a plano banco underneath the smith machine. Now coloca the barra at a height that you can reach when lying down and tus brazos are almost completamente extended. Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the plano banco. Using a agarre en pronación that is wider than al ancho de hombros, unlock the bar from the rack and mantén it recto over you with tus brazos locked. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras inhalas, come down lentamente hasta que sientas the bar on your middle pecho.

después a second haz una pausa, lleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhalas and empuja the bar using tu pecho muscles. Lock tus brazos in the posición contraída, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente again. Consejo: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, lock the bar back in the rack.

name: Remo inclinado en máquina Smith
instructions: Set the barra attached to the smith machine to a height that is about 2 inches below tus rodillas.

flexiona tus rodillas slightly and lleva your torso hacia adelante, by bending at the waist, mientras manteniendo back recto hasta it is almost paralelo to el suelo. Consejo: asegúrate de that you mantén the head up.

Now agarra the barra using an overhand (pronated) agarra and unlock it from the smith machine rack. luego let it hang directly frente a ti as tus brazos hang extended perpendicular to el suelo and your torso. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras manteniendo torso stationary, levanta the barra mientras exhalas, manteniendo codos close to the body and not doing any force with the antebrazo other than holding the weights. On the top posición contraída, aprieta the back muscles and mantén durante a second.
lentamente baja el peso again to the posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Press de banca agarre cerrado en máquina Smith
instructions: coloca a plano banco underneath the smith machine. coloca the barra at a height that you can reach when lying down and tus brazos are almost completamente extended. Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the plano banco. Using a close and agarre en pronación (palmas hacia adelante) that is around al ancho de hombros, unlock the bar from the rack and mantén it recto over you with tus brazos locked. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras inhalas, come down lentamente hasta que sientas the bar on your middle pecho. Consejo: asegúrate de that as opposed to a regular banco presiona, you mantén the codos close to the torso at all times para maximize tríceps involvement.

después a second haz una pausa, lleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhalas and empuja the bar using tus tríceps muscles. Lock tus brazos in the posición contraída, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente again. Consejo: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, lock the bar back in the rack.

name: Press declinado en máquina Smith
instructions: posiciona a decline banco in the rack so that the bar will be sobre tus pecho. Load an appropriate weight and take your coloca on the banco.
rota the bar to unhook it from the rack and completamente extiende tus brazos. tu espalda should be slightly arched and your hombro blades retracted. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza the movement by flexing tus brazos, lowering the bar to tu pecho.
haz una pausa briefly, and luego extiende tus brazos to empuja the weight de vuelta a la posición inicial.
después completing the número de repeticiones deseadas, rota the bar to rack the weight.

name: Press inclinado en máquina Smith
instructions: coloca an incline banco underneath the smith machine. coloca the barra at a height that you can reach when lying down and tus brazos are almost completamente extended. Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the incline banco and asegúrate de your upper pecho is aligned with the barra. Using a agarre en pronación (palmas hacia adelante) that is wider than al ancho de hombros, unlock the bar from the rack and mantén it recto over you with tus brazos locked. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras inhalas, come down lentamente hasta que sientas the bar on your upper pecho.

después a second haz una pausa, lleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhalas and empuja the bar using tu pecho muscles. Lock tus brazos in the posición contraída, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente again. Consejo: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, coloca the bar back in the rack.

name: Press de piernas en máquina Smith
instructions: posiciona a Smith machine bar a couple feet off of el suelo. asegúrate de que that it is resting on the safeties. después loading the bar to an appropriate weight, lie underneath the bar. coloca the middle of tus pies on the bar, tucking tus rodillas to tu pecho. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza the movement by driving through tus pies to move the bar hacia arriba, extending the caderas and rodillas. Do not lock out tus rodillas.
en el punto más alto of the motion, haz una pausa briefly antes returning to the posición inicial.

name: Press militar en máquina Smith
instructions: To comienza, coloca a plano banco (or preferably one with back support) underneath a smith machine. posiciona the barra at a height so that when seated on the plano banco, the arms must be almost completamente extended to reach the barra.

Once you have the correct height, siéntate slightly in behind the barra so that there is an imaginary recto line from the tip of your nose to the barra. tus pies should be stationary. agarra la barrabell with the palmas hacia adelante, unlock it and levanta it up so that tus brazos are completamente extended. This is the posición inicial.
lentamente comienza to baja the barra hasta it is level with your chin mientras inhaling.
luego levanta the barra de vuelta a la posición inicial using tus hombros mientras exhaling.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Sentadilla pistola en máquina Smith
instructions: To comienza, first set the bar to a posiciona that best matches your height. da un paso under it and posiciona the bar across the back of tus hombros.
Take the bar with tus manos facing hacia adelante, unlock it and levanta it off the rack by extending tus piernas. 3

Move one foot hacia adelante about 12 inches in front of the bar. extiende la otra pierna out frente a ti, holding it off el suelo. Look hacia adelante at all times and maintain a neutro or slightly arched columna vertebral. esta es tu posición inicial.
Maintaining good posture, baja yourself by flexing the rodilla and cadera, going down as far as flexibility allows.
haz una pausa briefly en el punto más bajo and luego regresa a la posición inicial by driving through the heel of your foot, extending the rodilla and cadera.

name: Sentadilla en máquina Smith
instructions: To comienza, first set the bar on the height that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, da un paso under the bar and coloca the back of tus hombros (slightly below the cuello) across it.
mantén on to the bar using both arms at each side (palmas hacia adelante), unlock it and levanta it off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straightening your torso.

posiciona tus piernas using a al ancho de hombros medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. mantén tu cabeza up at all times and also maintain a recto back. esta es tu posición inicial. (Nota: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section).

comienza to lentamente baja the bar by bending the rodillas as you maintain a recto posture with the head up. Continue down hasta the angle between the upper leg and the pantorrillas becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below paralelo to el suelo). inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the rodillas should make an imaginary recto line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If tus rodillas are past that imaginary line (if they are past tus dedos del pie) luego you are placing undue stress on the rodilla and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
comienza to eleva the bar as you exhala by pushing el suelo with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Peso muerto piernas rígidas en máquina Smith
instructions: To comienza, set the bar on the smith machine to a height that is around the middle of your muslos. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, agarra the bar using a pronated (palms hacia adelante) agarra that is al ancho de hombros. You may need some muñeca wraps if using a significant amount of weight.

levanta the bar up by completamente extending tus brazos mientras manteniendo back recto. párate con torso recto and tus piernas spaced using a al ancho de hombros or narrower stance. The rodillas should be ligeramente flexionados. esta es tu posición inicial.

manteniendo rodillas stationary, baja the barra to over the top of tus pies by bending at the waist mientras manteniendo back recto. mantén moving hacia adelante as if you were going to agarra something from el suelo hasta you siente el estiramiento on the isquiotibiales. exhala as you realiza this movement

comienza bringing your torso up recto again as soon as you feel the isquiotibiales stretch by extending tus caderas and waist hasta you are back at the posición inicial. inhala as you realiza this movement.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Sentadilla dividida una pierna en máquina Smith
instructions: To comienza, coloca a plano banco 2-3 feet behind the smith machine. luego, set the bar on the height that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, da un paso under the bar and coloca the back of tus hombros (slightly below the cuello) across it.
mantén on to the bar using both arms at each side (palmas hacia adelante), unlock it and levanta it off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straightening your torso.
posiciona tus piernas by placing one foot slightly hacia adelante under the bar and extending your other leg back and coloca the top of your foot on the banco. esta es tu posición inicial

comienza to lentamente baja the bar by bending the rodilla as you maintain a recto posture with the head up. Continue down hasta the angle between the upper leg and the pantorrilla becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below paralelo to el suelo). inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the rodilla should make an imaginary recto line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your rodilla is past that imaginary line (if it is past tus dedos del pie) luego you are placing undue stress on the rodilla and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
comienza to eleva the bar as you exhala by pushing el suelo with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten your leg again and go de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.
cambia de pierna and repite the movement.

name: Press militar dos brazos con pesas rusas
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to tus hombros. Clean the kettlebells to tus hombros by extending through the legs and caderas as you balancea the kettlebells towards tus hombros. rota tus muñecas as you do so, so that the palms face hacia adelante.

presiona the kettlebells up and out. As the kettlebells pass tu cabeza, lean into the weights so that the kettlebells are racked detrás de tus head. asegúrate de to contrae tus dorsales, butt, and stomach for added stability.

name: Elevación de hombros inclinada con barra
instructions: Lie back on an Incline banco. Using a medium width agarra (a agarra that is slightly wider than al ancho de hombros), levanta the bar from the rack and mantén it recto over you with tus brazos recto. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras manteniendo arms recto, levanta the bar by protracting your hombro blades, raising the hombros from the banco mientras exhalas.
lleva back the bar to the posición inicial mientras inhalas.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Pullover con barra brazos flexionados
instructions: acuéstate en plano banco with a barra using a hombro agarra width.
mantén the bar recto over tu pecho with a flexiona in tus brazos. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras manteniendo arms in the bent arm posiciona, baja el peso lentamente in an arc detrás de tus head mientras breathing in hasta you siente el estiramiento on the pecho.
At that point, lleva the barra de vuelta a la posición inicial using the arc through which the weight was lowered and exhala as you realiza this movement.
mantén the weight on the initial posiciona for a second and repite the motion for the prescribed number of repetitions.

name: Pullover con mancuerna brazos flexionados
instructions: coloca a mancuerna standing up on a plano banco.

Ensuring that the mancuerna stays securely placed en el punto más alto of the banco, lie perpendicular to the banco (torso across it as in forming a cross) with only tus hombros lying on the surface. caderas should be below the banco and legs bent with feet firmly on el suelo. The head will be off the banco as well.

agarra the mancuerna with both hands and mantén it recto over tu pecho with a flexiona in tus brazos. Both palms should be pressing against the underside one of the sides of the mancuerna. esta es tu posición inicial. Caution: Always asegúrate de que that the mancuerna used for this exercise is secure. Using a mancuerna with loose plates can result in the mancuerna falling apart and falling on your face.
mientras manteniendo arms locked in the bent arm posiciona, baja el peso lentamente in an arc detrás de tus head mientras breathing in hasta you siente el estiramiento on the pecho.
At that point, lleva the mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial using the arc through which the weight was lowered and exhala as you realiza this movement.
mantén the weight on the initial posiciona for a second and repite the motion for the prescribed number of repetitions.

name: Elevación de cadera con rodillas flexionadas
instructions: Lay plano on el suelo with tus brazos junto a tus sides.
Now flexiona tus rodillas at around a 75 degree angle and levanta tus pies off el suelo by around 2 inches.

Using your baja abs, lleva tus rodillas in towards you as you maintain the 75 degree angle flexiona in tus piernas. Continue this movement hasta you eleva tus caderas off of el suelo by rolling your pelvis hacia atrás. exhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: At the end of the movement tus rodillas will be over tu pecho.
aprieta tus abdominales en el punto más alto del movimiento for a second and luego regresa a la posición inicial lentamente mientras inhalas. Consejo: Maintain a controlado motion at all times.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Crunch cruzado
instructions: Lie plano on tu espalda and flexiona tus rodillas about 60 degrees.
mantén your pies planos en el suelo and coloca tus manos loosely detrás de tus head. esta es tu posición inicial.

Now curl up and lleva your right codo and hombro across tu cuerpo mientras lleva your left rodilla in toward your left hombro at the same time. Reach with your codo and try to touch your rodilla. exhala as you realiza this movement. Consejo: Try to lleva your hombro up towards your rodilla rather than just your codo and remember that the key is to contrae the abs as you realiza the movement; not just to move the codo.
Now go back down to the posición inicial as you inhala and repite with the left codo and the right rodilla.
Continue alternando in this manner hasta all prescribed repetitions are done.

name: Press declinado agarre cerrado a rompecráneos
instructions: Secure tus piernas at the end of the decline banco and lentamente lay down on the banco.

Using a close agarra (a agarra that is slightly less than al ancho de hombros), levanta the bar from the rack and mantén it recto over you with tus brazos locked and codos in. The arms should be perpendicular to el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial. Consejo: para protect your rotator cuff, it is best if you have a spotter help you levanta the barra off the rack.
Now baja the bar down to your baja pecho mientras inhalas. mantén the codos in as you realiza this movement.
Using the tríceps to empuja the bar back up, presiona it de vuelta a la posición inicial as you exhala.

mientras inhalas and you mantén the la parte superior de los brazos stationary, lleva the bar down lentamente by moving tus antebrazos in a semicircular motion towards you hasta que sientas the bar slightly touch your forehead. inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement.
levanta the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial by contracting the tríceps and exhaling.
repite steps 3-6 hasta the número de repeticiones recomendadas is performed.

name: Apertura declinada con mancuernas
instructions: Secure tus piernas at the end of the decline banco and lie down with a mancuerna on each hand on top of your muslos. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.

Once you are laying down, move the mancuernas frente a ti at al ancho de hombros. The palms of the hands should be facing each other and the arms should be perpendicular to el suelo and completamente extended. esta es tu posición inicial.

With una ligera flexión on tus codos para prevent stress at the bíceps tendon, baja tus brazos out at both sides in a amplio arc hasta you siente el estiramiento on tu pecho. inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: mantén in mind that throughout the movement, the arms should remain stationary; the movement should only occur at the hombro joint.
regresa tus brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial as you aprieta tu pecho muscles and exhala. Consejo: asegúrate de to use the same arc of motion used to baja el pesos.
mantén durante a second at the posición contraída and repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Crunch oblicuo declinado
instructions: Secure tus piernas at the end of the decline banco and lentamente lay down on the banco.
eleva your upper body off the banco hasta your torso is about 35-45 degrees if measured from el suelo.
Put one hand beside tu cabeza and the other on your muslo. esta es tu posición inicial.

eleva your upper body lentamente from the posición inicial mientras turning your torso to the left. Continue crunching up as you exhala hasta your right codo touches your left rodilla. mantén this posición contraída for a second. Consejo: Focus on manteniendo abs firme and manteniendo movement lento and controlado.
baja tu cuerpo back down lentamente to the posición inicial as you inhala.

después completing one set on the right for the número de repeticiones recomendadas, switch to your left side. Consejo: Focus on really twisting your torso and feeling the contraction when you are in the up posiciona.

name: Crunch inverso declinado
instructions: acuéstate boca arriba on a decline banco and mantén on to the top of the banco with both hands. Don't let tu cuerpo slip down from this posiciona.

mantén tus piernas paralelo to el suelo using tus abdominales to mantén them there mientras manteniendo rodillas and feet together. Consejo: tus piernas should be completamente extended with una ligera flexión on the rodilla. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras exhaling, move tus piernas towards the torso as you roll your pelvis backwards and you eleva tus caderas off the banco. At the end of this movement tus rodillas will be touching tu pecho.
mantén la contracción for a second and move tus piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras inhaling.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación con mancuerna
instructions: Grab a mancuerna in each arm and párate erguido with tus brazos extended by your sides with una ligera flexión at the codos and tu espalda recto. esta es tu posición inicial. Consejo: The mancuerna should be junto a tus muslos with the palm of tus manos facing back.

Use your side hombros to levanta the mancuernas as you exhala. The mancuernas should be to the side of the body as you move them up. Continue to levanta it hasta the mancuernas are nearly in line with your chin. Consejo: tus codos should drive the motion. As you levanta the mancuerna, your codo should always be higher than your antebrazo. Also, mantén your torso stationary and haz una pausa for a second en el punto más alto del movimiento.
baja the mancuernas back down lentamente to the posición inicial. inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Apertura inclinada con mancuernas
instructions: mantén a mancuerna on each hand and acuéstate enn incline banco that is set to an incline angle of no more than 30 degrees.
extiende tus brazos sobre ti with una ligera flexión at the codos.
Now rota the muñecas so that the palms of tus manos are facing you. Consejo: The pinky fingers should be next to each other. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras inhalas, comienza to lentamente baja the arms to the side mientras manteniendo arms extended and mientras rotating the muñecas hasta the palms of the hand are facing each other. Consejo: At the end of the movement the arms will be by your side with the palmas hacia el techo.

As you exhala comienza to lleva the mancuernas back up to the posición inicial by reversing the motion and rotating the hands so that the pinky fingers are next to each other again. Consejo: mantén in mind that the movement will only happen at the hombro joint and at the muñeca. There is no motion that happens at the codo joint.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Flexión a plancha lateral
instructions: colócate en pushup posiciona on the toes with tus manos just outside of al ancho de hombros.
realiza a pushup by allowing the codos to flexiona. As you descend, mantén tu cuerpo recto.
Do one pushup and as you come up, shift your weight on the left side of the body, gira to the side mientras bringing the right arm up towards el techo in a side plank.
baja the arm back to el suelo for another pushup and luego gira to the other side.
repite the series, alternando each side, for 10 or more reps.

name: Subida al cajón con elevación de rodilla
instructions: párate facing a box or banco of an appropriate height with tus pies together. esta es tu posición inicial.

comienza the movement by stepping up, putting your left foot on the top of the banco. extiende through the cadera and rodilla of your front leg to párate up on the box. As you párate on the box with your left leg, flexiona your right rodilla and cadera, bringing your rodilla as high as you can.
Reverse this motion to da un paso down off the box, and luego repite the sequence on the opposite leg.

name: Buenos días piernas rígidas con barra
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To comienza, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, da un paso under the bar and coloca the back of tus hombros (slightly below the cuello) across it.
mantén on to the bar using both arms at each side and levanta it off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straightening your torso.

da un paso away from the rack and posiciona tus piernas using a al ancho de hombros medium stance. mantén tu cabeza up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a recto back. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo legs stationary, move your torso hacia adelante by bending at the caderas mientras inhaling. baja your torso hasta it is paralelo with el suelo.
comienza to eleva the bar as you exhala by elevating your torso de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Pullover con mancuerna brazos extendidos
instructions: coloca a mancuerna standing up on a plano banco.

Ensuring that the mancuerna stays securely placed en el punto más alto of the banco, lie perpendicular to the banco (torso across it as in forming a cross) with only tus hombros lying on the surface. caderas should be below the banco and legs bent with feet firmly on el suelo. The head will be off the banco as well.

agarra the mancuerna with both hands and mantén it recto over tu pecho at arms length. Both palms should be pressing against the underside one of the sides of the mancuerna. esta es tu posición inicial.
Caution: Always asegúrate de que that the mancuerna used for this exercise is secure. Using a mancuerna with loose plates can result in the mancuerna falling apart and falling on your face.
mientras manteniendo arms recto, baja el peso lentamente in an arc detrás de tus head mientras breathing in hasta you siente el estiramiento on the pecho.
At that point, lleva the mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial using the arc through which the weight was lowered and exhala as you realiza this movement.
mantén the weight on the initial posiciona for a second and repite the motion for the prescribed number of repetitions.

name: Pullover declinado agarre ancho con barra
instructions: Lie down on a decline banco with both legs securely locked in posiciona. Reach for the barra behind the head using a agarre en pronación (palmas hacia out). asegúrate de to agarra la barrabell wider than al ancho de hombros for this exercise. lentamente levanta the barra up from el suelo by using tus brazos.
When positioned correctamente, tus brazos should be completamente extended and perpendicular to el suelo. This is the posición inicial.

comienza by moving the barra back down in a semicircular motion as if you were going to coloca it on el suelo, but instead, stop when the arms are paralelo to el suelo. Consejo: mantén the arms completamente extended at all times. The movement should only happen at the hombro joint. inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement.
Now lleva the barra up mientras exhaling hasta you are back at the posición inicial. Remember to mantén full control of the barra at all times.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
When finished with your set, lentamente baja the barra back down hasta it is level with tu cabeza and release it.

name: Press de pantorrilla en máquina de piernas
instructions: Using a leg presiona machine, siéntate down on the machine and coloca tus piernas on the plataforma directly frente a ti at a medium (al ancho de hombros) foot stance.

baja the safety bars holding the weighted plataforma in coloca and presiona the plataforma all the way up hasta tus piernas are completamente extended frente a ti sin locking tus rodillas. (Nota: In some leg presiona units you can leave the safety bars on for increased safety. If your leg presiona unit allows for this, luego this is the preferred method of performing the exercise.) Your torso and the legs should make perfect ángulo de 90 grados. Now carefully coloca tus dedos del pie and la parte delantera de tus pies on the baja portion of the plataforma with the heels extending off. Toes should be facing hacia adelante, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. esta es tu posición inicial.

presiona on the plataforma by raising tus talones mientras exhalas by extending tus tobillos lo más alto posible and flexing your pantorrilla. asegúrate de que that the rodilla is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. mantén the posición contraída by a second antes you comienza to go back down.
Go back lentamente to the posición inicial mientras inhalas by lowering tus talones as you flexiona the tobillos hasta pantorrillas are stretched.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Remo alto con cable
instructions: Get a plataforma of some sort (it can be an aerobics or pantorrilla eleva plataforma) that is around 4-6 inches in height.
coloca it on the seat of the cable row machine.
siéntate down on the machine and coloca tus pies on the front plataforma or crossbar provided making sure that tus rodillas are ligeramente flexionados and not locked.
Lean over as you mantén the natural alignment of tu espalda and grab the V-bar handles.

With tus brazos extended jala back hasta your torso is at a ángulo de 90 grados from tus piernas. tu espalda should be slightly arched and tu pecho should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on tus dorsales as you mantén the bar frente a ti. This is the posición inicial of the exercise.

manteniendo torso stationary, jala the handles back towards your torso mientras manteniendo arms close to it hasta you touch the abdominals. exhala as you realiza that movement. At that point you should be squeezing tu espalda muscles hard. mantén that contraction for a second and lentamente go back to the original posiciona mientras breathing in.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl alto con cable
instructions: párate between a couple of high pulleys and grab a handle in each arm. posiciona your la parte superior de los brazos in a way that they are paralelo to el suelo with the palms of tus manos facing you. esta es tu posición inicial.

Curl the handles towards you hasta they are junto a tus ears. asegúrate de that as you do so you flexiona tus bíceps and exhala. The la parte superior de los brazos should remain stationary and only the antebrazos should move. mantén durante a second in the posición contraída as you aprieta the bíceps.
lentamente lleva back the arms to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Remo sentado con cable
instructions: For this exercise you will need access to a low pulley row machine with a V-bar. Nota: The V-bar will enable you to have a agarre neutro where the palms of tus manos face each other. To colócate en the posición inicial, first siéntate down on the machine and coloca tus pies on the front plataforma or crossbar provided making sure that tus rodillas are ligeramente flexionados and not locked.
Lean over as you mantén the natural alignment of tu espalda and grab the V-bar handles.

With tus brazos extended jala back hasta your torso is at a ángulo de 90 grados from tus piernas. tu espalda should be slightly arched and tu pecho should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on tus dorsales as you mantén the bar frente a ti. This is the posición inicial of the exercise.

manteniendo torso stationary, jala the handles back towards your torso mientras manteniendo arms close to it hasta you touch the abdominals. exhala as you realiza that movement. At that point you should be squeezing tu espalda muscles hard. mantén that contraction for a second and lentamente go back to the original posiciona mientras breathing in.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Remo vertical con cable
instructions: agarra a recto bar cable attachment that is attached to a low pulley with a pronated (palmas hacia your muslos) agarra that is slightly less than al ancho de hombros. The bar should be resting on top of your muslos. tus brazos should be extended with una ligera flexión at the codos and tu espalda should be recto. esta es tu posición inicial.

Use your side hombros to levanta the cable bar as you exhala. The bar should be close to the body as you move it up. Continue to levanta it hasta it nearly touches your chin. Consejo: tus codos should drive the motion. As you levanta the bar, tus codos should always be higher than tus antebrazos. Also, mantén your torso stationary and haz una pausa for a second en el punto más alto del movimiento.
baja the bar back down lentamente to the posición inicial. inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl martillo alterno
instructions: párate up with your torso upright and a mancuerna in each hand being held at arms length. The codos should be close to the torso.
The palms of the hands should be facing your torso. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras holding the upper arm stationary, curl the right weight hacia adelante mientras contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas. Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps is completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a second as you aprieta the bíceps. Consejo: Only the antebrazos should move.
lentamente comienza to lleva the mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala.
repite the movement with the left hand. This equals one repetition.
Continue alternando in this manner for the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl inclinado alterno con mancuernas
instructions: siéntate down on an incline banco with a mancuerna in each hand being held at arms length. Consejo: mantén the codos close to the torso.esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras holding the upper arm stationary, curl the right weight hacia adelante mientras contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas. As you do so, rota the hand so that the palm is facing up. Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps is completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a second as you aprieta the bíceps. Consejo: Only the antebrazos should move.
lentamente comienza to lleva the mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala.
repite the movement with the left hand. This equals one repetition.
Continue alternando in this manner for the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación de deltoides alterna
instructions: In a standing posiciona, mantén a pair of mancuernas a tu costado.
manteniendo codos ligeramente flexionados, sube el pesos directly frente a ti to hombro height, avoiding any swinging or cheating.
regresa the weights a tu lado.
On the next repetition, sube el pesos laterally, raising them out a tu lado to about hombro height.
regresa the weights to the posición inicial and continue alternando to the front and side.

name: Dominada asistida con banda
instructions: Choke the banda around the center of the pullup bar. You can use different bandas to provide varying levels of assistance.
jala the end of the banda down, and coloca one bent rodilla into the loop, ensuring it won't slip out. Take a medium to amplio agarra on the bar. esta es tu posición inicial.

jala yourself hacia arriba by contracting the dorsales as you flexiona the codo. The codo should be driven a tu lado. jala to the front, attempting to get your chin over the bar. Avoid swinging or jerking movements.
después a brief haz una pausa, regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Curl con barra
instructions: párate up with your torso upright mientras holding a barra at a al ancho de hombros agarra. The palm of tus manos should be facing hacia adelante and the codos should be close to the torso. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras holding the la parte superior de los brazos stationary, curl the weights hacia adelante mientras contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas. Consejo: Only the antebrazos should move.
Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the bar is at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a second and aprieta the bíceps hard.
lentamente comienza to lleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl con barra apoyado en banco inclinado
instructions: Lie against an incline banco, with tus brazos holding a barra and hanging down in a horizontal line. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras manteniendo la parte superior de los brazos stationary, curl the weight up as high as you can mientras squeezing the bíceps. exhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: Only the antebrazos should move. Do not balancea the arms.
después a second contraction, lentamente go de vuelta a la posición inicial as you inhala. Consejo: asegúrate de that you go all of the way down.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación de pantorrilla sentado con barra
instructions: coloca a block about 12 inches in front of a plano banco.
siéntate en banco and coloca the ball of tus pies on the block.
Have someone coloca a barra over your upper muslos about 3 inches sobre tus rodillas and mantén it there. esta es tu posición inicial.
eleva up on tus dedos del pie lo más alto posible as you aprieta the pantorrillas and mientras exhalas.
después a second contraction, lentamente go de vuelta a la posición inicial. Consejo: To get máximo benefit stretch tus pantorrillas todo lo que puedas.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Encogimientos con barra
instructions: párate erguido with tus pies at al ancho de hombros as you mantén a barra with both hands frente a ti using a agarre en pronación (palmas hacia the muslos). Consejo: tus manos should be a little wider than al ancho de hombros. You can use muñeca wraps for this exercise for a better agarra. esta es tu posición inicial.
eleva tus hombros up todo lo que puedas go mientras exhalas and mantén la contracción for a second. Consejo: Refrain from trying to levanta the barra by using tus bíceps.
lentamente regresa a la posición inicial mientras inhalas.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Encogimientos con barra por detrás
instructions: párate erguido with tus pies at al ancho de hombros as you mantén a barra with both hands detrás de tus back using a agarre en pronación (palmas hacia back). Consejo: tus manos should be a little wider than al ancho de hombros. You can use muñeca wraps for this exercise for better agarra. esta es tu posición inicial.

eleva tus hombros up todo lo que puedas go mientras exhalas and mantén la contracción for a second. Consejo: Refrain from trying to levanta the barra by using tus bíceps. The arms should remain stretched out at all times.
lentamente regresa a la posición inicial mientras inhalas.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Press de banca con bandas
instructions: Using a plano banco secure a banda under the leg of the banco that is nearest to tu cabeza.
Once the banda is secure, grab it by both handles and lie down on the banco.
extiende tus brazos so that you are holding the banda handles frente a ti at al ancho de hombros.
Once at al ancho de hombros, rota tus muñecas hacia adelante so that the palms of tus manos are facing away from you. esta es tu posición inicial.
lleva down the handles lentamente hasta your codo forms a ángulo de 90 grados. mantén full control at all times.

mientras exhalas, lleva the handles up using your pectoral muscles. Lock tus brazos in the posición contraída, aprieta tu pecho, mantén durante a second and luego comienza coming down lentamente. Consejo: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.

name: Zancada caminando con peso corporal
instructions: comienza standing with tus pies al ancho de hombros and tus manos on tus caderas.

da un paso hacia adelante with one leg, flexing the rodillas to baja tus caderas. Descend hasta your rear rodilla nearly touches el suelo. Your posture should remain upright, and your front rodilla should stay above the front foot.
Drive through the heel of your lead foot and extiende both rodillas to eleva yourself back up.
da un paso hacia adelante with your rear foot, repeating the lunge on the opposite leg.

name: Elevación de pantorrilla sobre mancuerna
instructions: Hang on to a sturdy object for balance and párate on a mancuerna handle, preferably one with round plates so that it rolls as in this manner you have to work harder to stabilize yourself; thus increasing the effectiveness of the exercise.
Now roll your foot slightly hacia adelante so that you can get a nice stretch of the pantorrilla. esta es tu posición inicial.

levanta the pantorrilla as you roll your foot over the top of the handle so that you get a full extension. exhala durante the execution of this movement. contrae the pantorrilla hard en el punto más alto and mantén durante a second. Consejo: As you come up, roll the mancuerna slightly hacia atrás.
Now inhala as you roll the mancuerna slightly hacia adelante as you come down to get a better stretch.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl con barra EZ agarre cerrado
instructions: párate up with your torso upright mientras holding an E-Z Curl Bar at the closer inner handle. The palm of tus manos should be facing hacia adelante and they should be slightly tilted inwards debido a the shape of the bar. The codos should be close to the torso. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras holding the la parte superior de los brazos stationary, curl the weights hacia adelante mientras contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas. Consejo: Only the antebrazos should move.
Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the bar is at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a second and aprieta the bíceps hard.
lentamente comienza to lleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl de pie agarre cerrado con barra
instructions: mantén a barra with both hands, palms up and a few inches apart.

párate con torso recto and tu cabeza up. tus pies should be about al ancho de hombros and tus codos close to your torso. esta es tu posición inicial. Consejo: You will mantén your la parte superior de los brazos and codos stationary throughout the movement.

Curl the bar up in a semicircular motion hasta the antebrazos touch tus bíceps. exhala as you realiza this portion of the movement and contrae tus bíceps hard for a second en el punto más alto. Consejo: Avoid bending the back or using swinging motions as you levanta the weight. Only the antebrazos should move.
lentamente go back down to the posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl de concentración
instructions: siéntate down on a plano banco with one mancuerna frente a ti between tus piernas. tus piernas should be spread with tus rodillas bent and feet on el suelo.

Use your right arm to agarra the mancuerna up. coloca the back of your right upper arm on the top of your inner right muslo. rota the palm of your hand hasta it is facing hacia adelante away from your muslo. Consejo: Your arm should be extended and the mancuerna should be above el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras holding the upper arm stationary, curl the weights hacia adelante mientras contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas. Only the antebrazos should move. Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level. Consejo: en el punto más alto del movimiento asegúrate de that the little finger of your arm is higher than your thumb. This guarantees a good contraction. mantén the posición contraída for a second as you aprieta the bíceps.
lentamente comienza to lleva the mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala. Caution: Avoid swinging motions at any time.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas. luego repite the movement with the left arm.

name: Curl martillo cruzado
instructions: párate erguido with a mancuerna in each hand. tus manos should be down a tu costado with your palmas hacia in.

mientras manteniendo palmas hacia in and sin twisting your arm, curl the mancuerna of the right arm up towards your left hombro as you exhala. Touch the top of the mancuerna to your hombro and mantén la contracción for a second.
lentamente baja the mancuerna along the same path as you inhala and luego repite the same movement for the left arm.
Continue alternando in this fashion hasta the número de repeticiones recomendadas is performed for each arm.

name: Abdominales
instructions: Lie plano on tu espalda with tus pies plano on el suelo, or resting on a banco with tus rodillas bent at a ángulo de 90 grados. If you are resting tus pies on a banco, coloca them three to four inches apart and point tus dedos del pie hacia adentro so they touch.
Now coloca tus manos lightly on either side of tu cabeza manteniendo codos in. Consejo: Don't lock your fingers detrás de tus head.
mientras pushing the small of tu espalda down in el suelo to better isolate your abdominal muscles, comienza to roll tus hombros off el suelo.

Continue to empuja down as hard as you can with your la espalda baja as you contrae your abdominals and exhala. tus hombros should come up off el suelo only about four inches, and your la espalda baja should remain on el suelo. en el punto más alto del movimiento, contrae your abdominals hard and mantén the contraction for a second. Consejo: Focus on lento, controlado movement - don't cheat yourself by using momentum.
después the one second contraction, comienza to come down lentamente again to the posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Crunch declinado
instructions: Secure tus piernas at the end of the decline banco and lie down.
Now coloca tus manos lightly on either side of tu cabeza manteniendo codos in. Consejo: Don't lock your fingers detrás de tus head.
mientras pushing the small of tu espalda down in the banco to better isolate your abdominal muscles, comienza to roll tus hombros off it.

Continue to empuja down as hard as you can with your la espalda baja as you contrae your abdominals and exhala. tus hombros should come up off the banco only about four inches, and your la espalda baja should remain on the banco. en el punto más alto del movimiento, contrae your abdominals hard and mantén the contraction for a second. Consejo: Focus on lento, controlado movement - don't cheat yourself by using momentum.
después the one second contraction, comienza to come down lentamente again to the posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Extensión de tríceps declinada con mancuernas
instructions: Secure tus piernas at the end of the decline banco and lie down with a mancuerna on each hand on top of your muslos. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.

Once you are laying down, move the mancuernas frente a ti at al ancho de hombros. The palms of the hands should be facing each other and the arms should be perpendicular to el suelo and completamente extended. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras inhalas and you mantén the la parte superior de los brazos stationary (and codos in), lleva the mancuernas down lentamente by moving tus antebrazos in a semicircular motion towards you hasta your thumbs are junto a tus ears. inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement.
levanta the mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial by contracting the tríceps and exhaling.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Flexión declinada
instructions: acuéstate en floor face down and coloca tus manos about 36 inches apart mientras holding your torso up at arms length. Move tus pies up to a box or banco. esta es tu posición inicial.
Next, baja yourself hacia abajo hasta tu pecho almost touches el suelo as you inhala.
Now exhala and presiona your upper body back up to the posición inicial mientras squeezing tu pecho.
después a brief haz una pausa en el punto más alto posición contraída, you can comienza to baja yourself hacia abajo again for as many repetitions as needed.

name: Curl de bíceps alterno con mancuernas
instructions: párate (torso upright) with a mancuerna in each hand held at arms length. The codos should be close to the torso and the palms of your hand should be facing your muslos.

mientras holding the upper arm stationary, curl the right weight as you rota the palm of the hands hasta they are facing hacia adelante. At this point continue contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas hasta tus bíceps is completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a second as you aprieta the bíceps. Consejo: Only the antebrazos should move.
lentamente comienza to lleva the mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala. Consejo: Remember to gira the palms de vuelta a la posición inicial (facing your muslos) as you come down.
repite the movement with the left hand. This equals one repetition.
Continue alternando in this manner for the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl de bíceps con mancuernas
instructions: párate erguido with a mancuerna in each hand at arm's length. mantén tus codos close to your torso and rota the palms of tus manos hasta they are facing hacia adelante. esta es tu posición inicial.

Now, manteniendo la parte superior de los brazos stationary, exhala and curl the weights mientras contracting tus bíceps. Continue to sube el pesos hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a brief haz una pausa as you aprieta tus bíceps.
luego, inhala and lentamente comienza to baja the mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Apertura con mancuernas
instructions: Lie down on a plano banco with a mancuerna on each hand resting on top of your muslos. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.

luego using your muslos to help eleva the mancuernas, levanta the mancuernas one at a time so you can mantén them frente a ti at al ancho de hombros with the palms of tus manos facing each other. eleva the mancuernas up like you're pressing them, but stop and mantén just antes you lock out. esta es tu posición inicial.

With una ligera flexión on tus codos para prevent stress at the bíceps tendon, baja tus brazos out at both sides in a amplio arc hasta you siente el estiramiento on tu pecho. inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: mantén in mind that throughout the movement, the arms should remain stationary; the movement should only occur at the hombro joint.
regresa tus brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial as you aprieta tu pecho muscles and exhala. Consejo: asegúrate de to use the same arc of motion used to baja el pesos.
mantén durante a second at the posición contraída and repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Elevación de hombros inclinada con mancuernas
instructions: siéntate enn Incline banco mientras holding a mancuerna on each hand on top of your muslos.

levanta tus piernas up to patea the weights to tus hombros and lean back. posiciona the mancuernas sobre tus hombros with tus brazos extended. The arms should be perpendicular to el suelo with your palmas hacia adelante and knuckles pointing towards el techo. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras manteniendo arms recto and locked, levanta the mancuernas by raising the hombros from the banco mientras exhalas.
lleva back the mancuernas to the posición inicial mientras inhalas.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación lateral posterior un brazo acostado
instructions: mientras holding a mancuerna in one hand, lay with tu pecho down on a slightly inclined (around 15 degrees when measured from el suelo) adjustable banco. The other hand can be used to mantén to the leg of the banco for stability.

posiciona the palm of the hand that is holding the mancuerna in a neutro manner (palmas hacia your torso) as you mantén the arm extended with the codo ligeramente flexionados. esta es tu posición inicial.

Now eleva the arm with the mancuerna to the side hasta your codo is at hombro height and your arm is roughly paralelo to el suelo as you exhala. Consejo: Maintain your arm perpendicular to the torso mientras manteniendo arm extended throughout the movement. Also, mantén the contraction en el punto más alto for a second.
lentamente baja the mancuerna to the posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación lateral posterior acostado con mancuernas
instructions: mientras holding a mancuerna in each hand, lay with tu pecho down on a slightly inclined (around 15 degrees when measured from el suelo) adjustable banco.
posiciona the palms of the hands in a neutro manner (palmas hacia your torso) as you mantén the arms extended with the codos ligeramente flexionados. esta es tu posición inicial.

Now eleva the arms to the side hasta tus codos are at hombro height and tus brazos are roughly paralelo to el suelo as you exhala. Consejo: Maintain tus brazos perpendicular to the torso mientras manteniendom extended throughout the movement. Also, mantén the contraction en el punto más alto for a second.
lentamente baja the mancuernas to the posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas and luego switch to el otro brazo.

name: Extensión de tríceps un brazo con mancuerna
instructions: Grab a mancuerna and either siéntate en military presiona banco or a utility banco that has a back support on it as you coloca the mancuernas upright on top of your muslos or párate erguido.

Clean the mancuerna up to lleva it to hombro height and luego extiende the arm over tu cabeza so that the whole arm is perpendicular to el suelo and junto a tus head. The mancuerna should be on top of you. The other hand can be kept completamente extended to the side, by the waist, supporting the upper arm that has the mancuerna or grabbing a fixed surface.
rota the muñeca so that the palm of your hand is facing hacia adelante and the pinkie is facing el techo. esta es tu posición inicial.
lentamente baja the mancuerna detrás de tus head as you mantén the upper arm stationary. inhala as you realiza this movement and haz una pausa when tus tríceps are completamente stretched.
regresa a la posición inicial by flexing tus tríceps mientras exhalas. Consejo: It is imperative that only the antebrazo moves. The upper arm should remain at all times stationary junto a tus head.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas and switch arms.

name: Curl en banco inclinado boca abajo con mancuernas
instructions: Grab a mancuerna on each hand and acuéstate boca abajo on an incline banco with tus hombros near top of the incline. tus rodillas can rest on the seat or tus piernas can be straddled to the sides (my preferred way).
Let tus brazos extiende and hang naturally frente a ti so that they are perpendicular to el suelo.
Now mantén tus codos in by your side and face the palms hacia adelante. esta es tu posición inicial.

eleva the mancuernas by contracting the bíceps hasta tus brazos are completamente flexed. exhala as you realiza this portion of the movement and asegúrate de que that only the antebrazos move. The la parte superior de los brazos should remain stationary at all times.
baja the mancuernas hasta tus brazos are completamente extended.
repite durante las repeticiones recomendadas amount of times.

name: Elevación de pantorrilla una pierna sentado con mancuerna
instructions: coloca a block on el suelo about 12 inches from a plano banco.
siéntate en plano banco and coloca a mancuerna on your upper left muslo about 3 inches sobre tus rodilla.
Now coloca the ball of your left foot on the block. esta es tu posición inicial.
eleva tus dedos del pie up lo más alto posible as you exhala and you contrae your pantorrilla muscle. mantén la contracción for a second.
lentamente regresa a la posición inicial, stretching as far down as possible.
repite durante your prescribed number of repetitions and luego repite with the right leg.

name: Encogimientos con mancuernas
instructions: párate erect with a mancuerna on each hand (palmas hacia your torso), arms extended on the sides.

levanta the mancuernas by elevating the hombros lo más alto posible mientras you exhala. mantén la contracción en el punto más alto for a second. Consejo: The arms should remain extended at all times. Refrain from using the bíceps to help levanta the mancuernas. Only the hombros should be moving up and down.
baja the mancuernas back to the original posiciona.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Extensión de tríceps agarre pronado con mancuerna
instructions: Lie down on a plano banco holding two mancuernas directly sobre tus hombros. tus brazos should be completamente extended and form a ángulo de 90 grados from your torso and el suelo.
The palms of tus manos should be facing hacia adelante, and tus codos should be tucked in. esta es tu posición inicial.
Now, inhala and lentamente baja the mancuernas hasta they are near your ears. Be sure to mantén your la parte superior de los brazos stationary and tus codos tucked in.
luego, exhala and use tus tríceps to regresa the weight to the posición inicial.

name: Elevación de piernas acostado en banco plano
instructions: Lie with tu espalda plano on a banco and tus piernas extended frente a ti off the end.
coloca tus manos either under tus glúteos with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the banco. esta es tu posición inicial.

As you mantén tus piernas extended, recto as possible with tus rodillas ligeramente flexionados but locked eleva tus piernas hasta they make a ángulo de 90 grados with el suelo. exhala as you realiza this portion of the movement and mantén la contracción en el punto más alto for a second.
Now, as you inhala, lentamente baja tus piernas back down to the posición inicial.

name: Elevación frontal con mancuerna
instructions: agarra a couple of mancuernas and párate with a recto torso and the mancuernas on front of your muslos at arms length with the palms of the hand facing your muslos. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), levanta the left mancuerna to the front with una ligera flexión on the codo and the palms of the hands always facing down. Continue to go up hasta you arm is slightly above paralelo to el suelo. exhala as you ejecuta this portion of the movement and haz una pausa for a second en el punto más alto. inhala después the second haz una pausa.
Now baja the mancuerna back down lentamente to the posición inicial as you simultáneamente levanta the right mancuerna.
Continue alternando in this fashion hasta all of the número de repeticiones recomendadas have been performed for each arm.

name: Elevación frontal inclinada con mancuernas
instructions: siéntate down on an incline banco with the incline set anywhere between 30 to 60 degrees mientras holding a mancuerna on each hand. Consejo: You can change the angle to hit the muscle a little differently each time.
extiende tus brazos recto frente a ti and have your palmas hacia abajo with the mancuernas raised about 1 inch sobre tus muslos. esta es tu posición inicial.

lentamente eleva the mancuernas recto up hasta they are slightly sobre tus hombros, mientras manteniendo codos locked. aprieta en el punto más alto for a second and asegúrate de you exhala durante this portion of the movement. Consejo: mantén tu cabeza resting down against the banco and tus piernas on el suelo at all times.
baja the arms de vuelta a la posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl martillo
instructions: párate up with your torso upright and a mancuerna on each hand being held at arms length. The codos should be close to the torso.
The palms of the hands should be facing your torso. esta es tu posición inicial.

Now, mientras holding your upper arm stationary, exhala and curl the weight hacia adelante mientras contracting the bíceps. Continue to sube el peso hasta the bíceps are completamente contracted and the mancuerna is at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a brief moment as you aprieta the bíceps. Consejo: Focus on manteniendo codo stationary and only moving your antebrazo.
después the brief haz una pausa, inhala and lentamente comienza the baja the mancuernas back down to the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación de piernas en suspensión
instructions: Hang from a chin-up bar with both arms extended at arms length in top of you using either a amplio agarra or a medium agarra. The legs should be recto down with the pelvis rolled slightly backwards. esta es tu posición inicial.
eleva tus piernas hasta the torso makes a ángulo de 90 grados with the legs. exhala as you realiza this movement and mantén la contracción for a second or so.
Go back lentamente to the posición inicial mientras inhalas.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Extensión de tríceps inclinada con barra
instructions: mantén a barra with an agarre en pronación (palms down) that is a little closer together than al ancho de hombros.
Lie back on an incline banco set at any angle between 45-75-degrees.
lleva the bar sobre la cabeza with tus brazos extended and codos in. The arms should be in line with the torso above the head. esta es tu posición inicial.

Now baja the bar in a semicircular motion detrás de tus head hasta tus antebrazos touch tus bíceps. inhala as you realiza this movement. Consejo: mantén your la parte superior de los brazos stationary and close to tu cabeza at all times. Only the antebrazos should move.
regresa a la posición inicial mientras exhalas and you contrae the tríceps. mantén la contracción for a second.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl inclinado con mancuernas
instructions: siéntate back on an incline banco with a mancuerna in each hand held at arms length. mantén tus codos close to your torso and rota the palms of tus manos hasta they are facing hacia adelante. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras holding the upper arm stationary, curl the weights hacia adelante mientras contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas. Only the antebrazos should move. Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a second.
lentamente comienza to lleva the mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl martillo inclinado
instructions: Seat yourself on an incline banco with a mancuerna in each hand. You should pressed firmly against he back with tus pies together. Allow the mancuernas to hang recto down a tu costado, holding them with a agarre neutro. esta es tu posición inicial.
Initiate the movement by flexing at the codo, attempting to mantén the upper arm stationary.
Continue to the top of the movement and haz una pausa, luego lentamente regresa to the comienza posiciona.

name: Curl interior de bíceps inclinado
instructions: mantén a mancuerna in each hand and lie back on an incline banco.
The mancuernas should be at arm's length hanging a tus costados and your palms should be facing out. esta es tu posición inicial.

Now as you exhala curl the weight hacia afuera and up mientras manteniendo antebrazos in line with your side deltoids. Continue the curl hasta the mancuernas are at hombro height and to the sides of your deltoids. Consejo: The end of the movement should look similar to a double bíceps pose.
después a second contraction en el punto más alto del movimiento, comienza to inhala and lentamente baja el pesos de vuelta a la posición inicial using the same path used to lleva them up.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Extensión de tríceps acostado con mancuernas
instructions: acuéstate en plano banco mientras holding two mancuernas directly frente a ti. tus brazos should be completamente extended at a ángulo de 90 grados from your torso and el suelo. The palms should be facing in and the codos should be tucked in. This is the posición inicial.
mientras inhalas and you mantén the la parte superior de los brazos stationary with the codos in, lentamente baja el peso hasta the mancuernas are near your ears.
At that point, mientras manteniendo codos in and the la parte superior de los brazos stationary, use the tríceps to lleva the weight back up to the posición inicial mientras exhalas.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl con barra en banco alto acostado
instructions: Lie face hacia adelante on a erguido plano banco mientras holding a barra with a agarre en supinación (palmas hacia arriba). Consejo: If you are holding a barra grab it using a al ancho de hombros agarra and if you are using an E-Z Bar grab it on the inner handles. Your upper body should be positioned in a way that the upper pecho is over the end of the banco and the barra is hanging frente a ti with the arms extended and perpendicular to el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras manteniendo codos in and the la parte superior de los brazos stationary, curl the weight up in a semi-circular motion as you contrae the bíceps and exhala. mantén en el punto más alto del movimiento for a second.

As you inhala, lentamente go de vuelta a la posición inicial. Consejo: Maintain full control of the weight at all times and avoid any swinging. Remember, only the antebrazos should move throughout the movement.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación lateral un brazo acostado
instructions: mientras holding a mancuerna in one hand, lay with tu pecho down on a plano banco. The other hand can be used to mantén to the leg of the banco for stability.

posiciona the palm of the hand that is holding the mancuerna in a neutro manner (palmas hacia your torso) as you mantén the arm extended with the codo ligeramente flexionados. esta es tu posición inicial.

Now eleva the arm with the mancuerna to the side hasta your codo is at hombro height and your arm is roughly paralelo to el suelo as you exhala. Consejo: Maintain your arm perpendicular to the torso mientras manteniendo arm extended throughout the movement. Also, mantén the contraction en el punto más alto for a second.
lentamente baja the mancuerna to the posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación posterior de deltoides acostado
instructions: mientras holding a mancuerna in each hand, lay with tu pecho down on a plano banco.
posiciona the palms of the hands in a neutro manner (palmas hacia your torso) as you mantén the arms extended with the codos ligeramente flexionados. esta es tu posición inicial.

Now eleva the arms to the side hasta tus codos are at hombro height and tus brazos are roughly paralelo to el suelo as you exhala. Consejo: Maintain tus brazos perpendicular to the torso mientras manteniendom extended throughout the movement. Also, mantén the contraction en el punto más alto for a second.
lentamente baja the mancuernas to the posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas and luego switch to el otro brazo.

name: Curl supino acostado con mancuernas
instructions: Lie down on a plano banco face up mientras holding a mancuerna in each arm on top of your muslos.
lleva the mancuernas to the sides with the arms extended and the palms of the hands facing your muslos (agarre neutro).

mientras manteniendo arms close to your torso and codos in, lentamente baja tus brazos (as you mantén them extended with una ligera flexión at the codos) as far down towards el suelo as you can go. Once you cannot go down any further, lock your la parte superior de los brazos in that posiciona and that will be your posición inicial.

mientras exhalas, lentamente comienza to curl the weights up as you simultáneamente rota tus muñecas so that the palms of the hands face up. Continue curling the weight hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and aprieta hard en el punto más alto posiciona for a second. Consejo: Only the antebrazos should move. la parte superior de los brazos should remain stationary and codos should stay in throughout the movement.
regresa de vuelta a la posición inicial very lentamente.

name: Crunches oblicuos
instructions: Lie plano on el suelo with your la espalda baja pressed to el suelo. For this exercise, you will need to put one hand beside tu cabeza and the other to the side against el suelo.
asegúrate de tus pies are elevated and resting on a plano surface.
