Now levanta the hombro in which your hand is touching tu cabeza.

Simply elevate your hombro and body hacia arriba hasta you touch your rodilla. por ejemplo, if you have your right hand besides tu cabeza, luego you want to elevate tu cuerpo upwards hasta your right codo touches your left rodilla. The same variation can be applied doing the inverse and using your left codo to touch your right rodilla.
después your rodilla touches your codo, baja tu cuerpo hasta you have reached the posición inicial.
Remember to inhala durante the eccentric (lowering) part of the exercise and to exhala durante the concentric (hacia arriba) part of the exercise.
Continue alternando in this manner hasta all of the recommended repetitions for each side have been completed.

name: Crunches oblicuos en el suelo
instructions: comienza out by lying on your right side with tus piernas lying on top of each other. asegúrate de tus rodillas are bent a little bit.
coloca your left hand detrás de tus head.
Once you are in this set posiciona, comienza by moving your left codo up as you would realiza a normal crunch except this time the main emphasis is on your obliques.
Crunch as high as you can, mantén la contracción for a second and luego lentamente baja back down into the posición inicial.
Remember to inhala durante the eccentric (lowering) part of the exercise and to exhala durante the concentric (elevation) part of the exercise.

name: Elevación lateral inclinada un brazo
instructions: Lie down sideways on an incline banco presiona with a mancuerna in the hand. asegúrate de the hombro is pressing against the incline banco and the arm is lying across tu cuerpo with the palm around your navel.
mantén a mancuerna in your uppermost arm mientras keeping it extended frente a ti paralelo to el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras manteniendo mancuerna paralelo to el suelo at all times, realiza a lateral eleva. Your arm should travel recto up hasta it is pointing at el techo. Consejo: exhala as you realiza this movement. mantén the mancuerna in the posiciona and feel the contraction in the hombros for a second.
mientras inhaling baja el peso across tu cuerpo back into the posición inicial.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repite the movement.

name: Dominada supina un brazo
instructions: For this exercise, comienza out by placing a towel around a chin up bar.
Grab the chin-up bar with your palm facing you. One hand will be grabbing the chin-up bar and the other will be grabbing the towel.
lleva your torso back around 30 degrees or so mientras creating a curvature on your la espalda baja and sticking tu pecho out. esta es tu posición inicial.v

jala your torso up hasta the bar touches your upper pecho by drawing the hombros and the la parte superior de los brazos down and back. exhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full posición contraída. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The antebrazos should do no other work other than mantén the bar.

después a second on the posición contraída, comienza to inhala and lentamente baja your torso de vuelta a la posición inicial when tus brazos are completamente extended and the dorsales are completamente stretched.
repite this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repite the movement.

name: Curl en predicador un brazo con mancuerna
instructions: Grab a mancuerna with the right arm and coloca the upper arm on top of the preacher banco or the incline banco. The mancuerna should be held at hombro length. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras inhalas, lentamente baja the mancuerna hasta your upper arm is extended and the bíceps is completamente stretched.

As you exhala, use the bíceps to curl the weight up hasta tus bíceps is completamente contracted and the mancuerna is at hombro height. Again, remember that to asegúrate de que full contraction you need to lleva that small finger higher than the thumb.
aprieta the bíceps hard for a second at the posición contraída and repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.
Switch arms and repite the movement.

name: Extensión de tríceps pronada un brazo con mancuerna
instructions: Lie plano on a banco mientras holding a mancuerna at arms length. Your arm should be perpendicular to tu cuerpo. The palm of your hand should be facing towards tus pies as a agarre en pronación is required to realiza this exercise.
coloca your non lifting hand on your bicep for support.
lentamente comienza to baja the mancuerna down mientras inhalas.
luego, comienza lifting the mancuerna hacia arriba as you contrae the tríceps. Remember to exhala durante the concentric (lifting part of the exercise).
repite hasta you have performed your set repetitions.
Switch arms and repite the movement.

name: Extensión de tríceps supinada un brazo con mancuerna
instructions: Lie plano on a banco mientras holding a mancuerna at arms length. Your arm should be perpendicular to tu cuerpo. The palm of your hand should be facing towards your face as a agarre en supinación is required to realiza this exercise.
coloca your non lifting hand on your bicep for support.
lentamente comienza to baja the mancuerna down mientras inhalas.
luego, comienza lifting the mancuerna hacia arriba as you contrae the tríceps. Remember to exhala durante the concentric (lifting part of the exercise).
repite hasta you have performed your set repetitions.
Switch arms and repite the movement.
Switch arms again and repite the movement.

name: Curl de muñeca prono con mancuerna
instructions: comienza out by placing two mancuernas on one side of a plano banco.
Kneel down on both of tus rodillas so that tu cuerpo is facing the plano banco.

Use tus brazos to grab both of the mancuernas with a agarre en pronación (palmas hacia abajo) and lleva them up so that tus antebrazos are resting against the plano banco. tus muñecas should be hanging over the edge.
comienza out by curling your muñeca upwards and exhaling.
lentamente baja tus muñecas back down to the posición inicial mientras inhaling.
tus antebrazos should be stationary as your muñeca is the only movement needed to realiza this exercise.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl de muñeca supino con barra
instructions: comienza out by placing a barra on one side of a plano banco.
Kneel down on both of tus rodillas so that tu cuerpo is facing the plano banco.
Use tus brazos to agarra la barrabell with a agarre en supinación (palms up) and lleva them up so that tus antebrazos are resting against the plano banco. tus muñecas should be hanging over the edge.
comienza out by curling your muñeca upwards and exhaling.
lentamente baja tus muñecas back down to the posición inicial mientras inhaling.
tus antebrazos should be stationary as your muñeca is the only movement needed to realiza this exercise.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Fondos en barras paralelas
instructions: párate between a set of paralelo bars. coloca a hand on each bar, and luego take a small salta to help you colócate en the posición inicial with tus brazos locked out.
comienza by flexing the codo, lowering tu cuerpo hasta tus brazos break 90 degrees. Avoid swinging, and maintain good posture throughout the descent.
Reverse the motion by extending the codo, pushing yourself back up into the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Plancha
instructions: colócate en a prone posiciona on el suelo, supporting your weight on tus dedos del pie and tus antebrazos. tus brazos are bent and directly below the hombro.
mantén tu cuerpo recto at all times, and mantén esta posición as long as possible. To increase difficulty, an arm or leg can be raised.

name: Curl en predicador
instructions: To realiza this movement you will need a preacher banco and an E-Z bar. Grab the E-Z curl bar at the close inner handle (either have someone hand you the bar which is preferable or agarra la barra from the front bar rest provided by most preacher benches). The palm of tus manos should be facing hacia adelante and they should be slightly tilted inwards debido a the shape of the bar.
With the la parte superior de los brazos positioned against the preacher banco pad and the pecho against it, mantén the E-Z Curl Bar at hombro length. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras inhalas, lentamente baja the bar hasta your upper arm is extended and the bíceps is completamente stretched.
As you exhala, use the bíceps to curl the weight up hasta tus bíceps is completamente contracted and the bar is at hombro height. aprieta the bíceps hard and mantén esta posición for a second.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl martillo en predicador con mancuerna
instructions: coloca the upper part of both arms on top of the preacher banco as you mantén a mancuerna in each hand with the palmas enfrentadas (agarre neutro).
mientras inhalas, lentamente baja the mancuernas hasta your upper arm is extended and the bíceps is completamente stretched.
As you exhala, use the bíceps to curl the weight up hasta tus bíceps is completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro height.
aprieta the bíceps hard for a second at the posición contraída and repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl inverso con barra
instructions: párate up with your torso upright mientras holding a barra at al ancho de hombros with the codos close to the torso. The palm of tus manos should be facing down (agarre en pronación). esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras holding the la parte superior de los brazos stationary, curl the weights mientras contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas. Only the antebrazos should move. Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the bar is at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a second as you aprieta the muscle.
lentamente comienza to lleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Crunch inverso
instructions: Lie down on el suelo with tus piernas completamente extended and arms to the side of your torso with the palms on el suelo. tus brazos should be stationary for the entire exercise.
Move tus piernas up so that your muslos are perpendicular to el suelo and feet are together and paralelo to el suelo. This is the posición inicial.
mientras inhaling, move tus piernas towards the torso as you roll your pelvis backwards and you eleva tus caderas off el suelo. At the end of this movement tus rodillas will be touching tu pecho.
mantén la contracción for a second and move tus piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhaling.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Vuelos inversos
instructions: To comienza, lie down on an incline banco with the pecho and stomach pressing against the incline. Have the mancuernas in each hand with the palmas enfrentadas (agarre neutro).

extiende the arms frente a ti so that they are perpendicular to the angle of the banco. The legs should be stationary mientras applying pressure with the ball of tus dedos del pie. This is the posición inicial.

Maintaining the slight flexiona of the codos, move the weights out and away from each other (to the side) in an arc motion mientras exhaling. Consejo: Try to aprieta your hombro blades together to get the best results from this exercise.
The arms should be elevated hasta they are paralelo to el suelo.
Feel the contraction and lentamente baja el pesos back down to the posición inicial mientras inhaling.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Vuelos inversos con rotación externa
instructions: To comienza, lie down on an incline banco set at a 30-degree angle with the pecho and stomach pressing against the incline.

Have the mancuernas in each hand with the palmas hacia abajo to el suelo. tus brazos should be frente a ti so that they are perpendicular to the angle of the banco. Consejo: tus codos should have una ligera flexión. The legs should be stationary mientras applying pressure with the ball of tus dedos del pie (tus talones should not be touching el suelo). This is the posición inicial.
Maintaining the slight flexiona of the codos, move the weights out and away from each other in an arc motion mientras exhaling.

As you levanta the weight, your muñeca should externally rota by 90-degrees so that you go from a palms down (pronated) agarra to a palmas enfrentadas (neutro) agarra. Consejo: Try to aprieta your hombro blades together to get the best results from this exercise.
The arms should be elevated hasta they are level with the head.
Feel the contraction and lentamente baja el pesos back down to the posición inicial mientras inhaling.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Fondos en anillas
instructions: agarra a ring in each hand, and luego take a small salta to help you colócate en the posición inicial with tus brazos locked out.
comienza by flexing the codo, lowering tu cuerpo hasta tus brazos break 90 degrees. Avoid swinging, and maintain good posture throughout the descent.
Reverse the motion by extending the codo, pushing yourself back up into the posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Elevación posterior de deltoides sentado inclinado
instructions: coloca a couple of mancuernas looking hacia adelante in front of a plano banco.
siéntate en end of the banco with tus piernas together and the mancuernas detrás de tus pantorrillas.
flexiona at the waist mientras manteniendo back recto para agarra up the mancuernas. The palms of tus manos should be facing each other as you agarra them. esta es tu posición inicial.

manteniendo torso hacia adelante and stationary, and the arms ligeramente flexionados at the codos, levanta the mancuernas recto to the side hasta both arms are paralelo to el suelo. exhala as you levanta the weights. (Nota: avoid swinging the torso or bringing the arms back as opposed to the side.)
después a one second contraction en el punto más alto, lentamente baja the mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl de concentración agarre cerrado con barra
instructions: siéntate down on a plano banco with a barra or E-Z Bar frente a ti in between tus piernas. tus piernas should be spread with the rodillas bent and the feet on el suelo.

Use tus brazos to agarra the barra up and coloca the back of your la parte superior de los brazos on top of your inner muslos (around three and a half inches away from the front of the rodilla). A agarre en supinación closer than al ancho de hombros is needed to realiza this exercise. Consejo: Your arm should be extended at arms length and the barra should be above el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras holding the la parte superior de los brazos stationary, curl the weights hacia adelante mientras contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas. Only the antebrazos should move. Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a second as you aprieta the bíceps.
lentamente comienza to lleva the barra de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala. Consejo: Avoid swinging motions at any time.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl sentado con mancuernas
instructions: siéntate en plano banco with a mancuerna on each hand being held at arms length. The codos should be close to the torso.
rota the palms of the hands so that they are facing your torso. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras holding the upper arm stationary, curl the weights and comienza twisting the muñecas once the mancuernas pass your muslos so that the palms of tus manos face hacia adelante at the end of the movement. asegúrate de that you contrae the bíceps mientras exhalas and asegúrate de that only the antebrazos move. Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a second as you aprieta the bíceps.
lentamente comienza to lleva the mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala and as you rota the muñecas back to a agarre neutro.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl interior de bíceps sentado con mancuernas
instructions: siéntate en end of a plano banco with a mancuerna in each hand being held at arms length. The codos should be close to the torso.
rota the palms of the hands so that they are facing hacia adentro in a neutro posiciona. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras holding the la parte superior de los brazos stationary, curl the mancuernas out and up, turning the palms out as you levanta and manteniendo antebrazos in line with your outer deltoids. Tips:

Only the antebrazos should move. Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a second as you aprieta the bíceps.
lentamente comienza to lleva the mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala. Remember to rota tus brazos as you baja the mancuernas so that you can switch back to a agarre neutro.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl de muñeca prono sentado con mancuernas
instructions: comienza out by placing two mancuernas on el suelo in front of a plano banco.
siéntate down on the edge of the plano banco with tus piernas at about al ancho de hombros. asegúrate de to mantén tus pies on el suelo.

Use tus brazos to grab both of the mancuernas and lleva them up so that tus antebrazos are resting against your muslos with the palms of the hands facing down. tus muñecas should be hanging over the edge of your muslos.
comienza out by curling your muñeca upwards and exhaling.

lentamente baja tus muñecas back down to the posición inicial mientras inhaling. asegúrate de to inhala durante this part of the exercise. Consejo: tus antebrazos should be stationary as your muñeca is the only movement needed to realiza this exercise.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.
When finished, simply baja the mancuernas to el suelo.

name: Curl de muñeca supino sentado con mancuernas
instructions: comienza out by placing two mancuernas on el suelo in front of a plano banco.
siéntate down on the edge of the plano banco with tus piernas at about al ancho de hombros. asegúrate de to mantén tus pies on el suelo.

Use tus brazos to grab both of the mancuernas and lleva them up so that tus antebrazos are resting against your muslos with the palms of the hands facing up. tus muñecas should be hanging over the edge of your muslos.
comienza out by curling your muñeca upwards and exhaling.

lentamente baja tus muñecas back down to the posición inicial mientras inhaling. asegúrate de to inhala durante this part of the exercise. Consejo: tus antebrazos should be stationary as your muñeca is the only movement needed to realiza this exercise.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.
When finished, simply baja the mancuernas to el suelo.

name: Curl de muñeca prono un brazo sentado
instructions: siéntate en plano banco with a mancuerna in your right hand.
coloca your pies planos en el suelo, at a distance that is slightly wider than al ancho de hombros.

Lean hacia adelante and coloca your right antebrazo on top of your upper right muslo with your palm down. Consejo: asegúrate de that the back of the muñeca lies on top of tus rodillas. esta es tu posición inicial.
baja the mancuerna lo más lejos posible as you mantén a firme agarra on the mancuerna. inhala as you realiza this movement.

Now curl the mancuerna lo más alto posible as you contrae the antebrazos and as you exhala. mantén the contraction for a second antes you baja again. Consejo: The only movement should happen at the muñeca.
realiza for the número de repeticiones recomendadas, switch arms and repite the movement.

name: Curl de muñeca supino un brazo sentado
instructions: siéntate en plano banco with a mancuerna in your right hand.
coloca your pies planos en el suelo, at a distance that is slightly wider than al ancho de hombros.

Lean hacia adelante and coloca your right antebrazo on top of your upper right muslo with your palm up. Consejo: asegúrate de that the front of the muñeca lies on top of tus rodillas. esta es tu posición inicial.
baja the mancuerna lo más lejos posible as you mantén a firme agarra on the mancuerna. inhala as you realiza this movement.

Now curl the mancuerna lo más alto posible as you contrae the antebrazos and as you exhala. mantén the contraction for a second antes you baja again. Consejo: The only movement should happen at the muñeca.
realiza for the número de repeticiones recomendadas, switch arms and repite the movement.

name: Curl de muñeca supino sentado con barra
instructions: mantén a barra with both hands and your palmas hacia arriba; hands spaced about al ancho de hombros.
coloca your pies planos en el suelo, at a distance that is slightly wider than al ancho de hombros.

Lean hacia adelante and coloca tus antebrazos on top of your upper muslos with your palms up. Consejo: asegúrate de that the front of the muñecas lay on top of tus rodillas. esta es tu posición inicial.
baja the bar lo más lejos posible mientras inhaling and keeping a firme agarra.
Now curl bar up lo más alto posible mientras flexing the antebrazos and exhaling. mantén la contracción en el punto más alto for a second and Consejo: Only the muñeca should move.

name: Curl de muñeca prono sentado con barra
instructions: mantén a barra with both hands and your palmas hacia abajo; hands spaced about al ancho de hombros.
coloca your pies planos en el suelo, at a distance that is slightly wider than al ancho de hombros.

Lean hacia adelante and coloca tus antebrazos on top of your upper muslos with your palms down. Consejo: asegúrate de that the back of the muñecas lay on top of tus rodillas. esta es tu posición inicial.
baja the bar lo más lejos posible mientras inhaling and keeping a firme agarra.
Now curl bar up lo más alto posible mientras flexing the antebrazos and exhaling. mantén la contracción en el punto más alto for a second and Consejo: Only the muñeca should move.

name: Elevación lateral sentado
instructions: agarra a couple of mancuernas and siéntate at the end of a plano banco with tus pies firmly on el suelo. mantén the mancuernas with your palmas hacia in and tus brazos recto down a tus costados at arms' length. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), levanta the mancuernas a tu lado with una ligera flexión on the codo and the hands slightly tilted hacia adelante as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up hasta you arms are paralelo to el suelo. exhala as you ejecuta this movement and haz una pausa for a second en el punto más alto.
baja the mancuernas back down lentamente to the posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Press de hombros con bandas
instructions: To comienza, párate on an exercise banda so that tension begins at arm's length. agarra the handles and levanta them so that the hands are at hombro height at each side.

rota the muñecas so that the palms of tus manos are facing hacia adelante. tus codos should be bent, with the la parte superior de los brazos and antebrazos in line to the torso. esta es tu posición inicial.
As you exhala, levanta the handles up hasta tus brazos are completamente extended sobre la cabeza.

name: Elevación lateral
instructions: agarra a couple of mancuernas and párate with a recto torso and the mancuernas by your side at arms length with the palms of the hand facing you. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras maintaining the torso in a stationary posiciona (no swinging), levanta the mancuernas a tu lado with una ligera flexión on the codo and the hands slightly tilted hacia adelante as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up hasta you arms are paralelo to el suelo. exhala as you ejecuta this movement and haz una pausa for a second en el punto más alto.
baja the mancuernas back down lentamente to the posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación lateral a elevación frontal
instructions: In a standing posiciona, mantén a pair of mancuernas a tu costado. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo codos ligeramente flexionados, sube el pesos directly frente a ti to hombro height, avoiding any swinging or cheating.
en el punto más alto of the exercise move the weights out frente a ti, manteniendo arms extended.
baja el pesos with a controlado motion.
On the next repetition, sube el pesos frente a ti to hombro height antes moving the weights laterally a tu lados.
baja el pesos to the posición inicial.

name: Sentadilla una pierna en cajón alto
instructions: posiciona a box in a rack. Secure a banda or rope in coloca above the box.
Standing in front of it, da un paso onto the box to a full standing posiciona, letting your other leg remain unsupported. mantén onto the banda for balance
. Continue stepping up and down on the same leg antes switching to the opposite side.

name: Elevación simple con mancuerna
instructions: With a amplio stance, mantén a dumbell with both hands, grasping the head of the mancuerna instead of the handle. tus brazos should be extended and hanging at the waist. esta es tu posición inicial.
sube el peso hasta it is above hombro level, manteniendo arms extended. Your torso and caderas should remain stationary throughout the movement.
regresa a la posición inicial and repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Puente de glúteo una pierna
instructions: Lay on el suelo with tus pies plano and rodillas bent.
eleva one leg off of el suelo, pulling the rodilla to tu pecho. esta es tu posición inicial.
ejecuta the movement by driving through the heel, extending your cadera hacia arriba and raising tus glúteos off of el suelo.
extiende lo más lejos posible, haz una pausa and luego regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Abdominal completo
instructions: Lie down on el suelo placing tus pies either under something that will not move or by having a partner mantén them. tus piernas should be bent at the rodillas.
coloca tus manos detrás de tus head and lock them together by clasping your fingers. This is the posición inicial.
Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your muslos. exhala when performing this part of the exercise.
Once you feel the contraction for a second, baja your upper body back down to the posición inicial mientras inhaling.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación de hombros inclinada en máquina Smith
instructions: coloca an incline banco underneath the smith machine. coloca the barra at a height that you can reach when lying down and tus brazos are almost completamente extended. Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the incline banco and asegúrate de tus hombros are aligned right under the barra.
Using a al ancho de hombros pronated (palms hacia adelante) agarra, levanta the bar from the rack and mantén it recto over you with una ligera flexión at the codos. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras exhalas, levanta the bar up hasta tus brazos are completamente extended. Nota: The contraction should be felt around the hombros.
después a second haz una pausa, lleva the bar back down to the posición inicial mientras inhalas.
repite the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, coloca the bar back in the rack.

name: Sentadillas con bandas
instructions: To comienza out, asegúrate de that the exercise banda is at an even split between both the left and right side of the body. To do this, use tus manos to grab both sides of the banda and coloca both feet in the middle of the banda. tus pies should be al ancho de hombros from each other.

When holding the bandas, they should be the same height de cada lado. You should be using a agarre en pronación (palmas hacia adelante) and have the handles of the bandas junto a tus face for this exercise. This is the posición inicial.
lentamente comienza to flexiona the rodillas and baja the legs so that your muslos are paralelo to el suelo mientras exhaling.
Use the heel of tus pies to empuja tu cuerpo up to the posición inicial as you exhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación de pantorrilla de pie con barra
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To comienza, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, da un paso under the bar and coloca the bar on the back of tus hombros (slightly below the cuello).
mantén on to the bar using both arms at each side and levanta it off the rack by first pushing with tus piernas and at the same time straightening your torso.

da un paso away from the rack and posiciona tus piernas using a al ancho de hombros medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. mantén tu cabeza up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a recto back. The rodillas should be kept with una ligera flexión; never locked. esta es tu posición inicial. Consejo: For better rango de movimiento you may also coloca the ball of tus pies on a wooden block but be careful as this option requires more balance and a sturdy block.

eleva tus talones mientras exhalas by extending tus tobillos lo más alto posible and flexing your pantorrilla. asegúrate de que that the rodilla is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. mantén the posición contraída by a second antes you comienza to go back down.
Go back lentamente to the posición inicial mientras inhalas by lowering tus talones as you flexiona the tobillos hasta pantorrillas are stretched.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación de pantorrilla de pie con mancuerna
instructions: párate con torso upright holding two mancuernas in tus manos by your sides. coloca the ball of the foot on a sturdy and stable wooden board (that is around 2-3 inches erguido) mientras tus talones extiende off and touch el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.

With the toes pointing either recto (to hit all parts equally), inwards (for emphasis on the outer head) or outwards (for emphasis on the inner head), eleva the heels off el suelo as you exhala by contracting the pantorrillas. mantén the top contraction for a second.
As you inhala, go de vuelta a la posición inicial by lentamente lowering the heels.
repite durante las repeticiones recomendadas amount of times.

name: Curl inverso de pie con mancuernas
instructions: To comienza, párate recto with a mancuerna in each hand using a agarre en pronación (palmas hacia abajo). tus brazos should be completamente extended mientras tus pies are al ancho de hombros from each other. This is the posición inicial.

mientras holding the la parte superior de los brazos stationary, curl the weights mientras contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas. Only the antebrazos should move. Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a second as you aprieta the muscle.
lentamente comienza to lleva the mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Extensión de tríceps de pie con mancuerna
instructions: To comienza, párate up with a mancuerna held by both hands. tus pies should be about al ancho de hombros from each other. lentamente use both hands to grab the mancuerna and levanta it over tu cabeza hasta both arms are completamente extended.
The resistance should be resting in the palms of tus manos with your thumbs around it. The palm of the hands should be facing up towards el techo. esta es tu posición inicial.

manteniendo la parte superior de los brazos close to tu cabeza with codos in and perpendicular to el suelo, baja the resistance in a semicircular motion detrás de tus head hasta tus antebrazos touch tus bíceps. Consejo: The la parte superior de los brazos should remain stationary and only the antebrazos should move. inhala as you realiza this da un paso.
Go de vuelta a la posición inicial by using the tríceps to eleva the mancuerna. exhala as you realiza this da un paso.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Elevación frontal sobre cabeza con barra
instructions: To comienza, párate recto with a barra in tus manos. You should agarra la barra with palmas hacia abajo and a closer than al ancho de hombros agarra apart from each other.
tus pies should be al ancho de hombros from each other. tus codos should be ligeramente flexionados. This is the posición inicial.
levanta the barra up hasta it is directly over tu cabeza mientras exhaling. asegúrate de to mantén tus codos ligeramente flexionados when performing cada repetición.
Once you feel the contraction, comienza to baja the barra back down to the posición inicial as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl interior de bíceps de pie
instructions: párate up with a mancuerna in each hand being held at arms length. The codos should be close to the torso. tus piernas should be at about hombro's width apart from each other.
rota the palms of the hands so that they are facing hacia adentro in a neutro posiciona. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras holding the la parte superior de los brazos stationary, curl the weights out mientras contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas. Your muñeca should turn so that when the weights are completamente elevated you have agarre en supinación (palmas hacia arriba).

Only the antebrazos should move. Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level. Consejo: mantén the antebrazos aligned with your outer deltoids.
mantén the posición contraída for a second as you aprieta the bíceps.
lentamente comienza to lleva the mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala. Remember to rota the muñecas as you baja el peso para switch back to a agarre neutro.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Extensión de tríceps un brazo de pie con mancuerna
instructions: To comienza, párate up with a mancuerna held in one hand. tus pies should be about al ancho de hombros from each other. Now completamente extiende the arm with the mancuerna over tu cabeza. Consejo: The small finger of your hand should be facing el techo and the palm of your hand should be facing hacia adelante. The mancuerna should be sobre tus head.
esta es tu posición inicial.

manteniendo upper arm close to tu cabeza (codos in) and perpendicular to el suelo, baja the resistance in a semicircular motion detrás de tus head hasta your antebrazo touch your bicep. Consejo: The upper arm should remain stationary and only the antebrazo should move. inhala as you realiza this da un paso.
Go de vuelta a la posición inicial by using the tríceps to eleva the mancuerna. exhala as you realiza this da un paso.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.
Switch arms and repite the exercise.

name: Extensión de tríceps sobre cabeza con barra
instructions: To comienza, párate up holding a barra or e-z bar using a agarre en pronación (palmas hacia adelante) with tus manos closer than al ancho de hombros from each other. tus pies should be about al ancho de hombros.
Now elevate the barra sobre tus head hasta tus brazos are completamente extended. mantén tus codos in. esta es tu posición inicial.

manteniendo la parte superior de los brazos close to tu cabeza and codos in, perpendicular to el suelo, baja the resistance in a semicircular motion detrás de tus head hasta tus antebrazos touch tus bíceps. Consejo: The la parte superior de los brazos should remain stationary and only the antebrazos should move. inhala as you realiza this da un paso.
Go de vuelta a la posición inicial by using the tríceps to eleva the barra. exhala as you realiza this da un paso.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Extensión de tríceps con toalla de pie
instructions: To comienza, párate up with both arms completamente extended above the head holding one end of a towel with both hands. tus codos should be in and the arms perpendicular to el suelo with the palmas enfrentadas mientras tus pies should be al ancho de hombros from each other. This is the posición inicial.

Now communicate with your partner so that he/she can agarra the other side of the towel to apply resistance. manteniendo la parte superior de los brazos close to tu cabeza (codos in) and perpendicular to el suelo, baja the resistance in a semicircular motion detrás de tus head hasta tus antebrazos touch tus bíceps. Consejo: The la parte superior de los brazos should remain stationary and only the antebrazos should move. inhala as you realiza this da un paso.
Go de vuelta a la posición inicial by using the tríceps to eleva the towel. exhala as you realiza this da un paso.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Flexión suspendida
instructions: Anchor your suspension straps securely to the top of a rack or other object.

Leaning into the straps, take a handle in each hand and move into a empuja-up plank posiciona. You should be as close to paralelo to el suelo as you can manage with tus brazos completamente extended, maintaining good posture.
Maintaining a recto, rigid torso, descend lentamente by allowing the codos to flexiona.
Continue hasta tus codos break 90 degrees, pausing antes you extiende to regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Sentadilla dividida suspendida
instructions: Suspend your straps so the handles are 18-30 inches from el suelo.

Facing away from the setup, coloca your rear foot into the handle detrás de ti. mantén tu cabeza looking hacia adelante and tu pecho up, with your rodilla ligeramente flexionados. esta es tu posición inicial.
Descend by flexing the rodilla and caderas, lowering yourself to el suelo. mantén your weight on the heel of your foot and maintain your posture throughout the exercise.
en el punto más bajo del movimiento, reverse the motion, extending through the cadera and rodilla to regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Peso muerto con barra hexagonal
instructions: For this exercise load a trapecio bar, also known as a hex bar, to an appropriate weight resting on el suelo. párate in the center of the apparatus and agarra both handles.
baja tus caderas, look hacia adelante with tu cabeza and mantén tu pecho up.
comienza the movement by driving through the heels and extiende tus caderas and rodillas. Avoid rounding tu espalda at all times.
At the completion of the movement, baja el peso back to el suelo de forma controlada.

name: Crunch encogido
instructions: To comienza, lie down on el suelo or an exercise mat with tu espalda pressed against el suelo. tus brazos should be lying across your sides with the palmas hacia abajo.

tus piernas should be crossed by wrapping one tobillo around the other. lentamente elevate tus piernas up in the air hasta your muslos are perpendicular to el suelo with una ligera flexión at the rodillas. Nota: tus rodillas and toes should be paralelo to el suelo as opposed to the muslos.
Move tus brazos from el suelo and cross them so they are resting on tu pecho. This is the posición inicial.
mientras manteniendo la espalda baja pressed against el suelo, lentamente levanta your torso. Remember to exhala mientras realiza this part of the exercise.
lentamente comienza to baja your torso back down to the posición inicial mientras inhaling.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl en predicador dos brazos con mancuernas
instructions: Grab a mancuerna with each arm and coloca the la parte superior de los brazos on top of the preacher banco or the incline banco. The mancuerna should be held at hombro length. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras inhalas, lentamente baja the mancuernas hasta your upper arm is extended and the bíceps is completamente stretched.
As you exhala, use the bíceps to curl the weights up hasta tus bíceps is completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro height.
aprieta the bíceps hard for a second at the posición contraída and repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Fondos en banco con peso
instructions: For this exercise you will need to coloca a banco detrás de tus back and another one frente a ti. With the benches perpendicular to tu cuerpo, mantén on to one banco on its edge with the hands close to tu cuerpo, separated at al ancho de hombros. tus brazos should be completamente extended.

The legs will be extended hacia adelante on top of the other banco. tus piernas should be paralelo to el suelo mientras your torso is to be perpendicular to el suelo. Have your partner coloca the mancuerna on your lap. Nota: This exercise is best performed with a partner as placing the weight on your lap can be challenging and cause injury sin assistance. esta es tu posición inicial.

lentamente baja tu cuerpo as you inhala by bending at the codos hasta you baja yourself far enough to where there is an angle slightly smaller than 90 degrees between the upper arm and the antebrazo. Consejo: mantén the codos as close as possible throughout the movement. antebrazos should always be pointing down.
Using tus tríceps to lleva your torso up again, levanta yourself de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhaling.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Dominadas con peso
instructions: Attach a weight to a dip belt and secure it around your waist. Grab the jala-up bar with the palms of tus manos facing hacia adelante. For a medium agarra, tus manos should be spaced at al ancho de hombros. Both arms should be extended frente a ti holding the bar at the chosen agarra.
You'll want to lleva your torso back about 30 degrees mientras creating a curvature in your la espalda baja and sticking tu pecho out. esta es tu posición inicial.
Now, exhala and jala your torso up hasta tu cabeza is sobre tus hands. Concentrate on squeezing yourshoulder blades back and down as you reach the top posición contraída.

después a brief moment en el punto más alto posición contraída, inhala and lentamente baja your torso de vuelta a la posición inicial with tus brazos extended and tus dorsales completamente stretched.

name: Sentadilla con peso adicional
instructions: comienza by positioning two plano benches al ancho de hombros from each other. párate on top of them and envuelve the weighted belt around your waist with the amount of weight you feel cómodo with. asegúrate de tus dedos del pie are facing out.
Once you are standing recto up with the weight hanging in between tus piernas, posiciona tus brazos so that they are completamente extended to the side of tu cuerpo. This is the posición inicial.

comienza by bending the rodillas as you maintain a recto posture with the head up. Continue down hasta the angle between the upper leg and the pantorrillas becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below paralelo to el suelo). inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement. Consejo: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the rodillas should make an imaginary recto line with the toes that are perpendicular to the front. If tus rodillas are past that imaginary line (if they are past tus dedos del pie) luego you are placing undue stress on the rodilla and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.

comienza to move the body back up by pushing el suelo of the plano banco with the ball of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go de vuelta a la posición inicial. exhala as you realiza this portion of the exercise.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl de pie agarre ancho con barra
instructions: párate up with your torso upright mientras holding a barra at the amplio outer handle. The palm of tus manos should be facing hacia adelante. The codos should be close to the torso. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras holding the la parte superior de los brazos stationary, curl the weights hacia adelante mientras contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas. Consejo: Only the antebrazos should move.
Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the bar is at hombro level. mantén the posición contraída for a second and aprieta the bíceps hard.
lentamente comienza to lleva the bar de vuelta a la posición inicial as your inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl Zottman
instructions: párate up with your torso upright and a mancuerna in each hand being held at arms length. The codos should be close to the torso.
asegúrate de the palms of the hands are facing each other. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras holding the upper arm stationary, curl the weights mientras contracting the bíceps mientras exhalas. Only the antebrazos should move. Your muñeca should rota so that you have a supinated (palms up) agarra. Continue the movement hasta tus bíceps are completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro level.
mantén the posición contraída for a second as you aprieta the bíceps.
Now durante the posición contraída, rota your muñeca hasta you now have a pronated (palmas hacia abajo) agarra with the thumb at a higher posiciona than the pinky.
lentamente comienza to lleva the mancuernas back down using the agarre en pronación.
As the mancuernas close your muslos, comienza rotating the muñeca so that you go back to a neutro (palmas hacia tu cuerpo) agarra.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Curl Zottman en predicador
instructions: Grab a mancuerna in each hand and coloca your la parte superior de los brazos on top of the preacher banco or the incline banco. The mancuernas should be held at hombro height and the codos should be flexed. mantén the mancuernas with the palms of tus manos facing down. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras inhalas, lentamente baja the mancuernas manteniendo palms down hasta your upper arm is extended and tus bíceps are completamente stretched.
Now rota tus muñecas once you are en el punto más bajo del movimiento so that the palms of the hands are facing up.

As you exhala, use tus bíceps to curl the weights up hasta they are completamente contracted and the mancuernas are at hombro height. Again, remember that to asegúrate de que full contraction you need to lleva that small finger higher than the thumb.
aprieta the bíceps hard for a second at the posición contraída and rota tus muñecas so that the palms are facing down again.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Bicicleta de aire
instructions: Lie plano on el suelo with your la espalda baja pressed to el suelo. For this exercise, you will need to put tus manos beside tu cabeza. Be careful however to not strain with the cuello as you realiza it. Now levanta tus hombros into the crunch posiciona.
lleva rodillas up to where they are perpendicular to el suelo, with your baja legs paralelo to el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.

Now simultáneamente, lentamente go through a cycle pedal motion kicking hacia adelante with the right leg and bringing in the rodilla of the left leg. lleva your right codo close to your left rodilla by crunching to the side, mientras exhalas.
Go back to the initial posiciona mientras inhalas.
Crunch to the opposite side as you cycle tus piernas and lleva closer your left codo to your right rodilla and exhala.
Continue alternando in this manner hasta all of the recommended repetitions for each side have been completed.

name: Press Arnold con mancuernas
instructions: siéntate enn exercise banco with back support and mantén two mancuernas frente a ti at about upper pecho level with your palmas hacia tu cuerpo and tus codos bent. Consejo: tus brazos should be junto a tus torso. The posición inicial should look like the contracted portion of a mancuerna curl.
Now to realiza the movement, eleva the mancuernas as you rota the palms of tus manos hasta they are facing hacia adelante.
Continue lifting the mancuernas hasta tus brazos are extended sobre ti in recto arm posiciona. exhala as you realiza this portion of the movement.

después a second haz una pausa en el punto más alto, comienza to baja the mancuernas to the original posiciona by rotating the palms of tus manos towards you. Consejo: The left arm will be rotated in a counter clockwise manner mientras the right one will be rotated clockwise. inhala as you realiza this portion of the movement.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Rueda abdominal con barra
instructions: For this exercise you will need to colócate en a pushup posiciona, but instead of having tus manos of el suelo, you will be grabbing on to an Olympic barra (loaded with 5-10 lbs de cada lado) instead. esta es tu posición inicial.

mientras keeping una ligera curvatura on tu espalda, levanta tus caderas and roll the barra towards tus pies as you exhala. Consejo: As you realiza the movement, tus glúteos should be coming up, you should be manteniendo abs firme and should maintain tu espalda posture at all times. Also tus brazos should be staying perpendicular to el suelo throughout the movement. If you don't, you will work out tus hombros and back more than the abs.
después a second contraction en el punto más alto, comienza to roll the barra back hacia adelante to the posición inicial lentamente as you inhala.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Rueda abdominal con barra de rodillas
instructions: mantén an Olympic barra loaded with 5-10lbs de cada lado and kneel on el suelo.
Now coloca the barra on el suelo frente a ti so that you are on all tus manos and rodillas (as in a kneeling empuja up posiciona). esta es tu posición inicial.

lentamente roll the barra recto hacia adelante, stretching tu cuerpo into a recto posiciona. Consejo: Go down todo lo que puedas sin touching el suelo with tu cuerpo. inhala durante this portion of the movement.

después a second haz una pausa at the stretched posiciona, comienza pulling yourself de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras exhalas. Consejo: Go lentamente and mantén tus abdominales firme at all times.

name: Remo para deltoides posterior con barra
instructions: párate erguido mientras holding a barra using a amplio (higher than al ancho de hombros) and overhand (palmas hacia tu cuerpo) agarra.

flexiona rodillas slightly and flexiona over as you mantén the natural arquea of tu espalda. Let the arms hang frente a ti as they mantén the bar. Once your torso is paralelo to el suelo, flare the codos out and away from tu cuerpo. Consejo: Your torso and tus brazos should resemble the letter "T". Now you are ready to comienza the exercise.

mientras manteniendo la parte superior de los brazos perpendicular to the torso, jala the barra up towards your upper pecho as you aprieta the rear deltoides and you exhala. Consejo: When performed correctly, this exercise should resemble a banco presiona in reverse. Also, refrain from using tus bíceps to do the work. Focus on targeting the rear deltoides; the arms should only act as hooks.
lentamente go back to the initial posiciona mientras inhalas.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales 90/90
instructions: acuéstate boca arriba, with one leg extended recto out.
With la otra pierna, flexiona the cadera and rodilla to 90 degrees. You may brace your leg with tus manos if necessary. esta es tu posición inicial.
extiende your leg recto into the air, pausing briefly en el punto más alto. regresa the leg to the posición inicial.
repite durante 10-20 repetitions, and luego switch to la otra pierna.

name: Estiramiento de aductores
instructions: acuéstate boca abajo with one leg on a foam roll.
rota the leg so that the foam roll contacts against your inner muslo. Shift as much weight onto the foam roll as can be tolerated.
mientras trying to relaja the muscles if the inner muslo, roll over the foam between your cadera and rodilla, holding points of tension for 10-30 seconds. repite with la otra pierna.

name: Estiramiento de aductores e ingle
instructions: acuéstate boca arriba with tus pies raised towards el techo.
Have your partner mantén tus pies or tobillos. Abduct tus piernas todo lo que puedas. esta es tu posición inicial.
Attempt to aprieta tus piernas together for 10 or more seconds, mientras your partner prevents you from doing so.

Now, relaja the muscles in tus piernas as your partner pushes tus pies apart, stretching as far as is cómodo for you. Be sure to let your partner know when the stretch is adequate to prevent overstretching or injury.

name: Estiramiento de cuádriceps en cuatro apoyos
instructions: comienza off on tus manos and rodillas, luego levanta your leg off el suelo and mantén the foot with your hand.
Use your hand to mantén the foot or tobillo, manteniendo rodilla completamente flexed, stretching the cuádriceps and flexores de cadera.
Focus on extending tus caderas, thrusting them towards el suelo. mantén durante 10-20 seconds and luego cambia de lado.

name: Salto diagonal alterno
instructions: Assume a cómodo stance with one foot slightly in front of the other.
comienza by pushing off with the front leg, driving the opposite rodilla hacia adelante and lo más alto posible antes landing. Attempt to cover as much distance to each side with each bound.
It may help to use a line on el suelo to guage distance from side to side.
repite the sequence with la otra pierna.

name: Círculos de tobillo
instructions: Use a sturdy object like a squat rack to mantén yourself.

levanta the right leg in the air (just around 2 inches from el suelo) and realiza a circular motion with the big toe. Pretend that you are drawing a big circle with it. Consejo: One circle equals 1 repetition. Breathe normally as you realiza the movement.
When you are done with the right foot, luego repite with the left leg.

name: Tobillo sobre la rodilla
instructions: From a lying posiciona, flexiona tus rodillas and mantén tus pies on el suelo.
coloca your tobillo of one foot on your opposite rodilla.
agarra the muslo or rodilla of the bottom leg and jala both of tus piernas into the pecho. relaja tu cuello and hombros. mantén durante 10-20 seconds and luego cambia de lado.

name: Liberación miofascial del tibial anterior
instructions: comienza seated on el suelo with tus piernas bent and tus pies on el suelo.

Using a Muscle Roller or a rolling pin, apply pressure to the muscles on the outside of your espinillas. Work from just below the rodilla to above the tobillo, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. repite en el otro leg.

name: Círculos de brazos
instructions: párate up and extiende tus brazos recto out by the sides. The arms should be paralelo to el suelo and perpendicular (ángulo de 90 grados) to your torso. esta es tu posición inicial.
lentamente comienza to make circles of about 1 foot in diameter with each outstretched arm. Breathe normally as you realiza the movement.
Continue the circular motion of the outstretched arms for about ten seconds. luego reverse the movement, going the opposite direction.

name: Entrenador de piedra Atlas
instructions: This trainer is effective for developing Atlas Stone strength for those who don't have access to stones, and are typically made from bar ends or pesado pipe.
comienza by loading the desired weight onto the bar. Straddle the weight, wrapping tus brazos around the implement, bending at the caderas.

comienza by pulling the weight up past the rodillas, extending through the caderas. As the weight clears the rodillas, it can be lapped by resting it on your muslos and sitting back, hugging it tightly to tu pecho.
termina the movement by extending through tus caderas and rodillas to sube el peso lo más alto posible. The weight can be returned to the lap or to el suelo for successive repetitions.

name: Piedras Atlas
instructions: comienza with the atlas stone between tus pies. flexiona at the caderas to envuelve tus brazos verticalmente around the Atlas Stone, attempting to get your fingers underneath the stone. Many stones will have a small plano portion on the bottom, which will make the stone easier to mantén.
Pulling the stone into your torso, drive through the back half of tus pies to jala the stone from el suelo.
As the stone passes the rodillas, lap it by sitting hacia atrás, pulling the stone on top of your muslos.

siéntate low, getting the stone high onto tu pecho as you change your agarra to reach over the stone. párate, driving through with tus caderas. Close distance to the loading plataforma, and lean back, extending the caderas to get the stone lo más alto posible.

name: Peso muerto con eje
instructions: Approach the bar so that it is centered over tus pies. You feet should be about al ancho de la cadera. flexiona at the cadera to agarra la barra at al ancho de hombros, allowing your hombro blades to protract. Typically, you would use an over/under agarra.

With tus pies and your agarra set, take a big breath and luego baja tus caderas and flexiona the rodillas hasta your espinillas contact the bar. Look hacia adelante with tu cabeza, mantén tu pecho up and tu espalda arched, and comienza driving through the heels to move the weight hacia arriba.
después the bar passes the rodillas, aggressively jala the bar back, pulling your hombro blades together as you drive tus caderas hacia adelante into the bar.
baja the bar by bending at the caderas and guiding it to el suelo.

name: Arrastre hacia atrás
instructions: Load a sled with the desired weight, attaching a rope or straps to the sled that you can mantén onto.
comienza the exercise by moving backwards for a given distance. Leaning back, extiende through the legs for short steps to move as rápidamente as possible.

name: Lanzamiento hacia atrás con balón medicinal
instructions: This exercise is best done with a partner. If you lack a partner, the ball can be thrown and retrieved or thrown against a wall.
comienza standing a few meters frente a tir partner, both facing the same direction. comienza holding the ball between tus piernas.
Squat down and luego forcefully reverse direction, coming to full extension and you toss the ball over tu cabeza to your partner.
Your partner can luego roll the ball back to you. repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Buenos días con banda
instructions: Using a 41 inch banda, párate on one end, spreading tus pies a small amount. flexiona at the caderas to loop the end of the banda detrás de tus cuello. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo legs recto, extiende through the caderas to come to a near vertical posiciona.
asegúrate de que that you do not round tu espalda as you go down de vuelta a la posición inicial.

name: Buenos días con banda (tire a través)
instructions: Loop the banda around a post. Standing a little ways away, loop the opposite end around the cuello. tus manos can help mantén the banda in posiciona.

comienza by bending at the caderas, getting your butt back lo más lejos posible. mantén la espalda plana and flexiona hacia adelante to about 90 degrees. tus rodillas should be only ligeramente flexionados.
regresa a la posición inicial be driving through with the caderas to come back to a standing posiciona.

name: Puente de glúteo con barra
instructions: comienza seated on el suelo with a loaded barra over tus piernas. Using a fat bar or having a pad on the bar can greatly reduce the discomfort caused by this exercise. Roll the bar so that it is directly sobre tus caderas, and lay down plano on el suelo.
comienza the movement by driving through with tus talones, extending tus caderas verticalmente through the bar. Your weight should be supported by your la espalda alta and the heels of tus pies.
extiende lo más lejos posible, luego reverse the motion to regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Hip thrust con barra
instructions: comienza seated on el suelo with a banco directly detrás de ti. Have a loaded barra over tus piernas. Using a fat bar or having a pad on the bar can greatly reduce the discomfort caused by this exercise.
Roll the bar so that it is directly sobre tus caderas, and lean back against the banco so that your hombro blades are near the top of it.

comienza the movement by driving through tus pies, extending tus caderas verticalmente through the bar. Your weight should be supported by your hombro blades and tus pies. extiende lo más lejos posible, luego reverse the motion to regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Arrastre en cuatro patas con trineo
instructions: Wearing either a harness or a loose weight belt, attach the cadena to the back so that you will be facing away from the sled. flexiona down so that tus manos are on el suelo. tu espalda should be plano and rodillas bent. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza by driving with legs, alternando left and right. Use tus manos to maintain balance and to help jala. Try to mantén la espalda plana as you move over a given distance.

name: Estiramiento de pecho detrás de la cabeza
instructions: siéntate upright on el suelo with your partner detrás de ti.
coloca tus manos detrás de tus hand, and empuja tus codos back todo lo que puedas. Your partner should mantén tus codos. esta es tu posición inicial.
Gently attempt to jala tus codos hacia adelante with tus manos still detrás de tus head for 10 or more seconds. Your partner should prevent tus codos from moving.

Now, relaja your muscles and have your partner gently jala the codos back as far as it cómodo for you. Be sure to let your partner know when the stretch is adequate to prevent overstretching or injury.

name: Salto al banco
instructions: comienza with a box or banco 1-2 feet frente a ti. párate con los pies al ancho de hombros. esta es tu posición inicial.
realiza a short squat in preparation for the salta; balancea tus brazos detrás de ti.
Rebound out of this posiciona, extending through the caderas, rodillas, and tobillos to salta lo más alto posible. balancea tus brazos hacia adelante and up.
salta over the banco, landing with the rodillas bent, absorbing the impact through the legs.
Turn around and face the opposite direction, luego salta back over the banco.

name: Press de banca - Powerlifting
instructions: comienza by lying on the banco, getting tu cabeza beyond the bar if possible. Tuck tus pies underneath you and arquea tu espalda. Using the bar to help support your weight, levanta your hombro off the banco and retract them, squeezing the hombro blades together. Use tus pies to drive tus trapecios into the banco. Maintain this firme body posiciona throughout the movement.
However amplio your agarra, it should cover the ring on the bar. jala the bar out of the rack sin protracting tus hombros. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to jala it apart.
baja the bar to your baja pecho or upper stomach. The bar, muñeca, and codo should stay in line at all times.
haz una pausa when the barra touches your torso, and luego drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The codos should be tucked in hasta lockout.

instructions: ajusta the leader cadena, shortening it to the desired length.coloca the cadenas on the sleeves of the bar.

jala the bar out of the rack sin protracting tus hombros. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to jala it apart. baja the bar to your baja pecho or upper stomach. The bar, muñeca, and codo should stay in line at all times.
haz una pausa when the barra touches your torso, and luego drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The codos should be tucked in hasta lockout.

name: Sprint en banco
instructions: párate on el suelo with one foot resting on a banco or box with your heel close to the edge.
empuja off with your foot on top of the banco, extending through the cadera and rodilla.
aterriza with the opposite foot on top of the box, returning your other foot back to the comienza posiciona.
Continue alternando from one foot to another to completa the set.

instructions: To comienza, seat yourself on the bike and ajusta the seat to your height.

name: Press con tabla
instructions: comienza by lying on the banco, getting tu cabeza beyond the bar if possible. One to five boards, made out of 2x6's, can be screwed together and held in coloca by a training partner, bandas, or just tucked under your shirt.

baja the bar to the boards, and luego drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The codos should be tucked in hasta lockout.

name: Salto al cajón (múltiple)
instructions: Assume a relaxed stance facing the box or plataforma aproximadamente an arm's length away. Arms should be down at the sides and legs ligeramente flexionados.
Using the arms to aid in the initial burst, salta hacia arriba and hacia adelante, landing with feet simultáneamente on top of the box or plataforma.
Immediately baja or salta back down to the original starting coloca; luego repite the sequence.

name: Salto en cajón
instructions: You will need several boxes lined up about 8 feet apart.
comienza facing the first box with one leg slightly behind the other.
Drive off the back leg, attempting to gain as much height with the caderas as possible.

Immediately upon landing on the box, drive la otra pierna hacia adelante and hacia arriba to gain height and distance, leaping from the box. aterriza between the first two boxes with the same leg that landed on the first box.
luego, da un paso to the next box and repite.

name: Sentadilla en cajón
instructions: The box squat allows you to squat to desired depth and develop explosivo strength in the squat movement. comienza in a power rack with a box at the appropriate height detrás de ti. Typically, you would aim for a box height that brings you to a paralelo squat, but you can train higher or baja if desired.

comienza by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the hombros. aprieta your hombro blades together and rota tus codos hacia adelante, attempting to flexiona the bar across tus hombros. Remove the bar from the rack, creating a firme arquea in your la espalda baja, and da un paso back into posiciona. coloca tus pies wider for more emphasis on the back, glúteos, adductors, and isquiotibiales, or closer together for more quad development. mantén tu cabeza facing hacia adelante.

Set up the bandas on the sleeves, secured to either banda pegs, the rack, or mancuernas so that there is appropriate tension. If mancuernas are used, secure them so that they don't move. name: Liberación miofascial del braquial
instructions: Lie on your side, with your upper arm against the foam roller. The upper arm should be more or less aligned with tu cuerpo, with the outside of the bicep pressed against the foam roller.
eleva tus caderas off of el suelo, supporting your weight on your arm and on tus pies. mantén durante 10-30 seconds, and luego cambia de lado.

name: Estiramiento de pantorrilla con codos en pared
instructions: párate facing a wall from a couple feet away.
Lean against la pared, placing your weight on tus antebrazos.
Attempt to mantén tus talones on el suelo. mantén durante 10-20 seconds. You may move further or closer la pared, making it more or less difficult, respectively.

name: Estiramiento de pantorrilla con manos en pared
instructions: párate facing a wall from several feet away. Stagger your stance, placing one foot hacia adelante.
Lean hacia adelante and rest tus manos on la pared, manteniendo heel, cadera and head in a recto line.
Attempt to mantén your heel on el suelo. mantén durante 10-20 seconds and luego cambia de lado.

name: Liberación miofascial de pantorrillas
instructions: comienza seated on el suelo. coloca a foam roller underneath your baja leg. Your other leg can either be crossed over the opposite or be placed on el suelo, supporting some of your weight. esta es tu posición inicial.

coloca tus manos a tu lado or just detrás de ti, and presiona down to eleva tus caderas off of el suelo, placing much of your weight against your pantorrilla muscle. Roll from below the rodilla to above the tobillo, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. repite durante la otra pierna.

name: Peso muerto de auto
instructions: This event apparatus typically has agarre neutro handles, however some have a recto bar that you can approach like a normal deadlift. The apparatus can be loaded with a vehicle or other pesado objects como por ejemplo tractor tires or kegs.

Center yourself between the handles if you are a fuerte squatter, or back a couple inches if you are a fuerte deadlifter. You feet should be about al ancho de la cadera. flexiona at the cadera to agarra the handles. With tus pies and your agarra set, take a big breath and luego baja tus caderas and flexiona the rodillas.

Look hacia adelante with tu cabeza, mantén tu pecho up and tu espalda arched, and comienza driving through the heels to move the weight hacia arriba. As the weight comes up, jala your hombro blades together as you drive tus caderas hacia adelante.
baja el peso by bending at the caderas and guiding it to el suelo.

name: Paso carioca rápido
instructions: comienza with tus pies a few inches apart and your left arm up in a relaxed, athletic posiciona.
With your right foot, rápido da un paso behind and jala the rodilla up.

Fire tus brazos back up when you jala the right rodilla, being sure that your rodilla goes recto up and down. Avoid turning tus pies as you move and continue to look hacia adelante as you move to the side.

name: Estiramiento del gato
instructions: posiciona yourself on el suelo on tus manos and rodillas.
jala your belly in and round tu columna, la espalda baja, hombros, and cuello, letting tu cabeza baja.
mantén durante 15 seconds.

name: Atrapar y lanzar sobre cabeza
instructions: comienza standing mientras facing a wall or a partner.
Using both hands, posiciona the ball detrás de tus head, stretching as much as possible, and forcefully lanza the ball hacia adelante.

asegúrate de que that you follow your lanza through, being prepared to receive your rebound from your lanza. If you are throwing against la pared, asegúrate de that you párate close enough to la pared to receive the rebound, and aim a little higher than you would with a partner.

name: Extensión con mango de cadena
instructions: You will need two cable handle attachments and a plano banco, as well as cadenas, for this exercise. Clip the middle of the cadenas to the handles, and posiciona yourself on the plano banco. tus codos should be pointing recto up.
comienza by extending through the codo, manteniendo upper arm still, with tus muñecas pronated.
haz una pausa at the lockout, and reverse the motion to regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Press con cadenas
instructions: comienza by connecting the cadenas to the cable handle attachments. posiciona yourself on the plano banco in the same posiciona as for a mancuerna presiona. tus muñecas should be pronated and arms perpendicular to el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.
baja the cadenas by flexing the codos, unloading some of the cadena onto el suelo.
Continue hasta your codo forms a ángulo de 90 grados, and luego reverse the motion by extending through the codo to lockout.

name: Estiramiento de pierna extendida en silla
instructions: siéntate upright in a chair and agarra the seat on the sides.
eleva one leg, extending the rodilla, flexing the tobillo as you do so.
lentamente move that leg hacia afuera todo lo que puedas, and luego back to the center and down.
repite durante your other leg.

name: Estiramiento de espalda baja en silla
instructions: siéntate upright on a chair.
flexiona to one side with your arm over tu cabeza. You can mantén onto the chair with your free hand.
mantén durante 10 seconds, and repite durante your other side.

name: Estiramiento de tren superior en silla
instructions: siéntate en edge of a chair, gripping the back of it.
Straighten tus brazos, manteniendo back recto, and jala your upper body hacia adelante so you siente el estiramiento. mantén durante 20-30 seconds.

name: Estiramiento de pecho y deltoides anterior
instructions: comienza off by standing with tus piernas together, holding a bodybar or a broomstick.
Take a slightly wider than al ancho de hombros agarra on the pole and mantén it frente a ti with your palmas hacia abajo.
Carefully levanta the pole up and detrás de tus head.

name: Empuje de pecho desde 3 apoyos
instructions: comienza in a three point stance, squatted down with tu espalda plano and one hand on el suelo. coloca the medicine ball directly frente a ti.
To comienza, take your first da un paso as you jala the ball to tu pecho, positioning both hands to prepare for the lanza.
As you ejecuta the second da un paso, explosively release the ball hacia adelante as hard as possible.

name: Empuje de pecho (múltiple)
instructions: comienza in a kneeling posiciona facing a wall or utilize a partner. mantén the ball with both hands firme into the pecho.
ejecuta the pass by exploding hacia adelante and hacia afuera with the caderas mientras pushing the ball as hard as possible.
Follow through by falling hacia adelante, catching yourself with tus manos.
Immediately regresa to an upright posiciona. repite durante the número de repeticiones deseadas.

name: Empuje de pecho (simple)
instructions: comienza in a kneeling posiciona holding the medicine ball with both hands tightly into the pecho.
ejecuta the pass by exploding hacia adelante and hacia afuera with the caderas mientras pushing the ball lo más lejos posible.
Follow through by falling hacia adelante, catching yourself with tus manos.

name: Empuje de pecho con salida
instructions: comienza in an athletic stance with the rodillas bent, caderas back, and back plano. mantén the medicine ball near tus piernas. esta es tu posición inicial.
mientras taking your first da un paso draw the medicine ball into tu pecho.
As you take the second da un paso, explosively empuja the ball hacia adelante, immediately sprinting for 10 yards después the release. If you are really rápido, you can atrapa your own pass!

name: Estiramiento de pecho en pelota de estabilidad
instructions: Get on tus manos and rodillas next to an exercise ball.
coloca tus codos on top of the ball, manteniendo arm out a tu lado. esta es tu posición inicial.
baja your torso towards el suelo, manteniendo codo on top of the ball. mantén the stretch for 20-30 seconds, and repite with el otro brazo.

name: Postura del niño
instructions: Get on tus manos and rodillas, camina tus manos frente a ti.
baja your buttocks down to siéntate on tus talones. Let tus brazos drag along el suelo as you siéntate back to stretch your entire columna vertebral.
Once you settle onto tus talones, lleva tus manos junto a tus feet and relaja. "breathe" into tu espalda. Rest your forehead on el suelo. Avoid this posiciona if you have rodilla problems.

name: Estiramiento barbilla al pecho
instructions: colócate en a seated posiciona on el suelo.
coloca both hands at the rear of tu cabeza, fingers interlocked, thumbs pointing down and codos pointing recto ahead. lentamente jala tu cabeza down to tu pecho. mantén durante 20-30 seconds.

name: Campana de circo
instructions: The circus bell is an oversized mancuerna with a thick handle. comienza with the mancuerna between tus pies, and agarra the handle with both hands.
Clean the mancuerna by extending through tus caderas and rodillas to deliver the implement to the desired hombro, letting go with the extra hand.

asegúrate de que that you get one of the mancuerna heads behind the hombro to mantén from being thrown off balance. To eleva it sobre la cabeza, dip by flexing the rodillas, and the drive upwards as you extiende the mancuerna sobre la cabeza, leaning slightly away from it as you do so.
Carefully guide the bell back to el suelo, keeping it de forma controlada as much as possible. It is best to realiza this event on a thick rubber mat to prevent damage to el suelo.

name: Clean
instructions: With a barra on el suelo close to the espinillas, take an overhand (or hook) agarra just outside the legs. baja tus caderas with the weight focused on the heels, back recto, head facing hacia adelante, pecho up, with tus hombros just in front of the bar. esta es tu posición inicial.

comienza the first jala by driving through the heels, extending tus rodillas. tu espalda angle should stay the same, and tus brazos should remain recto. Move the weight with control as you continue to above the rodillas.

Next comes the second jala, the main source of acceleration for the clean. As the bar approaches the mid-muslo posiciona, comienza extending through the caderas. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending the caderas, rodillas, and tobillos, using speed to move the bar hacia arriba. There should be no need to actively jala through the arms to accelerate the weight; at the end of the second jala, the body should be completamente extended, leaning slightly back, with the arms still extended.

As full extension is achieved, transition into the third jala by aggressively shrugging and flexing the arms with the codos up and out. At peak extension, aggressively jala yourself down, rotating tus codos under the bar as you do so. Receive the bar in a front squat posiciona, the depth of which is dependent upon the height of the bar at the end of the third jala. The bar should be racked onto the protracted hombros, lightly touching the throat with the hands relaxed. Continue to descend to the bottom squat posiciona, which will help in the recovery.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, manteniendo torso upright and codos up. Continue hasta you have risen to a standing posiciona.

name: Peso muerto de clean
instructions: comienza standing with a barra close to your espinillas. tus pies should be directly under tus caderas with tus pies turned out slightly. agarra la barra with a double agarre en pronación or hook agarra, about al ancho de hombros. Squat down to the bar. tu columna should be in full extension, with a back angle that places tus hombros in front of the bar and tu espalda as vertical as possible.

comienza by driving through el suelo through the front of tus talones. As the bar travels hacia arriba, maintain a constant back angle. Flare tus rodillas out to the side to help mantén them out of the bar's path.
después the bar crosses the rodillas, completa the levanta by driving the caderas into the bar hasta tus caderas and rodillas are extended.

name: Tirón de clean
instructions: With a barra on el suelo close to the espinillas, take an overhand or hook agarra just outside the legs. baja tus caderas with the weight focused on the heels, back recto, head facing hacia adelante, pecho up, with tus hombros just in front of the bar. esta es tu posición inicial.

comienza the first jala by driving through the heels, extending tus rodillas. tu espalda angle should stay the same, and tus brazos should remain recto and codos out. Move the weight with control as you continue to above the rodillas.

Next comes the second jala, the main source of acceleration for the clean. As the bar approaches the mid-muslo posiciona, comienza extending through the caderas.
