In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending the caderas, rodillas, and tobillos, using speed to move the bar hacia arriba. There should be no need to actively jala through the arms to accelerate the weight; at the end of the second jala, the body should be completamente extended, leaning slightly back, with the arms still extended. Full extension should be violent and abrupt, and asegúrate de que that you do not prolong the extension for longer than necessary.

name: Encogimiento de clean
instructions: comienza with a al ancho de hombros, double overhand or hook agarra, with the bar hanging at the mid muslo posiciona. tu espalda should be recto and inclined slightly hacia adelante.
Shrug tus hombros towards your ears. mientras this exercise can usually by loaded with heavier weight than a clean, avoid overloading to the point that the execution slows down.

name: Clean y Jerk
instructions: With a barra on el suelo close to the espinillas, take an overhand or hook agarra just outside the legs. baja tus caderas with the weight focused on the heels, back recto, head facing hacia adelante, pecho up, with tus hombros just in front of the bar. esta es tu posición inicial.

comienza the first jala by driving through the heels, extending tus rodillas. tu espalda angle should stay the same, and tus brazos should remain recto. Move the weight with control as you continue to above the rodillas.

Next comes the second jala, the main source of acceleration for the clean. As the bar approaches the mid-muslo posiciona, comienza extending through the caderas. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending the caderas, rodillas, and tobillos, using speed to move the bar hacia arriba. There should be no need to actively jala through the arms to accelerate the weight; at the end of the second jala, the body should be completamente extended, leaning slightly back, with the arms still extended.

As full extension is achieved, transition into the third jala by aggressively shrugging and flexing the arms with the codos up and out. At peak extension, aggressively jala yourself down, rotating tus codos under the bar as you do so. Receive the bar in a front squat posiciona, the depth of which is dependent upon the height of the bar at the end of the third jala. The bar should be racked onto the protracted hombros, lightly touching the throat with the hands relaxed. Continue to descend to the bottom squat posiciona, which will help in the recovery.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, manteniendo torso upright and codos up. Continue hasta you have risen to a standing posiciona.

The second phase is the jerk, which raises the weight sobre la cabeza. Standing with the weight racked on the front of the hombros, comienza with the dip. With tus pies directly under tus caderas, flexiona the rodillas sin moving the caderas hacia atrás. Go down only slightly, and reverse direction as powerfully as possible.
Drive through the heels create as much speed and force as possible, and be sure to move tu cabeza out of the way as the bar leaves the hombros.

At this moment as the feet leave el suelo, the feet must be placed into the receiving posiciona as rápidamente as possible. In the brief moment the feet are not actively driving against the plataforma, the athletes effort to empuja the bar up will drive them down. The feet should be split, with one foot hacia adelante, and one foot back. Receive the bar with the arms locked out sobre la cabeza. regresa to a standing posiciona.

name: Clean desde bloques
instructions: With a barra on boxes or stands of the desired height, take an overhand or hook agarra just outside the legs. baja tus caderas with the weight focused on the heels, back recto, head facing hacia adelante, pecho up, with tus hombros just in front of the bar. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza the first jala by driving through the heels, extending tus rodillas. tu espalda angle should stay the same, and tus brazos should remain recto with the codos pointed out.

As full extension is achieved, transition into the receiving posiciona by aggressively shrugging and flexing the arms with the codos up and out. Aggressively jala yourself down, rotating tus codos under the bar as you do so. Receive the bar in a front squat posiciona, the depth of which is dependent upon the height of the bar at the end of the third jala. The bar should be racked onto the protracted hombros, lightly touching the throat with the hands relaxed. Continue to descend to the bottom squat posiciona, which will help in the recovery.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, manteniendo torso upright and codos up. Continue hasta you have risen to a standing posiciona. regresa the weight to the boxes for the next rep.

name: Rueda de Conan
instructions: With the weight loaded, take a zurcher mantén on the end of the implement. coloca the bar in the crook of the codo and mantén onto your muñeca. Try to mantén the weight off of the antebrazos.

comienza by lifting the weight from el suelo. mantén a firme, upright posture as you being to camina, taking short, rápido steps. Look up and away as you turn in a circle. Do not mantén your breath durante the event. Continue walking hasta you completa one or more completa turns.

name: Zancada inversa cruzada
instructions: párate con los pies al ancho de hombros. esta es tu posición inicial.
realiza a rear lunge by stepping back with one foot and flexing the caderas and front rodilla. As you do so, rota your torso across the front leg.
después a brief haz una pausa, regresa a la posición inicial and repite en el otro lado, continuing in an alternando fashion.

name: Crucifijo
instructions: In the crucifix, you statically mantén weights out to the side for time. mientras the event can be practiced using mancuernas, it is best to practice with one of the various implements used, como por ejemplo axes and hammers, as it feels different.

comienza standing, and eleva tus brazos out to the side holding the implements. tus brazos should be paralelo to el suelo. In competition, judges or sensors are used to let you know when you break paralelo. mantén durante as long as you can. Typically, the weights should be pesado enough that you fail in 30-60 seconds.

name: Estiramiento del bailarín
instructions: siéntate up on el suelo.
Cross your right leg over your left, manteniendo rodilla bent. Your left leg is recto and down on el suelo.
coloca your left arm on your right leg and your right hand on el suelo.
rota your upper body to the right, and mantén durante 10-20 seconds. cambia de lado.

name: Peso muerto con bandas
instructions: To deadlift with short bandas, simply loop them over the bar antes you comienza, and da un paso into them to set up. For long bandas, they will need to be anchored to a secure base, como por ejemplo pesado mancuernas or a rack.

With tus pies, and your agarra set, take a big breath and luego baja tus caderas and flexiona the rodillas hasta your espinillas contact the bar. Look hacia adelante with tu cabeza, mantén tu pecho up and tu espalda arched, and comienza driving through the heels to move the weight hacia arriba. después the bar passes the rodillas, aggressively jala the bar back, pulling your hombro blades together as you drive tus caderas hacia adelante into the bar.
baja the bar by bending at the caderas and guiding it to el suelo.

name: Peso muerto con cadenas
instructions: You can attach the cadenas to the sleeves of the bar, or just drape the middle over the bar so there is a greater weight increase as you levanta.

Approach the bar so that it is centered over tus pies. You feet should be about al ancho de la cadera. flexiona at the cadera to agarra la barra at al ancho de hombros, allowing your hombro blades to protract. Typically, you would use an agarre en pronación or an over/under agarra on heavier sets. With tus pies, and your agarra set, take a big breath and luego baja tus caderas and flexiona the rodillas hasta your espinillas contact the bar.

Look hacia adelante with tu cabeza, mantén tu pecho up and tu espalda arched, and comienza driving through the heels to move the weight hacia arriba. después the bar passes the rodillas, aggressively jala the bar back, pulling your hombro blades together as you drive tus caderas hacia adelante into the bar.
baja the bar by bending at the caderas and guiding it to el suelo.

name: Peso muerto en déficit
instructions: comienza by having a plataforma or weight plates that you can párate on, usually 1-3 inches in height. Approach the bar so that it is centered over tus pies. You feet should be about al ancho de la cadera. flexiona at the cadera to agarra la barra at al ancho de hombros, allowing your hombro blades to protract. Typically, you would use an agarre en pronación or an over/under agarra on heavier sets.

With tus pies, and your agarra set, take a big breath and luego baja tus caderas and flexiona the rodillas hasta your espinillas contact the bar. Look hacia adelante with tu cabeza, mantén tu pecho up and tu espalda arched, and comienza driving through the heels to move the weight hacia arriba. después the bar passes the rodillas, aggressively jala the bar back, pulling your hombro blades together as you drive tus caderas hacia adelante into the bar.
baja the bar by bending at the caderas and guiding it to el suelo.

name: Salto en profundidad
instructions: For this drill you will need two boxes or benches, one 12 to 16 inches high and the other 22 to 26 inches high.

párate on one of the two boxes with arms at the sides; feet should be together and slightly off the edge as in the depth salta. coloca the other box aproximadamente two or three feet in front of and facing the performer.
comienza by dropping off the initial box, landing and simultáneamente taking off with both feet.
Rebound by driving hacia arriba and hacia afuera as intensely as possible, using the arms and full extension of the body to salta onto the higher box. Again, allow the legs to absorb the impact.

name: Talón al glúteo dos piernas
instructions: comienza standing with tus rodillas ligeramente flexionados.
rápidamente squat a short distance, flexing the caderas and rodillas, and immediately extiende to salta for máximo vertical height.
As you go up, tuck tus talones by flexing the rodillas, attempting to touch the buttocks.
termina the motion by landing with the rodillas only partially bent, using tus piernas to absorb the impact.

name: Empuje en caída
instructions: posiciona low boxes or other platforms 2-3 feet apart.
Move to a pushup posiciona between them, supporting yourself by placing tus manos on the boxes.
With good posture, baja from the platforms by pressing up and moving tus manos to al ancho de hombros, cushioning your landing by absorbing the impact through the arm.

name: Press de suelo con mancuernas
instructions: Lay on el suelo holding mancuernas in tus manos. tus rodillas can be bent. comienza with the weights completamente extended sobre ti.
baja el pesos hasta your upper arm comes in contact with el suelo. You can tuck tus codos to emphasize tríceps size and strength, or to focus on tu pecho angle tus brazos to the side.
haz una pausa en el punto más bajo, and luego lleva the weight together en el punto más alto by extending through the codos.

name: Salto al cajón sentado con mancuernas
instructions: posiciona a box a couple feet to the side of a banco. mantén a mancuerna to tu pecho with both hands and seat yourself on the banco facing the box. esta es tu posición inicial.
Plant tus pies firmly on el suelo as you lean hacia adelante, extending through the caderas and rodillas to salta up and hacia adelante.
aterriza on the box with both feet, absorbing the impact by allowing the caderas and rodillas to flexiona.
da un paso down and regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Estiramiento dinámico de espalda
instructions: párate con los pies al ancho de hombros. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo arms recto, balancea them recto up frente a ti 5-10 times, increasing the rango de movimiento each time hasta tus brazos are sobre tus head.

name: Estiramiento dinámico de pecho
instructions: párate con hands together, arms extended directly frente a ti. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo arms recto, rápidamente move tus brazos back lo más lejos posible and back in again, similar to an exaggerated clapping motion. repite 5-10 times, increasing speed as you do so.

name: Círculos de codo
instructions: siéntate or párate con los pies slightly apart.
coloca tus manos on tus hombros with tus codos at hombro level and pointing out.
lentamente make a circle with tus codos. exhala as you comienza the circle and inhala as you completa the circle.

name: Codos atrás
instructions: párate erguido.
coloca both hands on your la espalda baja, fingers pointing hacia abajo and codos out.
luego gently jala tus codos back aiming to touch them together.

name: Máquina elíptica
instructions: To comienza, da un paso onto the elliptical and select the desired option from the menu. Most ellipticals have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned durante exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.
The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

name: Caminata del granjero
instructions: There are various implements that can be used for the farmers camina. These can also be performed with pesado mancuernas or short bars if these implements aren't available. comienza by standing between the implements.
después gripping the handles, levanta them up by driving through tus talones, manteniendo back recto and tu cabeza up.
camina taking short, rápido steps, and don't forget to breathe. Move for a given distance, typically 50-100 feet, as rápido as possible.

name: Salto con cuerda rápido
instructions: comienza in a relaxed posiciona with one leg slightly hacia adelante. esta es tu posición inicial.
Skip by executing a da un paso-hop pattern of right-right-da un paso to left-left-da un paso, and so on, alternando back and forth.
realiza rápido skips by maintaining close contact with el suelo and reduce air time, moving as rápidamente as possible.

name: Press de suelo
instructions: ajusta the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar. comienza lying on el suelo with tu cabeza near the end of a power rack. manteniendo hombro blades pulled together; jala the bar off of the hooks.

baja the bar towards the bottom of tu pecho or upper stomach, squeezing the bar and attempting to jala it apart as you do so. asegúrate de que that you tuck tus codos throughout the movement. baja the bar hasta your upper arm contacts el suelo and haz una pausa, preventing any slamming or bouncing of the weight.
presiona the bar back up as rápido as you can, manteniendo bar, tus muñecas, and codos in line as you do so.

name: Press de suelo con cadenas
instructions: ajusta the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar. For this exercise, drape the cadenas directly over the end of the bar, trying to mantén the ends away from the plates.
comienza lying on el suelo with tu cabeza near the end of a power rack. manteniendo hombro blades pulled together, jala the bar off of the hooks.

baja the bar towards the bottom of tu pecho or upper stomach, squeezing the bar and attempting to jala it apart as you do so. asegúrate de que that you tuck tus codos throughout the movement. baja the bar hasta your upper arm contacts el suelo and haz una pausa, preventing any slamming or bouncing of the weight.
presiona the bar back up as rápido as you can, manteniendo bar, tus muñecas, and codos in line as you do so.

name: Liberación miofascial del pie
instructions: This exercise stretches the fascia of the muscles in the feet. comienza off seated with your shoes removed. Using a foot roller or a similar object, como por ejemplo a small section of pvc pipe, coloca your foot against the roller across the arquea of your foot. esta es tu posición inicial.
presiona down firmly, rolling across the arquea of your foot. mantén durante 10-30 seconds, and luego switch feet.

name: Arrastre frontal con empuje
instructions: Attach a dual handled cadena or rope attachment to the sled. You should be facing away from the sled, holding a handle in each hand.

comienza the movement by moving hacia adelante for one da un paso. Leaning hacia adelante, extiende through the legs and caderas to move, pausing with each da un paso to extiende through the codos, pressing tus manos hacia adelante. da un paso hacia adelante hasta you regresa to the comienza posiciona prepared to presiona.

name: Sentadilla Frankenstein
instructions: This drill teaches you the proper positioning of both the bar and tu cuerpo durante the clean and front squat.

coloca the barra on the front of the hombros, releasing your agarra and extending tus brazos out frente a ti. The hombros should be pushed hacia adelante to create a shelf, and the bar should be in contact with the throat. asegúrate de que that you only move your hombro blades hacia adelante; don't round the thoracic columna vertebral.

Squat by flexing the rodillas and caderas, sitting in between tus piernas. mantén the torso upright, the arms up, and the hombros hacia adelante, and the bar should stay in coloca. Go to the bottom of the squat, hasta tus isquiotibiales contact tus pantorrillas.
regresa to the upright posiciona by driving through the front of the heel and extending the rodillas and caderas.

name: Saltos de rana
instructions: párate con hands detrás de tus head, and squat down manteniendo torso upright and tu cabeza up. esta es tu posición inicial.
salta hacia adelante several feet, avoiding jumping unnecessarily high. As tus pies contact el suelo, absorb the impact through tus piernas, and salta again. repite this action 5-10 times.

name: Salto frontal al cajón
instructions: comienza with a box of an appropriate height 1-2 feet frente a ti. párate con los pies should width apart. esta es tu posición inicial.
realiza a short squat in preparation for jumping, swinging tus brazos detrás de ti.
Rebound out of this posiciona, extending through the caderas, rodillas, and tobillos to salta lo más alto posible. balancea tus brazos hacia adelante and up.
aterriza on the box with the rodillas bent, absorbing the impact through the legs. You can salta from the box back to el suelo, or preferably da un paso down one leg at a time.

name: Saltos frontales con conos
instructions: Set up a row of cones or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart.
párate in front of the first cone with tus pies al ancho de hombros. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza by jumping with both feet over the first cone, swinging both arms as you salta.
Absorb the impact of landing by bending the rodillas, rebounding out of the first salta by jumping over the next cone.
Continue hasta you have jumped over all of the cones.

name: Elevaciones frontales de pierna
instructions: párate next to a chair or other support, holding on with one hand.
balancea your leg hacia adelante, manteniendo leg recto. Continue with a hacia abajo balancea, bringing the leg as far back as your flexibility allows. repite 5-10 times, and luego cambia de pierna.

name: Curl femoral invertido
instructions: comienza by adjusting the equipment to fit tu cuerpo. coloca tus pies against the footplate in between the rollers as you lie facedown. tus rodillas should be just behind the pad.

comienza from the bottom of the movement. mantén tu espalda arched as you comienza the movement by flexing the rodillas. Drive tus dedos del pie into the foot plate as you do so. mantén your upper body recto, and continue hasta tu cuerpo is upright.
regresa a la posición inicial, manteniendo descent de forma controlada.

name: Buenos días
instructions: comienza with a bar on a rack at hombro height. Rack the bar across the rear of tus hombros as you would a power squat, not on top of tus hombros. mantén tu espalda firme, hombro blades pinched together, and tus rodillas ligeramente flexionados. da un paso back from the rack.
comienza by bending at the caderas, moving them back as you flexiona over to near paralelo. mantén tu espalda arched and your cervical columna vertebral in proper alignment.
Reverse the motion by extending through the caderas with tus glúteos and isquiotibiales. Continue hasta you have returned to the posición inicial.

name: Buenos días desde pines
instructions: comienza with a bar on a rack at about the same height as your stomach. flexiona over underneath the bar and rack the bar across the rear of tus hombros as you would a power squat, not on top of tus hombros. At the proper height, you should be near paralelo to el suelo when bent over. mantén tu espalda firme, hombro blades pinched together, and tus rodillas ligeramente flexionados. mantén tu espalda arched and your cervical columna vertebral in proper alignment.

comienza the motion by extending through the caderas with tus glúteos and isquiotibiales, and you are standing with the weight. lentamente baja el peso back to the pins returning to the posición inicial.

name: Estiramiento de ingle y espalda
instructions: siéntate en floor with tus rodillas bent and feet together.
Interlock your fingers detrás de tus head. esta es tu posición inicial.
Curl downwards, bringing tus codos to the inside of your muslos. después a brief haz una pausa, regresa a la posición inicial with tu cabeza up and tu espalda recto. repite durante 10-20 repetitions.

name: Estiramiento dinámico de cadera
instructions: comienza in a pushup posiciona on el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.
Using both legs, salta hacia adelante landing with tus pies junto a tus hands. mantén tu cabeza up as you do so.
regresa a la posición inicial and immediately repite the movement, continuing for 10-20 repetitions.

name: Liberación miofascial de isquiotibiales
instructions: In a seated posiciona, extiende tus piernas over a foam roll so that it is posiciona on the back of the upper legs. coloca tus manos to the side or detrás de ti to help support your weight. esta es tu posición inicial.
Using tus manos, levanta tus caderas off of el suelo and shift your weight on the foam roll to one leg. relaja the isquiotibiales of the leg you are stretching.
Roll over the foam from below the cadera to above the back of the rodilla, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. repite durante la otra pierna.

name: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales
instructions: acuéstate boca arriba with one leg extended sobre ti, with the cadera at ninety degrees. mantén la otra pierna plano on el suelo.
Loop a belt, banda, or rope over the ball of your foot. esta es tu posición inicial.
jala on the belt to create tension in the pantorrillas and isquiotibiales. mantén this stretch for 10-30 seconds, and repite with la otra pierna.

name: Hang clean
instructions: comienza with a al ancho de hombros, double overhand or hook agarra, with the bar hanging at the mid muslo posiciona. tu espalda should be recto and inclined slightly hacia adelante.
comienza by aggressively extending through the caderas, rodillas and tobillos, driving the weight hacia arriba. As you do so, shrug tus hombros towards your ears.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, manteniendo torso upright and codos up. Continue hasta you have risen to a standing posiciona.

name: Hang clean debajo de las rodillas
instructions: comienza with a al ancho de hombros, double overhand or hook agarra, with the bar hanging just below the rodillas. tu espalda should be recto and inclined slightly hacia adelante.

comienza by aggressively extending through the caderas, rodillas and tobillos, driving the weight hacia arriba. As you do so, shrug tus hombros towards your ears. As full extension is achieved, transition into the third jala by aggressively shrugging and flexing the arms with the codos up and out.

At peak extension, aggressively jala yourself down, rotating tus codos under the bar as you do so. Receive the bar in a front squat posiciona, the depth of which is dependent upon the height of the bar at the end of the third jala. The bar should be racked onto the protracted hombros, lightly touching the throat with the hands relaxed. Continue to descend to the bottom squat posiciona, which will help in the recovery.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, manteniendo torso upright and codos up. Continue hasta you have risen to a standing posiciona.

name: Hang snatch
instructions: comienza with a amplio agarra on the bar, with an overhand or hook agarra. The feet should be directly below the caderas with the feet turned out. tus rodillas should be ligeramente flexionados, and the torso inclined hacia adelante. The columna vertebral should be completamente extended and the head facing hacia adelante. The bar should be at the caderas. esta es tu posición inicial.
Aggressively extiende through the legs and caderas. At peak extension, shrug the hombros and allow the codos to flexiona to the side.

As you move tus pies into the receiving posiciona, forcefully jala yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar sobre la cabeza. Receive the bar with tu cuerpo lo más bajo posible and the arms completamente extended sobre la cabeza.
regresa to a standing posiciona with the weight sobre la cabeza. Follow by returning the weight to el suelo de forma controlada.

name: Hang snatch debajo de las rodillas
instructions: comienza with a amplio agarra on the bar, with an overhand or hook agarra. The feet should be directly below the caderas with the feet turned out. tus rodillas should be ligeramente flexionados, and the torso inclined hacia adelante. The columna vertebral should be completamente extended and the head facing hacia adelante. The bar should be just below the rodillas. esta es tu posición inicial.
Aggressively extiende through the legs and caderas. At peak extension, shrug the hombros and allow the codos to flexiona to the side.

As you move tus pies into the receiving posiciona, forcefully jala yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar sobre la cabeza. Receive the bar with tu cuerpo lo más bajo posible and the arms completamente extended sobre la cabeza.
regresa to a standing posiciona with the weight sobre la cabeza, and luego regresa the weight to el suelo de forma controlada.

name: Buenos días colgado en barra
instructions: comienza with a bar on a rack at about the same height as your stomach. Suspend the bar using cadenas or suspension straps.

flexiona over underneath the bar and rack the bar across the rear of tus hombros as you would a power squat, not on top of tus trapecios. At the proper height, you should be near paralelo to el suelo when bent over. mantén tu espalda firme, hombro blades pinched together, and tus rodillas ligeramente flexionados. mantén tu espalda arched and your cervical columna vertebral in proper alignment.
comienza the motion by extending through the caderas with tus glúteos and isquiotibiales, and you are standing with the weight.
lentamente baja el peso de vuelta a la posición inicial, where it is supported by the cadenas.

name: Balance de snatch con impulso
instructions: This drill helps you learn the snatch. comienza by holding a ligero weight across the back of the hombros. tus pies should be slightly wider than al ancho de la cadera with the feet turned out, the same posiciona that you would realiza a squat with.
comienza by dipping with the rodillas slightly, and popping back up to briefly unload the bar. Drive yourself underneath the bar, elevating it sobre la cabeza as you descend into a full squat.
regresa to a standing posiciona.

name: Empuje de saco pesado
instructions: Utilize a pesado bag for this exercise. Assume an upright stance next to the bag, with tus pies staggered, fairly amplio apart. coloca your hand on the bag at about pecho height. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza by twisting at the waist, pushing the bag hacia adelante as hard as possible. realiza this move rápidamente, pushing the bag away from tu cuerpo.
Receive the bag as it swings back by reversing these steps.

name: Círculos de cadera boca abajo
instructions: posiciona yourself on tus manos and rodillas on el suelo. Maintaining good posture, eleva one bent rodilla off of el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo rodilla in a bent posiciona, rota the femur in an arc, attempting to make a big circle with your rodilla.
realiza this lentamente for a number of repetitions, and repite en el otro lado.

name: Elevación de cadera con banda
instructions: después choosing a suitable banda, lay down in the middle of the rack, después securing the banda on either side of you. If your rack doesn't have pegs, the banda can be secured using pesado mancuernas or similar objects, just asegúrate de que they won't move.
ajusta your posiciona so that the banda is directly over tus caderas. flexiona tus rodillas and coloca your pies planos en el suelo. tus manos can be on el suelo or holding the banda in posiciona.
manteniendo hombros on el suelo, drive through tus talones to eleva tus caderas, pushing into the banda as high as you can.
haz una pausa en el punto más alto of the motion, and regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Abrazar una pelota
instructions: Seat yourself on el suelo.
Straddle an exercise ball between both legs and baja tus caderas down toward el suelo.

Hug tus brazos around the ball to support tu cuerpo. ajusta tus piernas so that tus pies are plano on el suelo and tus rodillas line up over tus tobillos. mantén a good agarra on the ball so it doesn't roll away from you and send you back onto your buttocks.

name: Rodillas al pecho
instructions: Lie down on tu espalda and jala both rodillas up to tu pecho.
mantén tus brazos under the rodillas, not over (that would put to much pressure on your rodilla joints).
lentamente jala the rodillas toward tus hombros. This also stretches your buttocks muscles.

name: Saltos de valla
instructions: Set up a row of hurdles or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart.
párate in front of the first hurdle with tus pies al ancho de hombros. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza by jumping with both feet over the first hurdle, swinging both arms as you salta.
Absorb the impact of landing by bending the rodillas, rebounding out of the first salta by jumping over the next hurdle. Continue hasta you have jumped over all of the hurdles.

name: Estiramiento de cintilla iliotibial y glúteo
instructions: Loop a belt, rope, or banda around one of tus pies, and balancea that leg across tu cuerpo to the opposite side, manteniendo leg extended as you lay on el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo foot off of el suelo, jala on the belt, using the tension to jala the toes up. mantén durante 10-20 seconds, and repite en el otro lado.

name: Liberación miofascial de la cintilla iliotibial
instructions: Lay on your side, with the bottom leg placed onto a foam roller between the cadera and the rodilla. la otra pierna can be crossed frente a ti.
coloca as much of your weight as is tolerable onto your bottom leg; there is no need to mantén your bottom leg in contact with el suelo. Be sure to relaja the muscles of the leg you are stretching.
Roll your leg over the foam from you cadera to your rodilla, pausing for 10-30 seconds at points of tension. repite with the opposite leg.

name: Gusano
instructions: párate con los pies close together. manteniendo legs recto, stretch down and put tus manos on el suelo directly frente a ti. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza by walking tus manos hacia adelante lentamente, alternando your left and your right. As you do so, flexiona only at the cadera, manteniendo legs recto.
mantén going hasta tu cuerpo is paralelo to el suelo in a pushup posiciona.
Now, mantén tus manos in coloca and lentamente take short steps with tus pies, moving only a few inches at a time.
Continue walking hasta tus pies are by hour hands, manteniendo legs recto as you do so.

name: Salto en profundidad en flexión inclinada
instructions: For this drill you will need a box about 12 inches high, and two thick mats or aerobics steps.
coloca the steps just outside of tus hombros, and coloca tus pies on top of the box so that you are in an incline pushup posiciona, tus manos just inside the steps. esta es tu posición inicial.

comienza by bending at the codos to baja tu cuerpo, rápidamente reversing posiciona to empuja tu cuerpo off of el suelo. As you leave el suelo, move tus manos onto the steps, bending tus codos to absorb the impact.
repite the motion to regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Estiramiento de ingle intermedio
instructions: acuéstate boca arriba with tus piernas extended. Loop a belt, rope, or banda around one of tus pies, and balancea that leg as far to the side as you can. esta es tu posición inicial.
jala gently on the belt to create tension in your groin and isquiotibial muscles. mantén durante 10-20 seconds, and repite en el otro lado.

name: Estiramiento de flexores de cadera y cuádriceps
instructions: acuéstate boca abajo on el suelo, with a rope, belt, or banda looped around one foot.

flexiona the rodilla and extiende the cadera of the leg to be stretched, using both hands to jala on the belt. Your rodilla and your cadera should come off of el suelo, creating tension in the flexores de cadera and cuádriceps. mantén the stretch for 10-20 seconds, and repite en el otro leg.

name: Cruces de hierro
instructions: acuéstate boca abajo on el suelo, with tus brazos extended out a tu lado, palms pressed to el suelo. esta es tu posición inicial.
To comienza, flexiona one rodilla and lleva that leg across the back of tu cuerpo, attempting to touch it to el suelo near the opposite hand.
Promptly regresa the leg to the starting postion, and rápidamente repite with la otra pierna. Continue alternando for 10-20 repetitions.

name: Apretones isométricos de pecho
instructions: mientras either seating or standing, flexiona tus brazos at a ángulo de 90 grados and coloca the palms of tus manos together frente a tir pecho. Consejo: tus manos should be open with the palms together and fingers facing hacia adelante (perpendicular to your torso).
empuja both hands against each other as you contrae tu pecho. comienza with lento tension and increase lentamente. mantén breathing normally as you ejecuta this contraction.
mantén durante las repeticiones recomendadas number of seconds.
Now release the tension lentamente.
Rest durante las repeticiones recomendadas amount of time and repite.

name: Balance del jerk
instructions: This drill helps you learn to drive yourself low enough durante the jerk and corrects those who move hacia atrás durante the movement. comienza with the bar racked in the jerk posiciona, with the hombros hacia adelante, torso upright, and the feet split slightly apart.
Initiate the movement as you would a normal jerk, dipping at the rodillas mientras manteniendo torso vertical, and driving back up forcefully, using momentum and not tus brazos to elevate the weight.
mantén the rear foot in coloca, using it to drive tu cuerpo hacia adelante into a full split as you jerk the weight. Recover by standing up with the weight sobre la cabeza.

name: Sentadilla de impulso del jerk
instructions: This movement strengthens the dip portion of the jerk. comienza with the bar racked in the jerk posiciona, with the hombros hacia adelante to create a shelf and the bar lightly contacting the throat. The feet should be directly under the caderas, with the feet turned out as is cómodo.

manteniendo torso vertical, dip by flexing the rodillas, allowing them to travel hacia adelante and sin moving the caderas to the rear. The dip should not be excessive. regresa the weight to the posición inicial by driving forcefully though the feet.

name: Trote en cinta
instructions: To comienza, da un paso onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu. Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned durante exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.

Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than jogging outside. A 150 lb person will burn almost 250 calories jogging for 30 minutes, compared to more than 450 calories running. Maintain proper posture as you jog, and only mantén onto the handles when necessary, como por ejemplo when dismounting or checking your heart rate.

name: Carga de barril
instructions: To load kegs, coloca the desired number a distance from the loading plataforma, typically 30-50 feet.
comienza by grabbing the close handle of the first keg, tilting it onto its side to grab the opposite edge of the bottom of the keg. levanta the keg up to tu pecho.

The higher you can coloca the keg, the faster you should be able to move to the plataforma. Shouldering is usually not allowed. Be sure to mantén a firme mantén on the keg. Move as rápidamente as possible to the plataforma, and load it, extending through tus caderas, rodillas, and tobillos to get it lo más alto posible.
regresa a la posición inicial to retrieve the next keg, and repite hasta the event is completed.

name: Rodilla al lado opuesto
instructions: Lie down on el suelo with your right leg recto. flexiona your left leg and baja it across tu cuerpo, holding the rodilla down toward el suelo with your right hand. (The rodilla doesn't need to touch el suelo if you're firme.)

coloca your left arm comfortably beside you and turn tu cabeza to the left. Imagine you have a weight tied to your tailbone. let your tailbone fall back toward el suelo as tu pecho reaches in the opposite direction to stretch your la espalda baja. cambia de lado.

name: Círculos de rodilla
instructions: párate con legs together and hands by your waist.
Now move tus rodillas in a circular motion as you breathe normally.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Salto con rodillas al pecho
instructions: comienza in a cómodo standing posiciona with tus rodillas ligeramente flexionados. mantén tus manos frente a ti, palms down with your fingertips together at pecho height. esta es tu posición inicial.
Rapidly dip down into a quarter squat and immediately explode hacia arriba. Drive the rodillas towards the pecho, attempting to touch them to the palms of the hands.
salta as high as you can, raising tus rodillas up, and luego asegúrate de que a good aterriza be re-extending tus piernas, absorbing impact through be allowing the rodillas to rebend.

name: Ejercicio de brazos de rodillas
instructions: This drill helps increase arm efficiency durante the run. comienza kneeling, left foot in front, right rodilla down. Apply pressure through the front heel to mantén tus glúteos and isquiotibiales activated.
comienza by blocking the arms in long, pendulum like swings. Close the arm angle, blocking with the arms as you would when jogging, progressing to a run and finally a sprint.
As soon as tus manos pass the cadera, accelerate them hacia adelante durante the sprinting motion to move them as rápidamente as possible.
Switch rodillas and repite.

name: Estiramiento de antebrazo de rodillas
instructions: comienza by kneeling on a mat with your palms plano and your fingers pointing back toward tus rodillas.
lentamente lean back manteniendo palms plano on el suelo hasta you siente el estiramiento in tus muñecas and antebrazos. mantén durante 20-30 seconds.

name: Estiramiento de flexores de cadera de rodillas
instructions: Kneel on a mat and lleva your right rodilla up so the bottom of your foot is on el suelo and extiende your left leg out detrás de ti so the top of your foot is on el suelo.
Shift your weight hacia adelante hasta you siente el estiramiento in your cadera. mantén durante 15 seconds, luego repite durante your other side.

name: Sentadilla con salto de rodillas
instructions: comienza kneeling on el suelo with a barra racked across the back of tus hombros, or you can use tu cuerpo weight for this exercise. This can be done inside of a power rack to make unracking easier.
siéntate back with tus caderas hasta tus glúteos touch tus pies, manteniendo head and pecho up.
Explode up with tus caderas, generating enough power to aterriza with your pies planos en el suelo.
Continue with the squat by driving through tus talones and extending the rodillas to come to a standing posiciona.

name: Sentadilla de rodillas
instructions: Set the bar to the proper height in a power rack. Kneel behind the bar; it may be beneficial to put a mat down to pad tus rodillas. Slide under the bar, racking it across the back of tus hombros. Your hombro blades should be retracted and the bar firme across tu espalda. Unrack the weight.
With tu cabeza looking hacia adelante, siéntate back with your butt hasta you touch tus pantorrillas.
Reverse the motion, returning the torso to an upright posiciona.

name: Salto lateral
instructions: Assume a half squat posiciona facing 90 degrees from your direction of travel. esta es tu posición inicial.
Allow your lead leg to do a countermovement hacia adentro as you shift your weight to the outside leg.
Immediately empuja off and extiende, attempting to bound to the side lo más lejos posible.
Upon landing, immediately empuja off in the opposite direction, returning to your original comienza posiciona.
Continue back and forth for several repetitions.

name: Salto lateral al cajón
instructions: Assume a cómodo standing posiciona, with a short box positioned next to you. esta es tu posición inicial.
rápidamente dip into a quarter squat to initiate the stretch reflex, and immediately reverse direction to salta up and to the side.
lleva tus rodillas high enough to asegúrate de que tus pies have good clearance over the box.
aterriza on the center of the box, using tus piernas to absorb the impact.
Carefully salta down to the other side of the box, and continue going back and forth for several repetitions.

name: Saltos laterales con conos
instructions: posiciona a number of cones in a row several feet apart.
párate next to the end of the cones, facing 90 degrees to the direction of travel. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza the salta by dipping with the rodillas to initiate a stretch reflex, and immediately reverse direction to empuja off el suelo, jumping up and sideways over the cone.
Use tus piernas to absorb impact upon landing, and rebound into the next salta, continuing down the row of cones.

name: Liberación miofascial del dorsal ancho
instructions: mientras lying on el suelo, coloca a foam roll under tu espalda and to one side, just detrás de tus arm pit. esta es tu posición inicial.

mantén the arm of the side being stretched behind and to the side of you as you shift your weight onto tus dorsales, manteniendo upper body off of el suelo. mantén durante 10-30 seconds, and cambia de lado.

name: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales con pierna elevada
instructions: Lie plano on tu espalda, flexiona one rodilla, and put that foot plano on el suelo to stabilize tu columna.

extiende la otra pierna in the air. If you're firme, you wont be able to straighten it. That's okay. extiende the rodilla so that the sole of the lifted foot faces el techo (or as close as you can get it).
lentamente straighten the legs as much as possible and luego jala the leg toward your nose. cambia de lado.

name: Técnica de inicio lineal en 3 partes
instructions: This drill helps you accelerate as rápidamente as possible into a sprint from a dead stop. It helps to use a line to comienza from. comienza with two feet on the line. coloca your left foot with the toe junto a tus right tobillo. coloca your right foot 4-6 inches behind the left.
coloca your right hand onto the line, and thing lleva your nose close to your left rodilla.
Squat down as you lean foward, tu cabeza being baja than tus caderas and your weight loaded onto the left leg. esta es tu posición inicial.
Take your left hand up so that it is paralelo to el suelo, pointing detrás de ti, and explode out when ready.

name: Ejercicio de aceleración lineal en pared
instructions: Lean at around 45 degrees against a wall. tus pies should be together, glúteos contracted.
comienza by lifting your right rodilla rápidamente, pausing, and luego driving it recto down into el suelo.
cambia de pierna, raising the opposite rodilla, and luego attacking el suelo recto down.
repite once more with your right leg, and as soon as the right foot strikes el suelo hammer them out rapidly, alternando left and right as rápido as you can.

name: Salto lineal en profundidad
instructions: You will need two boxes or benches spaced a few feet away from each other. comienza by standing on one box facing towards the other plataforma.
To initiate the movement, gently baja down to el suelo between your platforms, allowing the rodillas and caderas to flexiona.
Reverse the motion by exploding, extending through the caderas, rodillas, and tobillos to salta onto the other plataforma.
aterriza softly, asborbing the impact through the legs.

name: Levantamiento de tronco
instructions: comienza standing with the log frente a ti. agarra the handles, and comienza to clean the log. As you are bent over to comienza the clean, attempt to get the log lo más alto posible, pulling it into tu pecho. extiende through the caderas and rodillas to lleva it up to completa the clean.

empuja tu cabeza back and look up, creating a shelf on tu pecho to rest the log. comienza the presiona by dipping, flexing slightly through the rodillas and reversing the motion. This empuja presiona will generate momentum to comienza the log moving verticalmente. Continue by extending through the codos to presiona the log sobre tus head. There are no strict rules on form, so use whatever techniques you are most efficient with. As the log is pressed, asegúrate de que that you empuja tu cabeza through on cada repetición, looking hacia adelante.
repite as many times as possible. Attempt to control the descent of the log as it is returned to el suelo.

name: Mirar al techo
instructions: Kneel on el suelo, holding tus talones with both hands.
levanta your buttocks up and hacia adelante mientras bringing tu cabeza back to look up at el techo, to give an arquea in tu espalda.

name: Liberación miofascial de espalda baja
instructions: In a seated posiciona, coloca a foam roll under your la espalda baja. Cross tus brazos frente a ti and protract tus hombros. esta es tu posición inicial.

eleva tus caderas off of el suelo and lean back, manteniendo weight on your la espalda baja. Now shift your weight slightly to one side, manteniendo weight off of the columna vertebral and on the muscles to the side of it. Roll over your la espalda baja, holding points of tension for 10-30 seconds. repite en el otro lado.

name: Curl de espalda baja
instructions: acuéstate boca abajo with tus brazos out a tu lados. esta es tu posición inicial.

Using your la espalda baja muscles, extiende tu columna lifting tu pecho off of el suelo. Do not use tus brazos to empuja yourself up. mantén tu cabeza up durante the movement. repite durante 10-20 repetitions.

name: Estiramiento de ingle acostado rodilla flexionada
instructions: acuéstate boca arriba with tus rodillas bent and the soles of the feet pressed together. Have your partner mantén tus rodillas. esta es tu posición inicial.
Attempt to aprieta tus rodillas together, mientras your partner prevents any movement from occurring.
después 10-20 seconds, relaja your muscles as your partner gently pushes tus rodillas towards el suelo. Be sure to inform your helper when the stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching.

name: Cruce acostado
instructions: acuéstate boca arriba with tus piernas extended.

Cross one leg over tu cuerpo with the rodilla bent, attempting to touch the rodilla to el suelo. Your partner should kneel beside you, holding your hombro down with one hand and controlling the crossed leg with the other. esta es tu posición inicial.
Attempt to eleva the bent rodilla off of el suelo as your partner prevents any actual movement.
después 10-20 seconds, relaja the leg as your partner gently presses the rodilla towards el suelo. repite with the other side.

name: Estiramiento de glúteo acostado
instructions: acuéstate boca arriba with your partner kneeling beside you.

flexiona the cadera of one leg, raising it off of el suelo. rota the leg so the foot is over the opposite cadera, the baja leg perpendicular to tu cuerpo. Your partner should mantén the rodilla and tobillo in coloca. esta es tu posición inicial.
Attempt to empuja your leg towards your partner, who should be preventing any actual movement of the leg.

después 10-20 seconds, completely relaja as your partner gently pushes the tobillo and rodilla towards tu pecho. Be sure to inform your helper when the stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching.

name: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales acostado
instructions: acuéstate boca arriba with tus piernas extended. Your partner should be kneeling beside you. eleva one leg up towards el techo and have your partner mantén the tobillo. Your partner can use their hombro to brace your leg if necessary. esta es tu posición inicial.
With your partner holding your leg in coloca, attempt to flexiona the rodilla, contracting the isquiotibiales for 10-20 seconds.

luego relaja your leg, allowing your partner to gently empuja the leg towards tu cabeza. Be sure to inform your helper when the stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching. cambia de lado once completa.

name: Estiramiento de cuádriceps boca abajo
instructions: Lay face down on el suelo with your partner kneeling beside you. flexiona one rodilla and eleva that leg off el suelo, attempting to touch tus glúteos with your foot. Your partner should mantén the rodilla and tobillo. esta es tu posición inicial.
Attempt to extiende your rodilla mientras your partner prevents any actual movement.
después 10-20 seconds, relaja your muscles as your partner gently pushes the foot towards tus glúteos, further stretching the cuádriceps and flexores de cadera.
después 10-20 seconds, cambia de lado.

name: Pase de pecho con balón medicinal
instructions: You will need a partner for this exercise. Lacking one, this movement can be performed against a wall.
comienza facing your partner holding the medicine ball at your torso with both hands.
jala the ball to tu pecho, and reverse the motion by extending through the codos. For sports applications, you can take a da un paso as you lanza.
Your partner should atrapa the ball, and lanza it back to you.
Receive the lanza with both hands at pecho height.

name: Giro completo con balón medicinal
instructions: For this exercise you will need a medicine ball and a partner. párate back to back with your partner, spaced 2-3 feet apart. esta es tu posición inicial.
mantén the ball in front of the trunk. Open the caderas and turn the hombros at the same time as your partner.
For full rotation, you and your partner should gira in the same direction, i.e. counter-clockwise.
Pass the ball to your partner, and both of you can now gira in the opposite direction to repite the procedure.

name: Lanzamiento cuchara con balón medicinal
instructions: Assume a semisquat stance with a medicine ball in tus manos. tus brazos should hang so the ball is near tus pies.
comienza by thrusting the caderas hacia adelante as you extiende through the legs, jumping up.
As you do, balancea tus brazos up and over tu cabeza, manteniendom extended, releasing the ball at the peak of your movement. The goal is to lanza the ball the greatest distance detrás de ti.

name: Estiramiento de espalda media
instructions: párate so tus pies are al ancho de hombros and tus manos are on tus caderas.
gira at your waist hasta you siente el estiramiento. mantén durante 10 to 15 seconds, luego gira to the other side.

name: Escaladores de montaña
instructions: comienza in a pushup posiciona, with your weight supported by tus manos and toes. Flexing the rodilla and cadera, lleva one leg hasta the rodilla is aproximadamente under the cadera. esta es tu posición inicial.

Explosively reverse the positions of tus piernas, extending the bent leg hasta the leg is recto and supported by the toe, and bringing the other foot up with the cadera and rodilla flexed. repite in an alternando fashion for 20-30 seconds.

name: Serie de garras en movimiento
instructions: This move helps prepare your running form to help you excel at sprinting. As you run, be sure to flexiona the rodilla, aiming to patea tus glúteos as the cadera extends.
Reload the quad as the leg moves back hacia adelante, attacking el suelo on the next da un paso.
asegúrate de que that as you run, you block with the arms, punching through in a rapid 1-2 motion.

name: Muscle snatch
instructions: comienza with a loaded barra held at the mid muslo posiciona with a amplio agarra. The feet should be directly below the caderas, with the feet turned out as needed. baja the caderas, with the pecho up and the head looking hacia adelante. The hombros should be just in front of the bar. This will be the posición inicial.

comienza the jala by driving through the front of the heels, raising the bar. Transition into the second jala by extending through the caderas rodillas and tobillos, driving the bar up as rápidamente as possible. The bar should be close to the body.
Continue raising the bar to the sobre la cabeza posiciona, sin rebending the rodillas.

name: Liberación miofascial del cuello
instructions: Using a muscle roller or a rolling pin, coloca the roller detrás de tus head and against tu cuello. asegúrate de that you do not coloca the roller directly against the columna vertebral, but turned slightly so that the roller is pressed against the muscles to either side of the columna vertebral. esta es tu posición inicial.
Starting en el punto más alto of tu cuello, lentamente roll down the muscles of tu cuello, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds.

name: Sentadilla olímpica
instructions: comienza with a barra supported on top of the trapecios. The pecho should be up, and the head facing hacia adelante. Adopt a al ancho de la cadera stance with the feet turned out as needed.

Descend by flexing the rodillas, refraining from moving the caderas back as much as possible. This requires that the rodillas travel hacia adelante; asegúrate de que that they stay aligned with the feet. The goal is to mantén the torso as upright as possible. Continue all the way down, manteniendo weight on the front of the heel.
At the moment the upper legs contact the baja, reverse the motion, driving the weight hacia arriba.

name: Estiramiento de cuádriceps boca arriba
instructions: acuéstate en plano banco or da un paso, and hang one leg and arm over the side.
flexiona the rodilla and mantén the top of the foot. As you do this, be careful not to arquea your la espalda baja.

jala the belly button to the columna vertebral to stay in neutro. presiona your foot down and into your hand. To add the cadera stretch, levanta the cadera of the leg you're holding up toward el techo.
cambia de lado.

name: Estiramiento de cuádriceps de lado
instructions: comienza off by lying on your right side, with your right rodilla bent at a ángulo de 90 grados resting on el suelo frente a ti (this stabilizes the torso).

flexiona your left rodilla detrás de ti and mantén your left foot with your left hand. To stretch your cadera flexor, presiona your left cadera hacia adelante as you empuja your left foot back into your hand. cambia de lado.

name: Un brazo contra la pared
instructions: From a standing posiciona, coloca a bent arm against a wall or doorway.
lentamente lean toward your arm hasta you siente el estiramiento in tus dorsales.

name: Media langosta
instructions: Lie facedown on el suelo.
Put your left hand under your left hipbone to pad your cadera and pubic bone.
flexiona your right rodilla so you can mantén the foot in your right hand.

levanta the foot in the air and simultáneamente levanta tus hombros off el suelo. This also stretches the right cadera flexor and the pecho and hombros. cambia de lado. If it doesn't bother tu espalda, you can try it with both arms and legs at the same time.

name: Colgada un brazo
instructions: Grab onto a chinup bar with one hand, using a agarre en pronación. mantén tus pies on el suelo or a da un paso. Allow the majority of your weight to hang from that hand, mientras manteniendo feet on el suelo. mantén durante 10-20 seconds and cambia de lado.

name: Una rodilla al pecho
instructions: comienza off by lying on el suelo.
extiende one leg recto and jala the other rodilla to tu pecho. mantén under the rodilla joint to protect the kneecap.
Gently tug that rodilla toward your nose.
cambia de lado. This stretches the buttocks and la espalda baja of the bent leg and the cadera flexor of the recto leg.

name: Estiramiento del dorsal sobre cabeza
instructions: siéntate upright on el suelo with your partner detrás de ti. eleva one arm recto up, and flexiona the codo, attempting to touch your hand to tu espalda. Your parner should mantén your tricep and muñeca. esta es tu posición inicial.
Attempt to jala your upper arm a tu lado as your partner prevents you from doing actually doing so.
después 10-20 seconds, relaja the arm and allow your partner to further stretch the dorsal by applying gentle pressure to the tricep. mantén durante 10-20 seconds, and luego cambia de lado.

name: Golpe sobre cabeza
instructions: mantén a medine ball with both hands and párate con los pies at al ancho de hombros. esta es tu posición inicial.
Initiate the countermovement by raising the ball sobre tus head and completamente extending tu cuerpo.
Reverse the motion, slamming the ball into el suelo directly frente a ti as hard as you can.
Receive the ball with both hands on the bounce and repite the movement.

name: Sentadilla sobre cabeza
instructions: comienza out by having a barra frente a ti on el suelo. tus pies should be wider than al ancho de hombros from each other.

flexiona the rodillas and use a agarre en pronación (palmas hacia you) to agarra la barrabell. tus manos should be at a wider than al ancho de hombros from each other antes lifting. Once you are positioned, levanta the barra up hasta you can rest it on tu pecho.

Move the barra over and slightly detrás de tus head and asegúrate de tus brazos are completamente extended. mantén tu cabeza up at all times and also maintain a recto back. Retract your hombro blades. esta es tu posición inicial.

lentamente baja el peso by bending tus rodillas hasta your muslos are paralelo to el suelo mientras inhaling. Consejo: mantén la espalda recta mientras performing this exercise to avoid any injuries and tus brazos should remain extended and over tu cabeza at all times.
Now use tus pies and legs to help lleva the weight back up to the posición inicial mientras exhaling.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Estiramiento sobre cabeza
instructions: Standing recto up, lace your fingers together and open your palms to el techo. mantén tus hombros down as you extiende tus brazos up.
To create a full torso stretch, jala your tailbone down and stabilize your torso as you do this. Stretch the muscles on both the front and the back of the torso.

name: Estiramiento de tríceps sobre cabeza
instructions: siéntate upright on el suelo with your partner detrás de ti. eleva one arm recto up, and flexiona the codo, attempting to touch your hand to tu espalda. Your parner should mantén your codo and muñeca. esta es tu posición inicial.
Attempt to extiende the arm recto into the air as your partner prevents you from doing actually doing so.
después 10-20 seconds, relaja the arm and allow your partner to further stretch the tricep by applying gentle pressure to the muñeca. mantén durante 10-20 seconds, and luego cambia de lado.

name: Inclinación pélvica a puente
instructions: Lie down with tus pies on el suelo, heels directly under tus rodillas.
levanta only your tailbone to el techo to stretch your la espalda baja. (Don't levanta the entire columna vertebral yet.) jala in your stomach.
To go into a bridge, levanta the entire columna vertebral except the cuello.

name: Liberación miofascial de peroneos
instructions: Lay on your side, supporting your weight on your antebrazo and on a foam roller placed on the outside of your baja leg. Your upper leg can either be on top of your baja leg, or you can cross it frente a ti. esta es tu posición inicial.
eleva tus caderas off of el suelo and comienza to roll from below the rodilla to above the tobillo on the side of your leg, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. repite en el otro leg.

name: Estiramiento de peroneos
instructions: In a seated posiciona, loop a belt, rope, or banda around one foot. esta es tu posición inicial.

With the leg extended and the heel off of el suelo, jala on the belt so that the foot is inverted, with the inside of the foot being pulled towards you. mantén durante 10-20 seconds, and luego cambia de lado.

name: Press desde pines
instructions: Pin presses remove the eccentric phase of the banco presiona, developing starting strength. They also allow you to train a desired rango de movimiento.

The banco should be set up in a power rack. Set the pins to the desired point in your rango de movimiento, whether it just be lockout or an inch off of tu pecho. The bar should be moved to the pins and prepared for lifting.

comienza by lying on the banco, with the bar directly above the contact point durante your regular banco. Tuck tus pies underneath you and arquea tu espalda. Using the bar to help support your weight, levanta your hombro off the banco and retract them, squeezing the hombro blades together. Use tus pies to drive tus trapecios into the banco. Maintain this firme body posiciona throughout the movement.

You can take a standard banco agarra, or al ancho de hombros to focus on the tríceps. The bar, muñeca, and codo should stay in line at all times. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to jala it apart.
Drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The codos should be tucked in hasta lockout.
regresa the bar to the pins, pausing antes beginning the next repetition.

name: Liberación miofascial del piriforme
instructions: siéntate with your buttocks on top of a foam roll. flexiona tus rodillas, and luego cross one leg so that the tobillo is over the rodilla. esta es tu posición inicial.

Shift your weight to the side of the crossed leg, rolling over the buttocks hasta que sientas tension in your upper glúteo. You may assist the stretch by using one hand to jala the bent rodilla towards tu pecho. mantén esta posición for 10-30 seconds, and luego cambia de lado.

name: Flexión pliométrica
instructions: Move into a prone posiciona on el suelo, supporting your weight on tus manos and toes.
tus brazos should be completamente extended with the hands around al ancho de hombros. mantén tu cuerpo recto throughout the movement. esta es tu posición inicial.
Descend by flexing at the codo, lowering tu pecho towards el suelo.
en el punto más bajo, reverse the motion by pushing yourself up through codo extension as rápidamente as possible. Attempt to empuja your upper body up hasta tus manos leave el suelo.
regresa a la posición inicial and repite the exercise.
For added difficulty, add claps into the movement mientras you are air borne.

name: Estiramiento del tibial posterior
instructions: In a seated posiciona, loop a belt, rope, or banda around one foot. esta es tu posición inicial.

With the leg extended and the heel off of el suelo, jala on the belt so that the foot is everted, with the outside of the foot being pulled towards you. mantén durante 10-20 seconds, and luego cambia de lado.

name: Power clean desde bloques
instructions: With a barra on boxes of the desired height, take a agarra just outside the legs. baja tus caderas with the weight focused on the heels, back recto, head facing hacia adelante, pecho up, with tus hombros just in front of the bar. esta es tu posición inicial.

comienza the first jala by driving through the heels, extending tus rodillas. tu espalda angle should stay the same, and tus brazos should remain recto. As the bar approaches the mid-muslo posiciona, comienza extending through the caderas.

In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending the caderas, rodillas, and tobillos, using speed to move the bar hacia arriba. There should be no need to actively jala through the arms to accelerate the weight. At the end of the second jala, the body should be completamente extended, leaning slightly back, with the arms still extended.

As full extension is achieved, transition into the third jala by aggressively shrugging and flexing the arms with the codos up and out. At peak extension, jala yourself under the bar far enough that it can be racked onto the hombros, rotating tus codos under the bar as you do so. The bar should be racked onto the protracted hombros, lightly touching the throat with the hands relaxed.

Immediately recover by driving through the heels, manteniendo torso upright and codos up. Continue hasta you have risen to a standing posiciona, and completa the repetition by returning the weight to the boxes.

name: Power jerk
instructions: Standing with the weight racked on the front of the hombros, comienza with the dip. With tus pies directly under tus caderas, flexiona the rodillas sin moving the caderas hacia atrás. Go down only slightly, and reverse direction as powerfully as possible.
Drive through the heels create as much speed and force as possible, and be sure to move tu cabeza out of the way as the bar leaves the hombros.

At this moment as the feet leave el suelo, the feet must be placed into the receiving posiciona as rápidamente as possible. In the brief moment the feet are not actively driving against the plataforma, the athletes effort to empuja the bar up will drive them down. The feet should be moved to a slightly wider stance, with the rodillas partially bent.
Receive the bar with the arms locked out sobre la cabeza.
regresa to a standing posiciona.

name: Power snatch
instructions: comienza with a loaded barra on el suelo. The bar should be close to or touching the espinillas, and a amplio agarra should be taken on the bar. The feet should be directly below the caderas, with the feet turned out as needed. baja the caderas, with the pecho up and the head looking hacia adelante. The hombros should be just in front of the bar. This will be the posición inicial.
comienza the first jala by driving through the front of the heels, raising the bar from el suelo. The back angle should stay the same hasta the bar passes the rodillas.

Transition into the second jala by extending through the caderas rodillas and tobillos, driving the bar up as rápidamente as possible. The bar should be close to the body. At peak extension, shrug the hombros and allow the codos to flexiona to the side.

As you move tus pies into the receiving posiciona, a slightly wider posiciona, jala yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar sobre la cabeza. The bar should be received in a partial squat. Continue raising the bar to the sobre la cabeza posiciona, receiving the bar locked out sobre la cabeza.
regresa to a standing posiciona with the weight over head.

name: Power snatch desde bloques
instructions: comienza with a loaded barra on boxes or stands of the desired height. A amplio agarra should be taken on the bar. The feet should be directly below the caderas, with the feet turned out as needed. baja the caderas, with the pecho up and the head looking hacia adelante. The hombros should be just in front of the bar, with the codos pointed out. This will be the posición inicial.
comienza the first jala by driving through the front of the heels, raising the bar from the boxes.

Transition into the second jala by extending through the caderas rodillas and tobillos, driving the bar up as rápidamente as possible. The bar should be close to the body. At peak extension, shrug the hombros and allow the codos to flexiona to the side.

As you move tus pies into the receiving posiciona, forcefully jala yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar sobre la cabeza. The feet should move to just outside the caderas, turned out as necessary. Receive the bar above a full squat and with the arms completamente extended sobre la cabeza.
manteniendo bar aligned over the front of the heels, tu cabeza and pecho up, drive through heels of the feet to move to a standing posiciona. Carefully regresa the weight to the boxes.

name: Escalones de potencia
instructions: In the power stairs, implements are moved up a staircase. For training purposes, these can be performed with a tire or box.

comienza by taking the implement with both hands. Set tus pies amplio, with tu cabeza and pecho up. Drive through el suelo with tus talones, extending tus rodillas and caderas to sube el peso from el suelo.
As you lean back, attempt to balancea the weight onto the stairs, which are usually around 16-18" high. You can use tus piernas to help empuja the weight onto the stair.
repite durante 3-5 repetitions, and continue with a heavier weight, moving as rápido as possible.

name: Sprint con trineo Prowler
instructions: coloca your sled on an appropriate surface, loaded to a suitable weight. The sled should provide enough resistance to require effort, but not so pesado that you are significantly slowed down.
You may use the upright or the low handles for this exercise. coloca tus manos on the handles with tus brazos extended, leaning into the implement.
With good posture, drive through el suelo with alternando, short steps. Move as rápido as you can for a short distance.

name: Push press por detrás del cuello
instructions: Standing with the weight racked on the back of the hombros, comienza with the dip. With tus pies directly under tus caderas, flexiona the rodillas sin moving the caderas hacia atrás. Go down only slightly, and reverse direction as powerfully as possible. Drive through the heels create as much speed and force as possible, moving the bar in a vertical path.
Using the momentum generated, termina pressing the weight sobre la cabeza be extending through the arms.
regresa a la posición inicial, using tus piernas to absorb the impact.

name: Pirámide
instructions: comienza off by rolling your torso hacia adelante onto the ball so tus caderas rest on top of the ball and become the highest point of tu cuerpo.

Rest tus manos and feet on el suelo. tus brazos and legs can be ligeramente flexionados or recto, depending on the size of the ball, your flexibility, and the length of your limbs. This also helps develop stabilizing strength in your torso and hombros.

name: Estiramiento de cuádriceps
instructions: Lay on your side. Loop a belt, rope, or banda around your top foot. flexiona the rodilla and extiende your cadera, attempting to touch tus glúteos with your foot, and holding the belt with tus manos. esta es tu posición inicial.
With the belt being held over the hombro or sobre la cabeza, gently jala to increase the stretch in the cuádriceps. mantén durante 10-20 seconds, and luego cambia de lado.

name: Liberación miofascial de cuádriceps
instructions: Lay facedown on el suelo with your weight supported by tus manos or antebrazos. coloca a foam roll underneath one leg on the cuádriceps, and mantén the foot off of el suelo. asegúrate de to relaja the leg as much as possible. esta es tu posición inicial.
Shifting as much weight onto the leg to be stretched as is tolerable, roll over the foam from above the rodilla to below the cadera, holding points of tension for 10-30 seconds. cambia de lado.

name: Salto rápido
instructions: You will need a box for this exerise.
comienza facing the box standing 1-2 feet from its edge.
By utilizing tus caderas, hop onto the box, landing on both legs. asegúrate de que that you aterriza with tus piernas bent and tus pies plano.
Immediately upon landing, completamente extiende through the entire body and balancea tus brazos sobre la cabeza to explode off of the box. Use tus piernas to absorb the impact of landing.

name: Entrega en rack
instructions: This drill teaches the delivery of the barra to the rack posiciona on the hombros. comienza holding a bar in the scarecrow posiciona, with the la parte superior de los brazos paralelo to el suelo, and the antebrazos hanging down. Use a hook agarra, with your fingers wrapped over your thumbs.

comienza by rotating the codos around the bar, delivering the bar to the hombros. As tus codos come hacia adelante, relaja your agarra. The hombros should be protracted, providing a shelf for the bar, which should lightly contact the throat.

It is important that the bar stay close to the body at all times, as with a heavier load any distance will result in an unwanted collision. As the movement becomes smoother, speed and load can be increased antes progressing further.

name: Jalón desde rack con bandas
instructions: Set up in a power rack with the bar on the pins. The pins should be set to the desired point; just below the rodillas, just above, or in the mid muslo posiciona. Attach bandas to the base of the rack, or secure them with mancuernas. Attach the other end to the bar. You may need to choke the bandas to provide tension.

posiciona yourself against the bar in proper deadlifting posiciona. tus pies should be under tus caderas, your agarra al ancho de hombros, back arched, and caderas back to activa the isquiotibiales. Since the weight is typically pesado, you may use a mixed agarra, a hook agarra, or use straps to aid in holding the weight.

With tu cabeza looking hacia adelante, extiende through the caderas and rodillas, pulling the weight up and back hasta lockout. Be sure to jala tus hombros back as you completa the movement. regresa the weight to the pins and repite.

name: Jalones desde rack
instructions: Set up in a power rack with the bar on the pins. The pins should be set to the desired point; just below the rodillas, just above, or in the mid muslo posiciona. posiciona yourself against the bar in proper deadlifting posiciona. tus pies should be under tus caderas, your agarra al ancho de hombros, back arched, and caderas back to activa the isquiotibiales. Since the weight is typically pesado, you may use a mixed agarra, a hook agarra, or use straps to aid in holding the weight.
With tu cabeza looking hacia adelante, extiende through the caderas and rodillas, pulling the weight up and back hasta lockout. Be sure to jala tus hombros back as you completa the movement.
regresa the weight to the pins and repite.

name: Elevaciones traseras de pierna
instructions: coloca yourself on tus manos rodillas on an exercise mat. tu cabeza should be looking hacia adelante and the flexiona of the rodillas should create a ángulo de 90 grados between the isquiotibiales and the pantorrillas. esta es tu posición inicial.
extiende one leg up and detrás de ti. The rodilla and cadera should both extiende. repite durante 5-10 repetitions, and luego cambia de lado.

name: Bicicleta reclinada
instructions: To comienza, seat yourself on the bike and ajusta the seat to your height.

Select the desired option from the menu. You may have to comienza pedaling to turn it on. You can use the manual setting, or you can select a program to use. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned durante exercise. The level of resistance can be changed throughout the workout. The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

Recumbent bikes offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and have less impact than other activities. A 150 lb person will burn about 230 calories cycling at a moderate rate for 30 minutes, compared to 450 calories or more running.

name: Empuje de retorno desde posición
instructions: You will need a partner for this drill.
comienza in an athletic 2 or 3 point stance.
At the signal, move into a posiciona to receive the pass from your partner.
atrapa the medicine ball with both hands and immediately lanza it back to your partner.
You can modify this drill by running different routes.

name: Press de banca con banda invertida
instructions: posiciona a banco inside a power rack, with the bar set to the correct height. comienza by anchoring bandas either to banda pegs or to the top of the rack. asegúrate de que that you will be posiciona correctamente under the bandas. Attach the other end to the barra.

acuéstate en banco, tuck tus pies underneath you and arquea tu espalda. Using the bar to help support your weight, levanta your hombro off the banco and retract them, squeezing the hombro blades together. Use tus pies to drive tus trapecios into the banco. Maintain this firme body posiciona throughout the movement. However amplio your agarra, it should cover the ring on the bar.

jala the bar out of the rack sin protracting tus hombros. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to jala it apart. baja the bar to your baja pecho or upper stomach. The bar, muñeca, and codo should stay in line at all times.
haz una pausa when the barra touches your torso, and luego drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The codos should be tucked in hasta lockout.

name: Sentadilla en cajón con banda invertida
instructions: comienza in a power rack with a box at the appropriate height detrás de ti. Set up the bandas either on banda pegs or attached to the top of the rack, ensuring they will be directly above the bar durante the squat. Attach the other end to the bar.

comienza by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the hombros. aprieta your hombro blades together and rota tus codos hacia adelante, attempting to flexiona the bar across tus hombros. Remove the bar from the rack, creating a firme arquea in your la espalda baja, and da un paso back into posiciona. coloca tus pies wider for more emphasis on the back, glúteos, adductors, and isquiotibiales, or closer together for more quad development. mantén tu cabeza facing hacia adelante.

With tu espalda, hombros, and core firme, empuja tus rodillas and butt out and you comienza your descent. siéntate back with tus caderas hasta you are seated on the box. Ideally, your espinillas should be perpendicular to el suelo. haz una pausa when you reach the box, and relaja the flexores de cadera. Never bounce off of a box.

manteniendo weight on tus talones and pushing tus pies and rodillas out, drive hacia arriba off of the box as you lead the movement with tu cabeza. Continue hacia arriba, maintaining tightness head to toe. Use care to regresa the barra to the rack.

name: Peso muerto con banda invertida
instructions: Set the bar up in a power rack. Attach bandas to the top of the rack, using either bandas pegs or the frame itself. Attach the other end of the bandas to the bar.

Approach the bar so that it is centered over tus pies. You feet should be about al ancho de la cadera. flexiona at the cadera to agarra la barra at al ancho de hombros, allowing your hombro blades to protract. Typically, you would use an agarre en pronación or an over/under agarra on heavier sets.
