With tus pies, and your agarra set, take a big breath and luego baja tus caderas and flexiona the rodillas hasta your espinillas contact the bar. Look hacia adelante with tu cabeza, mantén tu pecho up and tu espalda arched, and comienza driving through the heels to move the weight hacia arriba.
después the bar passes the rodillas, aggressively jala the bar back, pulling your hombro blades together as you drive tus caderas hacia adelante into the bar.
baja the bar by bending at the caderas and guiding it to el suelo.

name: Sentadilla de potencia con banda invertida
instructions: comienza in a power rack with the pins and bar set at the appropriate height. después loading the bar, attach bandas to the top of the rack, using either pegs or the frame itself. Attach the other end of the bandas to the bar.

comienza by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the hombros. aprieta your hombro blades together and rota tus codos hacia adelante, attempting to flexiona the bar across tus hombros. Remove the bar from the rack, creating a firme arquea in your la espalda baja, and da un paso back into posiciona. coloca tus pies amplio for more emphasis on the back, glúteos, adductors, and isquiotibiales.

mantén tu cabeza facing hacia adelante. With tu espalda, hombros, and core firme, empuja tus rodillas and butt out and you comienza your descent. siéntate back with tus caderas as much as possible. Ideally, your espinillas should be perpendicular to el suelo. baja bar posiciona necessitates a greater torso lean to mantén the bar over the heels. Continue hasta you break paralelo, which is defined as the crease of the cadera being in line with the top of the rodilla.

manteniendo weight on tus talones and pushing tus pies and rodillas out, drive hacia arriba as you lead the movement with tu cabeza. Continue hacia arriba, maintaining tightness head to toe, hasta you have returned to the posición inicial.

name: Sumo deadlift con banda invertida
instructions: comienza with a bar loaded on el suelo inside of a power rack. Attach bandas to the top of the rack, using either pegs or the frame itself. Attach the other end to the barra.

Approach the bar so that the bar intersects the middle of the feet. The feet should be set very amplio, near the collars. flexiona at the caderas to agarra la barra. The arms should be directly below the hombros, inside the legs, and you can use a agarre en pronación, a mixed agarra, or hook agarra. relaja the hombros, which in effect lengthens tus brazos.

Take a breath, and luego baja tus caderas, looking hacia adelante with tu cabeza with tu pecho up. Drive through el suelo, spreading tus pies apart, with your weight on the back half of tus pies. extiende through the caderas and rodillas.
As the bar passes through the rodillas, lean back and drive the caderas into the bar, pulling your hombro blades together.
regresa the weight to el suelo by bending at the caderas and controlling the weight on the way down.

name: Liberación miofascial de romboides
instructions: Lay down with tu espalda on el suelo. coloca a foam roll underneath your la espalda alta, and cross tus brazos frente a ti, protracting tus hombros. esta es tu posición inicial.

eleva tus caderas off of el suelo, placing your weight onto the foam roll. Shift your weight to one side at a time, rolling over your middle and la espalda alta. haz una pausa at points of tension for 10-30 seconds.

name: Cargada con rickshaw
instructions: posiciona the frame at the starting point, and load with the appropriate weight. Standing in the center of the frame, comienza by gripping the handles and driving through tus talones to levanta the frame. asegúrate de que tu pecho and head are up and tu espalda is recto.

Immediately comienza walking briskly with rápido, controlado steps. mantén tu pecho up and head hacia adelante, and asegúrate de you continue breathing. lleva the frame to el suelo después you have reached the end point.

name: Peso muerto con rickshaw
instructions: Load the frame with the desired weight. Center yourself between the handles. You feet should be about al ancho de la cadera. flexiona at the caderas to agarra the handles, allowing your hombro blades to protract.

With tus pies and your agarra set, take a big breath and luego baja tus caderas and flexiona the rodillas. Look hacia adelante with tu cabeza, mantén tu pecho up and tu espalda arched, and comienza driving through the heels to move the weight hacia arriba. As the weight comes up, jala your hombro blades together as you drive tus caderas hacia adelante.
baja el peso by bending at the caderas and guiding it to el suelo.

name: Salto cohete
instructions: comienza in a relaxed stance with tus pies al ancho de hombros and mantén tus brazos close to the body.
To initiate the move, squat down halfway and explode back up lo más alto posible.
completamente extiende your entire body, reaching sobre la cabeza lo más lejos posible. As you aterriza, absorb your impact through the legs.

name: Peso muerto rumano desde déficit
instructions: comienza standing mientras holding a bar at arm's length frente a ti. You can párate on a raised plataforma to increase the rango de movimiento.

comienza by flexing the rodillas slightly, and luego flexiona at the cadera, moving your butt back lo más lejos posible, lowering the torso as far as flexibility allows. The back should remain in absolute extension at all times, and the bar should remain in contact with the legs. If done correctamente, there should be pesado tension felt in the isquiotibiales.
Reverse the motion to regresa a la posición inicial.

name: Salto con cuerda
instructions: mantén an end of the rope in each hand. posiciona the rope detrás de ti on el suelo. eleva tus brazos up and turn the rope over tu cabeza bringing it down frente a ti. When it reaches el suelo, salta over it. Find a good turning pace that can be maintained. Different speeds and techniques can be used to introduce variation.
Rope jumping is exciting, challenges your coordination, and requires a lot of energy. A 150 lb person will burn about 350 calories jumping rope for 30 minutes, compared to over 450 calories running.

name: Estiramiento circular de hombros
instructions: párate erguido with tus piernas together, holding a bodybar or broomstick.
mantén the pole detrás de tus caderas with a wider than al ancho de hombros agarra. Your palms should be down and your thumbs facing out.
lentamente levanta tus brazos up detrás de tus head. Don't force it if it gets hard to levanta further.

name: Remo estático
instructions: To comienza, seat yourself on the rower. asegúrate de that tus talones are resting comfortably against the base of the foot pedals and that the straps are secured. Select the program that you wish to use, if applicable. siéntate up recto and flexiona hacia adelante at the caderas.

There are three phases of movement when using a rower. The first phase is when you come hacia adelante on the rower. tus rodillas are bent and against tu pecho. Your upper body is leaning slightly hacia adelante mientras still maintaining good posture. Next, empuja against the foot pedals and extiende tus piernas mientras bringing tus manos to your upper abdominal area, squeezing tus hombros back as you do so. To avoid straining tu espalda, use primarily your leg and cadera muscles.
The recovery phase simply involves straightening tus brazos, bending the rodillas, and bringing tu cuerpo hacia adelante again as you transition back into the first phase.

name: Estiramiento del corredor
instructions: It's easiest to colócate en this stretch if you comienza standing up, put one leg detrás de ti, and lentamente baja your torso down to el suelo.
mantén the front heel on el suelo (if it lifts up, scoot your other leg further back).

coloca tus manos on either side of your front leg. To get more out of this stretch, empuja your butt up toward el techo, and luego gradualmente baja it back toward el suelo. You'll Stretch the cadera flexor of the back leg and the isquiotibial and buttocks of the front.

name: Carrera en cinta
instructions: To comienza, da un paso onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu. Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned durante exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.

Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside. A 150 lb person will burn over 450 calories running 8 miles per hour for 30 minutes. Maintain proper posture as you run, and only mantén onto the handles when necessary, como por ejemplo when dismounting or checking your heart rate.

name: Carga de saco de arena
instructions: To load sandbags or other objects, comienza with the implements placed a distance from the loading plataforma, typically 50 feet.

comienza by lifting the sandbag. Sandbags are extremely awkward, and the manner of lifting them can vary depending on the particular sandbag used. Reach as far around it as possible, extending through the caderas and rodillas to jala it up high. Shouldering is usually not allowed.

Move as rápidamente as possible to the plataforma, and load it, extending through tus caderas, rodillas, and tobillos to get it lo más alto posible. coloca it onto the plataforma, ensuring it doesn't fall off.
regresa a la posición inicial to retrieve the next sandbag, and repite hasta the event is completed.

name: Patada tijera
instructions: To comienza, lie down with tu espalda pressed against el suelo or on an exercise mat (optional). tus brazos should be completamente extended to the sides with your palmas hacia abajo. Nota: The arms should be stationary the entire time.
With una ligera flexión at the rodillas, levanta tus piernas up so that tus talones are about 6 inches off el suelo. This is the posición inicial.
Now levanta your left leg up to about a 45 degree angle mientras your right leg is lowered hasta the heel is about 2-3 inches from el suelo.
Switch movements by raising your right leg up and lowering your left leg. Remember to breathe mientras performing this exercise.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Salto de tijeras
instructions: Assume a lunge stance posiciona with one foot hacia adelante with the rodilla bent, and the rear rodilla nearly touching el suelo.
asegúrate de que that the front rodilla is over the midline of the foot. Extending through both legs, salta lo más alto posible, swinging tus brazos to gain levanta.
As you salta as high as you can, switch the posiciona of tus piernas, moving your front leg to the back and the rear leg to the front.
As you aterriza, absorb the impact through the legs by adopting the lunge posiciona, and repite.

name: Estiramiento de bíceps sentado
instructions: siéntate en floor with tus rodillas bent and your partner standing detrás de ti. extiende tus brazos recto detrás de ti with your palmas enfrentadas. Your partner will mantén tus muñecas for you. This will be the posición inicial.
Attempt to flexiona tus codos, mientras your partner prevents any actual movement.

después 10-20 seconds, relaja tus brazos mientras your partner gently pulls tus muñecas up to stretch tus bíceps. Be sure to let your partner know when the stretch is appropriate to prevent injury or overstretching.

name: Estiramiento de pantorrilla sentado
instructions: siéntate up recto on an exercise mat.
flexiona one rodilla and put that foot on el suelo to stabilize the torso.
Straighten your other leg and flexiona your tobillo.
Using a banda, towel, or your hand if you can reach, jala the toes toward you. mantén durante 10 to 20 seconds, luego cambia de lado.

name: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales en suelo sentado
instructions: siéntate en mat with your right leg extended frente a ti and your left leg bent with your foot against your right inner muslo.
Lean hacia adelante from tus caderas and reach for your tobillo hasta you siente el estiramiento in your isquiotibial. mantén durante 15 seconds, luego repite durante your other side.

name: Estiramiento del deltoides anterior sentado
instructions: siéntate upright on el suelo with tus piernas bent, your partner standing detrás de ti. Stick tus brazos recto out a tu lados, with your palmas hacia el suelo. Attempt to move them as far detrás de ti as possible, as your assistant holds tus muñecas. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo codos recto, attempt to move tus brazos to the front, with your partner gently restraining you to prevent any actual movement for 10-20 seconds.
Now, relaja your muscles and allow your partner to gently increase the stretch on the hombros and pecho. mantén durante 10 to 20 seconds.

name: Estiramiento de glúteo sentado
instructions: In a seated posiciona with tus rodillas bent, cross one tobillo over the opposite rodilla. Your partner will párate detrás de ti. Now, lean hacia adelante as your partner braces tus hombros with their hands. esta es tu posición inicial.
Attempt to empuja your torso back for 10-20 seconds, as your partner prevents any actual movement of your torso.
Now relaja your muscles as your partner increases the stretch by gently pushing your torso hacia adelante for 10-20 seconds.

name: Buenos días sentado
instructions: Set up a box in a power rack. The pins should be set at an appropriate height. comienza by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the hombros, not on top of tus trapecios. aprieta your hombro blades together and rota tus codos hacia adelante, attempting to flexiona the bar across tus hombros.

Remove the bar from the rack, creating a firme arquea in your la espalda baja. mantén tu cabeza facing hacia adelante. With tu espalda, hombros, and core firme, empuja tus rodillas and butt out and you comienza your descent. siéntate back with tus caderas hasta you are seated on the box. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo bar firme, flexiona hacia adelante at the caderas as much as possible. If you set the pins to what would be paralelo, you not only have a safety if you fail, but know when to stop.
haz una pausa just above the pins and reverse the motion hasta your torso it upright.

name: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales sentado
instructions: In a seated posiciona with tus piernas extended, have your partner párate detrás de ti. Now, lean hacia adelante as your partner braces tus hombros with their hands. esta es tu posición inicial.
Attempt to empuja your torso back for 10-20 seconds, as your partner prevents any actual movement of your torso.
Now relaja your muscles as your partner increases the stretch by gently pushing your torso hacia adelante for 10-20 seconds.

name: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales y pantorrilla sentado
instructions: Loop a belt, rope, or banda around one foot. siéntate down with both legs extended . esta es tu posición inicial.
Leaning hacia adelante slightly, jala on the belt to draw the toes of your foot back. mantén esta posición for 10-20 seconds and luego repite with la otra pierna.

name: Estiramiento sobre cabeza sentado
instructions: siéntate up recto on an exercise mat.
Touch the soles of tus pies together with tus pies six to eight inches frente a tir caderas.
coloca one hand on el suelo beside you and your other hand detrás de tus head.
levanta your codo to el techo as you incline your torso to the other side. mantén durante 10 to 20 seconds, luego cambia de lado.

name: Círculos de hombros
instructions: With hombros relaxed and arms resting loosely a tus costados (or in your lap if you're seated), gently roll tus hombros hacia adelante, up, back, and down.
Reverse direction. You can do this exercise alternando hombros or both at the same time.

name: Elevación de hombros
instructions: relaja tus brazos a tu lados and eleva tus hombros up toward your ears, luego back down.

name: Estiramiento de hombros
instructions: Reach your left arm across tu cuerpo and mantén it recto.

name: Estiramiento lateral acostado en el suelo
instructions: First lie on your left side, bending your left rodilla frente a ti to stabilize your torso (use your abdominal muscles as well to mantén you upright).

Straighten your right leg and rest the right foot on el suelo detrás de tus left. Straighten your right arm over tu cabeza and gently jala on your right muñeca to stretch the entire right side of the body. cambia de lado.

name: Salto lateral con sprint
instructions: párate to the side of a cone or hurdle.
comienza this drill by hopping sideways over the obstacle, rebounding out of your landing to hop back to where you started.
Hop for a prescribed number or repetitions as rápidamente as possible, and termina this drill by sprinting a short distance upon landing the last hop.

name: Elevaciones laterales de pierna
instructions: párate next to a chair, which you may mantén onto as a support. párate on one leg. esta es tu posición inicial.
manteniendo leg recto, eleva it as far out to the side as possible, and balancea it back down, allowing it to cross the opposite leg.
repite this swinging motion 5-10 times, increasing the rango de movimiento as you do so.

name: Estiramiento de ingle lateral acostado
instructions: comienza off by lying on your right side and flexiona your right rodilla frente a ti to stabilize the torso.
Rest tu cabeza on your right hand or hombro. levanta your left leg hacia arriba and mantén it by the back of the rodilla (easier) or the foot (harder).
jala your left rodilla in toward your left hombro and simultáneamente presiona your foot or rodilla down to el suelo. To intensify this stretch, straighten your left leg. cambia de lado.

name: Estiramiento lateral del cuello
instructions: comienza with tus hombros relaxed, gently inclina tu cabeza towards your hombro.
Assist stretch with a gentle jala on the side of the head.

name: Salto largo lateral de pie
instructions: comienza standing with tus pies al ancho de la cadera in an athletic stance. tu cabeza and pecho should be up, rodillas and caderas ligeramente flexionados. esta es tu posición inicial.
Leaning to your right, extiende through tus caderas, rodillas, and tobillos to salta into the air. Block with the arms to lead the movement, jumping as far to your right as you can.
aterriza facing the same direction with tus pies al ancho de la cadera, absorbing the impact through your baja body.

name: Tirón lateral de muñeca
instructions: This stretch works best standing. Cross your left arm over the midline of tu cuerpo and mantén the left muñeca in your right hand down at the level of tus caderas. comienza the stretch with a bent left arm.
lentamente straighten, jala, and levanta it up to hombro height, as pictured. Feel this stretch originate in tu espalda, not tus hombros, and don't jala too hard on the hombros joint. cambia de lado.

name: Desplazamiento lateral en cajón
instructions: párate to one side of the box with your left foot resting on the middle of it.
To comienza, salta up and over to the other side of the box, landing with your right foot on top of the box and your left foot on el suelo. balancea tus brazos to aid your movement.
Continue shuffling back and forth across the box.

name: Ejercicio de sprint en cono
instructions: This drill teaches rápido foot action. You need a single cone. comienza standing next to the cone with one arm back and one arm hacia adelante.
Chop the feet as rápidamente as possible, blocking with the arms. Circle the cone, mantén tus rodillas up, with violent foot action.
Rest después three trips around the cone.

name: Progresión de saltos una pierna
instructions: Arrange a line of cones frente a ti. Assume a relaxed standing posiciona, balanced on one leg. eleva the rodilla of your opposite leg. esta es tu posición inicial.
Hop hacia adelante, jumping and landing with the same leg over the cone.
Use a countermovement salta to hop from cone to cone.
At the end, turn around and go back on la otra pierna.

name: Salto lateral una pierna
instructions: párate to the side of a cone or hurdle. To colócate en the comienza posiciona, párate on one leg with your rodilla ligeramente flexionados.
To comienza, ejecuta a counterjump to hop sideways over the cone.
aterriza on your jumping leg, and immediately rebound out of it by jumping back to the comienza posiciona.
Continue hopping back and forth.

name: Salto de zancada una pierna
instructions: párate to the side of a box with your inside foot on top of it, close to the edge.
comienza by swinging the arms hacia arriba as you empuja through the top leg, jumping hacia arriba lo más alto posible. Attempt to drive the opposite rodilla hacia arriba.
aterriza in the same posiciona that you started, using your inside leg to decelerate the impact.

name: Talón al glúteo una pierna
instructions: comienza by standing on one leg, with the bent rodilla raised. This will be your comienza posiciona.
Using a countermovement salta, take off hacia arriba by extending the cadera, rodilla, and tobillo of el sueloed leg.
Immediately flexiona the rodilla and attempt to touch your butt with the heel of your jumping leg.
regresa the leg to a partially bent posiciona underneath the caderas and aterriza. Your opposite leg should stay in relatively the same posiciona throughout the drill.

name: Despegue una pierna
instructions: párate on el suelo with one foot resting on the box, heel close to the edge.
empuja off with your foot on top of the box, trying to gain as much height as possible by extending through the cadera and rodilla.
aterriza with the same foot on top of the box, returning your other foot back to the comienza posiciona.

name: Sentadilla-sentarse
instructions: párate con los pies al ancho de hombros. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza the movement by flexing tus rodillas and caderas, sitting back with tus caderas.
Continue hasta you have squatted a portion of the way down, but are above paralelo, and rápidamente reverse the motion hasta you regresa a la posición inicial. repite durante 5-10 repetitions.

name: Patinaje
instructions: Roller skating is a fun activity which can be effective in improving cardiorespiratory fitness and muscular endurance. It requires relatively good balance and coordination. It is necessary to learn the basics of skating including turning and stopping and to wear protective gear to avoid possible injury.

You can skate at a cómodo pace for 30 minutes recto. If you want a cardio challenge, do interval skating — speed skate two minutes of every five minutes, using the remaining three minutes to recover. A 150 lb person will typically burn about 175 calories in 30 minutes skating at a cómodo pace, similar to brisk walking.

name: Arrastre de trineo con arnés
instructions: To comienza, load the sled with the desired weight and attach the pulling strap. You can jala with handles, use a harness, or attach the pulling strap to a weight belt.
Whether pulling forwards or backwards, lean in the direction of travel and progress by extending through the caderas and rodillas.

name: Empuje de trineo
instructions: Load your pushing sled with the desired weight.

Take an athletic posture, leaning into the sled with tus brazos completamente extended, grasping the handles. empuja the sled as rápido as possible, focusing on extending tus caderas and rodillas to strengthen your posterior cadena.

name: Golpes con mazo
instructions: You will need a tire and a sledgehammer for this exercise. párate in front of the tire about two feet away from it with a staggered stance. agarra the sledgehammer.
If you are right handed, your left hand should be en el punto más bajo of the handle, and your right hand should be choking up closer to the head.

As you lleva the sledge up, your right hand slides toward the head; as you balancea down, your right hand will slide down to join your left hand. Slam it down as hard as you can against the tire. Control the bounce of the hammer off of the tire.
repite en el otro lado.

name: Snatch
instructions: coloca tus pies at a al ancho de hombros stance with the barra resting right above the connection between the toes and the rest of the foot.

With a palmas hacia abajo agarra, flexiona at the rodillas and manteniendo back plano agarra la barra using a wider than al ancho de hombros agarra. lleva the caderas down and asegúrate de that tu cuerpo drops as if you were going to siéntate en chair. esta es tu posición inicial.
comienza pushing el suelo as if it were a moving plataforma with tus pies and simultáneamente comienza lifting the barra keeping it close to tus piernas.
As the bar reaches the middle of your muslos, empuja el suelo with tus piernas and levanta tu cuerpo to a completa extension in an explosivo motion.
levanta tus hombros back in a shrugging movement as you lleva the bar up mientras lifting tus codos out to the side and manteniendom above the bar for as long as possible.

Now in a very rápido but powerful motion, you have to get tu cuerpo under the barra when it has reached a high enough point where it can be controlado and baja mientras locking tus brazos and holding the barra sobre la cabeza as you assume a squat posiciona.

Finalize the movement by rising up out of the squat posiciona to termina the levanta. At the end of the levanta both feet should be on line and the arms completamente extended holding the barra sobre la cabeza.

name: Balance de snatch
instructions: comienza with the feet in the pulling posiciona, the bar racked across the back of the hombros, and the hands placed in a amplio snatch agarra.
Pop the bar with an abrupt dip and drive of the rodillas, and aggressively drive under the bar, transitioning the feet into the receiving posiciona.
Receive the bar locked out sobre la cabeza near the bottom of the squat. The torso should remain vertical, lowering the caderas between the legs.
Continue to descend to full depth, and regresa to a standing posiciona. Carefully baja el peso.

name: Peso muerto de snatch
instructions: The snatch deadlift strengthens the first jala of the snatch. comienza with a amplio snatch agarra with the barra placed on the plataforma. The feet should be directly under the caderas, with the feet turned out. Squat down to the bar, manteniendo back in absolute extension with the head facing hacia adelante.
Initiate the movement by driving through the heels, raising the caderas. The back angle should remain the same hasta the bar passes the rodillas.
At that point, drive tus caderas through the bar as you lay back. regresa the bar to the plataforma by reversing the motion.

name: Encogimiento de snatch
instructions: comienza with a amplio agarra, with the bar hanging at the mid muslo posiciona. You can use a hook or agarre en pronación. tu espalda should be recto and inclined slightly hacia adelante.
Shrug tus hombros towards your ears. mientras this exercise can usually by loaded with heavier weight than a snatch, avoid overloading to the point that the execution slows down.

name: Snatch desde bloques
instructions: comienza with a loaded barra on boxes or stands of the desired height. A amplio agarra should be taken on the bar. The feet should be directly below the caderas, with the feet turned out as needed. baja the caderas, with the pecho up and the head looking hacia adelante. The hombros should be just in front of the bar, with the codos pointed out. This will be the posición inicial.
comienza the first jala by driving through the front of the heels, raising the bar from the boxes.

Transition into the second jala by extending through the caderas rodillas and tobillos, driving the bar up as rápidamente as possible. The bar should be close to the body. At peak extension, shrug the hombros and allow the codos to flexiona to the side.

As you move tus pies into the receiving posiciona, forcefully jala yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar sobre la cabeza. name: Círculos de muñeca
instructions: comienza by standing recto with tus pies being al ancho de hombros from each other. Elevate tus brazos to the side of you hasta they are completamente extended and paralelo to el suelo at a height that is evenly aligned with tus hombros. Consejo: Your torso and arms should form the letter "T: Your palms should be facing down. This is the posición inicial.

manteniendo entire body stationary except for the muñecas, comienza to rota both muñecas hacia adelante in a circular motion. Consejo: Pretend that you are trying to draw circles by using tus manos as the brush. Breathe normally as you realiza this exercise.
repite durante the número de repeticiones recomendadas.

name: Caminata con yugo
instructions: The yoke is usually done with a yoke apparatus, but is sometimes seen with refrigerators or other pesado objects.
comienza by racking the apparatus across the back of the hombros. With tu cabeza looking hacia adelante and back arched, levanta the yoke by driving through the heels.

comienza walking as rápidamente as possible using short, rápido steps. You may mantén the side posts of the yoke to help estable it and mantén it in posiciona. Continue for the given distance as rápido as possible, usually 75-100 feet.
